raw.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the role

Kong is hiring a Senior Director, GTM People Business Partner to be the senior people leader for our global go-to-market organization. Reporting to our Chief People Officer, you will sit on the Chief Revenue Officer’s leadership team and partner with the leaders of Direct Sales, Sales Engineering, Sales and Business Development, Channels, Revenue Operations and Enablement across the Americas, EMEA and APJ.

This is a builder’s role at a pivotal moment. Kong’s Series E is funding global go-to-market expansion, our field teams are growing across more than a dozen countries, and our sales motion is moving from API management to AI connectivity. You will shape how the revenue organization is designed, led, paid and grown, and lead the People Business Partners who support it.

What you’ll do

  • Partner with the CRO and GTM leadership. Be the people voice on the CRO’s staff: org, talent, leadership and culture counsel, and the translation of each year’s revenue plan into a people plan.

  • Design the GTM organization for its next stage. Lead coverage-model changes, spans and layers, regional structures, and role architecture and leveling for sales, solutions engineering, SDR/BDR, partner and enablement roles, including new AI-connectivity selling roles.

  • Run headcount and capacity planning. With Finance, Revenue Operations and Talent Acquisition, build the ramp-adjusted capacity model, sequence hiring by territory and start date, and run a monthly GTM hiring review.

  • Govern sales compensation. With Global GTM Compensation and Total Rewards, shape plan philosophy, OTE and pay-mix benchmarks, quota-setting fairness, rollout, exceptions and disputes.

  • Build the GTM performance system. Run quarterly talent and attainment reviews, calibration, promotion criteria and fair, fast performance management across US, EMEA and APJ employment law.

  • Build the sales leadership bench. Assess first- and second-line leaders, own succession plans for the CRO’s leadership team, coach senior leaders, and launch a front-line sales manager program with Sales Enablement.

  • Shorten ramp and keep top performers. Define 30/60/90 plans with Enablement and Talent Acquisition, track time to quota, find the causes of early attrition and run targeted retention plans.

  • Protect culture, inclusion and engagement in the field. Own the GTM engagement read and the actions that follow, manager effectiveness, belonging and the norms of a distributed team.

  • Own employee relations and people risk for GTM. Lead investigations, restructures and international employment compliance across more than a dozen countries, with Legal and regional People leads.

  • Bring the data. Build the GTM people dashboard (attrition, ramp, attainment distribution, span of control, hiring velocity, representation) and present it at every QBR.

  • Lead the people side of change. Territory realignments, comp-plan changes, reorganizations, acquisition integrations and the field’s shift to AI connectivity.

  • Lead the GTM People Business Partner team and help shape Kong’s People operating model, including how AI and automation change HR work.


What you’ll bring

• 12+ years in People, including 5+ years as the lead business partner to a CRO, Chief Sales Officer or SVP of Sales at a B2B software company that at least doubled revenue during your

tenure.

• A background in infrastructure, developer-platform, API, cloud or open-source software. You know how technical sellers, solutions engineers and channel teams work, and how an open-source funnel feeds enterprise sales.

• Experience designing sales organizations with Finance and Revenue Operations: coverage models, spans and layers, role architecture, leveling and ramp-adjusted capacity plans.

• Fluency in sales compensation: OTE and pay-mix benchmarking, quota setting, accelerators and SPIFs, plan rollout, exceptions and disputes, and plans for usage-based products.

• A track record running performance management and talent reviews for quota-carrying teams in the US and in EMEA or APJ, including exits and restructures under different employment laws.

• Experience assessing and developing sales leaders, building succession plans for a revenue leadership team and coaching VP-level executives.

• Data fluency: you build and defend a people dashboard and bring analysis, not anecdotes, to a CRO staff meeting.

• Executive presence and judgment that a CRO and a CPO both trust, with speed and discretion on sensitive issues.

• Based in Southern California, or able to spend regular time in person with GTM leadership, with travel to San Francisco and the field.

How you’ll work.

You are in the room before the decision, not after it. You say what the data says,

including to the CRO, and you leave managers more capable than you found them.

Nice to have

• You have been through a platform-to-AI shift in a company’s sales motion.

• You have integrated an acquired team into a sales organization.

• You have worked in a People function that uses AI and automation in recruiting and operations.

• You have partnered Customer Success and Business Development as well as direct sales.

• You have built or led a team of People Business Partners.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit .

Compensation Range: $192K - $356K

About

We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence.

There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Focus: Making the Android OS / custom ROM work correctly with the actual physical phone hardware.

This is different from conventional Android application development.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate AOSP / custom ROM with the selected device hardware.

  • Work with Board Support Packages (BSPs).

  • Integrate vendor-specific Hardware Abstraction Layers (HALs).

  • Work with firmware and device drivers.

  • Support device bring-up and boot processes.

  • Integrate camera, microphone, speakers, sensors, modem, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

  • Troubleshoot hardware and firmware compatibility issues.

  • Work with ODM/OEM and chipset vendors.

  • Optimize power consumption and hardware performance.

Requirements

  • Experience with Android platform, BSP or embedded Linux development.

  • Understanding of Android HAL and hardware integration.

  • C / C++ knowledge.

  • Understanding of Linux kernel and device drivers. (IMPORTANT)

  • Experience debugging firmware and hardware integration issues.

Nice to have

  • Qualcomm or MediaTek experience.

  • Android device bring-up.

  • Custom ROM development.

  • Experience working with smartphone manufacturers or ODMs.

At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

Assists Mortgage Regional Manager in the leadership and management of Mortgage Loan Originators to achieve production goals, operational excellence, growth and profitability of the region. Maintains a personal pipeline of retail mortgage loans. Recruits, interviews and trains elite talent, as well as be pro-active in retaining current employees and managing performance. Actively participates in local and state mortgage banking, realtor, and builder trade associations, and maintains a thorough understanding of mortgage industry knowledge and current issues. Communicates business goals, objectives and company performance results to staff. Promotes an effective sales environment through sales training, individual and team coaching, and creation of marketing materials. Acts as liaison between U.S. Bank Home Mortgage and other departments/areas of the company. Establishes collaborative partnerships with other business lines within U.S. Bank.

This position requires National Mortgage Licensing System (NMLS) registration under the terms of the S.A.F.E. Act of 2008 and Regulation Z. You will be subject to the required registration process, which includes a criminal background and credit check. Failure to meet or maintain any of the NMLS registration requirements, including maintaining a satisfactory criminal and credit record, may result in a rescission of your offer or termination of employment.
Basic Qualifications
- Typically a Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
- Typically two or more years of relevant experience
Preferred Skills/Experience
- Thorough knowledge of sales and sales strategies

- Well-developed leadership skills

- Effective verbal and written communication skills
- Well-developed customer service/relations skills
- Demonstrated new business development and relationship management skills
- Thorough knowledge of mortgage products/services, operations, and current market trends
- Minimum two years of supervisory experience preferred

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Benefits:

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Basic term and optional term life insurance

  • Short-term and long-term disability

  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave

  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan

  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)

  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities

  • Adoption assistance

  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

U.S. Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

E-Verify

U.S. Bank participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program in all facilities located in the United States and certain U.S. territories. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

This role receives an annual base salary between $49,000 and $70,350 depending on the required state minimum, plus eligibility for incentives based on employee’s production under the applicable incentive plan.

U.S. Bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. U.S. Bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act as well as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. U.S. Bank is subject to, and conducts background checks consistent with the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA). In addition, certain positions may also be subject to the requirements of FINRA, NMLS registration, Reg Z, Reg G, OFAC, the NFA, the FCPA, the Bank Secrecy Act, the SAFE Act, and/or federal guidelines applicable to an agreement, such as those related to ethics, safety, or operational procedures.

raw.description:
About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities.

Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding across the Northeast and building a team of mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking an experienced and strategic Regional Medical Director to provide physician leadership across our Detroit and Chicago markets. In this pivotal role, you will work closely with operational and clinical leaders to support care delivery, elevate provider performance, advance quality initiatives, and drive ongoing market growth.

Our physicians serve older adults residing in affordable housing communities—many of whom face significant barriers to accessing healthcare. The ideal candidate is a mission-driven physician leader, passionate about improving outcomes for underserved populations and supporting providers and clinical teams across multiple markets.

As Regional Medical Director, you will be a key clinical leader, charged with ensuring exceptional care delivery while advancing clinical strategy, provider engagement, operational excellence, and patient outcomes. This highly collaborative position is ideal for a physician leader who enjoys team-building, process improvement, and championing healthcare innovation in community-based settings.

Responsibilities

  • Provide clinical leadership and oversight across assigned Chicago or Detroit markets

  • Partner with Operations, Clinical, and Executive leadership to support growth initiatives and strategic objectives

  • Mentor, develop, and support physicians and advanced practice providers

  • Lead quality improvement initiatives and champion high-quality patient care

  • Assist in developing, standardizing, and optimizing clinical workflows, protocols, and best practices

  • Monitor clinical performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve patient outcomes and operational effectiveness

  • Support provider recruitment, onboarding, and retention

  • Participate in clinical program development and implementation

  • Serve as a clinical ambassador and leader within Matter Health communities

Qualifications

  • Active MD or DO license

  • Board certification required

  • 5+ years of physician leadership experience preferred

  • Experience leading providers or managing multi-site healthcare operations strongly preferred

  • Background in value-based care, population health, primary care, or community-based healthcare is a plus

  • Demonstrated leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills

  • Proven success driving operational improvements and clinical initiatives

  • Experience leading through growth, change, and organizational expansion

  • Willingness to travel throughout the Chicago or Detroit region as needed (approximately 25–40%)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-market or regional leadership experience

  • Experience serving underserved or senior populations

  • Medicare Advantage or value-based care experience

  • Familiarity collaborating with interdisciplinary healthcare teams

  • Passion for serving vulnerable, underserved, or aging populations

  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships across clinical and operational settings

What Success Looks Like

  • Partnering effectively with Regional Operations leadership to drive market performance

  • Supporting and developing physicians and advanced practice providers across assigned markets

  • Improving quality, patient outcomes, and provider engagement

  • Helping to scale Matter Health’s integrated care model throughout the Southeast

  • Serving as a trusted clinical leader, balancing operational excellence with compassionate, patient-centered care

Why Matter Health

We believe that where someone lives should never determine the care they receive. Every team member at Matter Health plays an essential role in improving healthcare access for older adults historically underserved by traditional healthcare systems. This is not just our mission statement—it’s the work we do every day.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

Working at Matter Health

We are committed to supporting the whole person—at work and beyond. Full-time team member benefits begin the first of the month following your start date.

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Employer-funded HSA options

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

  • Voluntary illness, accident, and hospitalization coverage

  • Access to Matter Health’s in-person and virtual care services

Financial Security

  • Competitive compensation

  • 401(k) with company match beginning at day 60

  • Access to financial wellness resources and support

Time Away

  • Up to 4 weeks of PTO

  • 10 paid company holidays

  • 2 volunteer days annually to support causes meaningful to you

Professional Growth

  • Annual CME allowance for continuing education and certifications

  • Dedicated paid CME days for conferences and professional development

  • Opportunity to work within an innovative, community-based healthcare model

  • Collaborative interdisciplinary clinical support team

Eligibility is based on full-time employment status. Additional details will be shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Matter Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences and are dedicated to creating an environment where every team member feels valued, respected, and supported.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

raw.excerpt: AboutWe are reimagining the phone.  AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost.
raw.description:
About

We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence.

There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Focus: Defining the hardware platform strategy and specifications for the AI-native phone, ensuring the selected hardware can support both current and future AI capabilities.

This is a more strategic hardware role than Device Integration. The focus is on evaluating hardware architectures, selecting the right SoC and components, defining device specifications, and working with ODMs to translate product requirements into hardware designs.

Responsibilities

  • Define the overall hardware platform strategy and roadmap for the phone.

  • Evaluate and compare mobile SoC platforms, including Qualcomm, MediaTek and other potential vendors.

  • Define hardware specifications covering CPU, GPU, NPU, RAM, storage, memory bandwidth and connectivity.

  • Evaluate NPU capabilities, supported AI frameworks, compute performance and memory constraints for on-device AI workloads.

  • Define hardware requirements for AI-native features, including always-on hotword detection, camera and audio processing, background AI execution and sensor integration.

  • Evaluate power consumption, thermal performance, battery capacity and sustained compute performance.

  • Work with product and AI teams to translate future AI capabilities into hardware requirements.

  • Assess whether existing commercial platforms can meet our requirements or whether deeper hardware customization is necessary.

  • Work directly with ODM/OEM and chipset vendors to review platform proposals, component selection and technical feasibility.

  • Review hardware architecture, component specifications and design trade-offs proposed by ODMs.

  • Identify opportunities for dedicated AI accelerators, low-power processing and other hardware capabilities that could differentiate the device.

  • Establish hardware validation criteria and ensure the selected platform has sufficient headroom for future software and AI capabilities.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in smartphone hardware architecture, mobile SoC or embedded hardware engineering.

  • Deep understanding of mobile SoC architecture, including CPU, GPU, NPU, memory subsystem and hardware acceleration.

  • Experience evaluating and selecting smartphone hardware platforms.

  • Understanding of power architecture, thermal management, battery performance and hardware constraints.

  • Experience defining hardware specifications and technical requirements for mobile devices.

  • Experience working directly with ODM/OEM, chipset vendors and hardware suppliers.

  • Ability to translate product and AI requirements into concrete hardware specifications and platform decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Qualcomm Snapdragon or MediaTek Dimensity platforms.

  • Experience with AI accelerator / NPU architecture and on-device AI workloads.

  • Experience with smartphone hardware design and component selection.

  • Experience with camera ISP, audio DSP and sensor architecture.

  • Experience taking a smartphone product from platform selection through mass production.

  • Experience with custom hardware platforms or ODM product development.

This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company.

Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all.

The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry:

  • Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.

  • Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time).

  • Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building.

  • Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week.

  • Fully remote, with work equipment provided.

  • A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet.

  • And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously.

As a member in the Customer Operations team, some of your responsibilities could include:

  • Taking great care of our customers. Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike.

  • Answering inbound calls from policyholders who need something changed.

  • Getting deep on the product. With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it.

  • Problem solving to resolve customer inquiries effectively.

  • Processing service requests — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents.

  • Making the product better. Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship.

Who you are:

  • Prior work experience in customer service, sales, or hospitality is a plus, but not required

  • Genuinely friendly and positive attitude and willingness to work as a team

  • Strong work ethic

  • Strong problem solving skills

  • Strong communication skills

Compensation and perks:

  • Hourly wage of $19.00 - 21.00 + equity (stock options)

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Job Description

Job Purpose

As a Senior National Account Manager for Away from Home, you will be responsible for driving growth across Kraft Heinz portfolio within our Away from Home channel. This role is ideal for a results-driven leader who thrives on full ownership, strategic selling, and influencing key decision-makers—both internally and externally. We’re looking for a candidate who sees the big picture, understands the complexities of the three-tier system, and is passionate about turning data into actionable wins. This is more than a traditional sales role—it’s an opportunity to lead with impact, unlock new business, and champion the voice of the customer across a dynamic and high-growth channel.


Essential Functions & Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of sales and marketing programs to drive revenue growth within across multiple AFH channels.

· Cultivate and manage relationships with key stakeholders including distributors, C-store operators, franchisee groups, and non-commercial Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).

· Deeply understand and navigate the three-tier system—leveraging distributor and operator partnerships to unlock consumer insights and business growth.

· Identify growth opportunities using syndicated and internal data and deliver actionable strategies to expand distribution and velocity.

· Effectively sell new and expanded distribution opportunities across regional and national operators.

· Customize strategic sales plans based on each customer’s business needs and channel dynamics.

· Deliver clear, concise, and compelling sales updates and performance reporting to senior leadership.

· Ensure strong execution of promotions and innovation launches through detailed follow-ups and tracking.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with National Account Manager peers and Customer Vice Presidents to deliver annual operating plan objectives.

· Own and manage budgets, including trade, travel, and expenses, ensuring efficient resource allocation and strong ROI.

· Prepare and deliver high-impact customer presentations for business reviews and key selling initiatives.

· Continuously identify white space opportunities and pursue volume growth within existing and new accounts.


Expected Experience & Required Skills

· Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, sales, or related field preferred. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

· 5 to 7 years of experience in sales, with at least 3 years focused on selling to multi-unit operators, non-commercial accounts, c-store, or regional chains.

· Proven success building relationships with Away From Home customers, wholesalers, and internal cross-functional teams.

· Strong understanding of category management, trade strategy, and P&L ownership.

· Experience in collaborating cross-functionally with marketing, supply chain, finance, and sales operations teams.

· Demonstrated ability to use data to develop and execute customer strategies.

· Highly motivated, self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, customer-facing role.

· Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, demonstrated by effective presentation, influence, and advanced negotiation skills with both internal and external stakeholders.

· Detail-oriented with a track record of follow-through and delivering results with limited direction.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).

· Ability to adapt selling strategies to virtual platforms (MS Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, FaceTime, etc.).

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds when needed (e.g., delivering customer samples, etc.).

· Valid driver’s license and ability to meet MVR requirements.

· Willingness and ability to travel up to 40% of the time for in-person engagements with customers, distributors, and internal teams, as needed.


Work Environment & Schedule

This is a remote-based role that can be performed from a home office, with travel required based on business needs. The position follows a salaried, exempt schedule, allowing flexibility to meet customer and internal expectations, which may include occasional early mornings, evenings, or weekends. Regular domestic travel within the assigned territory is expected, including overnight trips as necessary. The role requires in-person engagement with customers, distributors, and internal teams to drive business objectives effectively. To support travel needs, this position is eligible for a company-provided vehicle or a car allowance.

Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values.

$120,800.00 - $151,000.00

Coverage for benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

raw.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

At Innodata, we’re partnering with the world’s leading technology companies to build the future of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re on the lookout for smart, savvy, and curious Generative AI Specialist to join our global contributor community as part of our Subject Matter Expert (SME) on Demand program.

This is not a traditional full-time role. It’s a part-time, remote, flexible, project-specific opportunity designed for those who want to make a real impact—on their schedule. Whether you're a writer, linguist, educator, researcher, or just deeply passionate about language and logic, this role lets you contribute to cutting-edge AI development while maintaining control over your time.

You’ll be helping LLMs learn the intricacies of language and reasoning—not just how to write, but how to think. If you’ve ever dreamed of shaping the intelligence behind tomorrow’s technology, this is your chance.

This is more than just a gig—it’s a rare chance to help shape the future of AI from anywhere in the world, on your own terms.

What You’ll Own:

  • Rating/assessing the performance of AI models or algorithms based on their output or behavior through a set of evaluative questions.
  • Labeling elements of a piece of content rather than the content as a whole.
  • Assigning predefined categories or labels to items.
  • Evaluating the perceived quality and/or appropriateness of content
  • Generating labels to advance understanding of a concept, trend etc.
  • Creation of additional training data for machine learning models by applying transformations to the original data, such as modifying images (rotation, flipping, cropping), generating new text (paraphrasing, summarization), or altering audio/video signals (speed modification, pitch shifting) to reduce overfitting and increase dataset diversity.
  • Reviewing data and identifying whether or not a product feature works as intended based on the project's guidelines.
  • Labeling model outputs to identify if a piece of content is or isn't something. Examples: identify clickbait; identifying gaming videos; identifying branded content.
  • Ordering or ranking items based on a set of preferences or criteria.
  • Creating prompts or questions that will be used to generate responses from a language model or other AI system.
  • Projects that evaluate the relevance of content based on a relevancy scale (1-3, 1-5, etc.).
  • Generating responses to prompts or questions using a language model or other AI system.
  • Rewriting existing text while preserving the original meaning, often to improve clarity or style and adherence to guidelines.
  • Producing concise summaries of longer pieces of text or data.
  • Converting spoken language or audio content into written text.
  • Converting text or spoken language from one language to another.
  • Gathering and compiling various forms of data to be used for training, evaluating, or fine-tuning the AI models. This may include text, images, videos, audio files, or other types of digital content.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a humanities specialization is required. Advanced degrees are strongly preferred (Master’s or PhD)
  • Professional or Expert level proficiency (C1/C2) in English

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $15 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. The Account Manager role is a partner support position within the BrokerBrand TPO channel, responsible for ensuring approved broker partners can successfully deliver loans to BrokerBrand TPO. The role centers on portal training and education, real-time assistance and guidance through a partner’s primary submissions, troubleshooting, and hands-on support gathering the documentation required to complete a file. The end responsibility of this position is a loan file that is submitted complete and accurately and moves directly to Underwriting without rework. Success in this role is measured by submission quality, partner proficiency in TPO Connect, and the speed and accuracy of the support provided.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Train and support broker partners on TPO Connect, including loan registration, pricing, document submission, conditions, status tracking, and other portal functionality.
  • Conduct new partner onboarding and provide ongoing training on BrokerBrand TPO processes, products, guidelines, systems, and submission requirements.
  • Develop and maintain partner training materials, job aids, submission checklists, and other resources.
  • Assist with new partner setup, activation, system access, and readiness to submit loans.
  • Provide ongoing support to partners throughout loan registration and initial submission, including troubleshooting portal, access, pricing, and document-related issues.

  • Support channel initiatives, including process changes, policy updates, product launches, and system enhancements.

  • Expected to meet productivity guidelines of the position.
  • Effectively use software specific for the position and Microsoft office products.
  • Work well with other members of the EHL team and be willing to fill in when needed.

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum three years of mortgage lending experience, with wholesale or third-party originations experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting and training external users on mortgage lending systems and loan delivery processes; experience with ICE TPO Connect and Encompass strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn new systems, portals, and technology quickly.

  • Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, sit climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

The base hourly range rate for this position is $28.00 - $35.00 per hour, depending on a number of factors including location and experience. If applicable, associate may be eligible for per-file incentives, commissions, bonuses or other variable earnings as determined upon hire.

As VP, Global Growth Marketing at vCluster Labs, you aren’t just running demand gen campaigns; you are building the global growth engine that turns market awareness into predictable, measurable pipeline. We already have strong product marketing, creative, community, ecosystem partnerships and events. Your job is to pull them into one system that covers ABM, field marketing, digital demand and marketing operations, using modern, AI-native ways of working. You won’t inherit a working machine here. You’ll build it, and you’ll own the strategy, team, budget and systems that tie marketing investment to revenue.

As VP, Global Growth Marketing, your role will include:

  • Global Demand & Pipeline: You will own the global demand strategy, pipeline targets, budget and performance across enterprise and AI infrastructure markets. You’ll build an always-on engine that covers paid digital, inbound, outbound orchestration, ABM, events and field. You’ll set funnel targets and conversion benchmarks and be accountable for marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline.

  • Account-Based & Field Marketing: You will build and scale a global ABM motion aimed at high-value accounts and buying groups. You’ll work with Sales leadership on account selection, intent signals and coordinated execution. You’ll also lead field programs across North America, EMEA and other priority markets, and you’ll measure every event and executive program by how it moves accounts forward and creates pipeline.

  • Digital Growth & Conversion: You will own paid search, paid social, retargeting and other acquisition channels. With Product Marketing and Creative, you’ll run website conversion, landing pages and experimentation. You’ll manage agencies against clear ROI targets and work with content and SEO/AEO to turn organic and AI search visibility into demand.

  • Marketing Operations & Analytics: You will build the marketing ops foundation for a high-growth global revenue org: funnel architecture, lifecycle definitions, attribution, lead routing, scoring and dashboards. You’ll work with Revenue Operations to keep data flowing cleanly across Salesforce, HubSpot and other GTM systems. You’ll also bring in AI-enabled workflows that make the team more efficient and personalize outreach at scale.

  • Team Leadership & Executive Partnership: You will build and lead a global team that covers demand gen, ABM, field, events and marketing ops, with clear ownership and operating rhythms. You’ll be a strategic partner to Sales and executive leadership. You’ll own planning, resource allocation and budget calls, and back your recommendations with data.

  • Early Impact: In your first 30 days, you’ll set the growth strategy and operating plan, agree a data and attribution roadmap with RevOps, and stand up an initial ABM motion. Within 3 to 6 months, you’ll have a repeatable pipeline engine with reliable reporting on sourced and influenced pipeline and how efficiently budget turns into pipeline.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Demand & Growth Leadership: 10+ years of B2B marketing, including significant leadership in demand generation, growth or revenue marketing at high-growth enterprise technology companies.

  • Pipeline Ownership: A track record of owning meaningful pipeline targets and marketing budgets, with clear accountability for business outcomes.

  • Enterprise GTM Depth: Deep expertise in ABM, enterprise demand gen, digital acquisition and field marketing. You also know how complex, sales-led deals with many stakeholders actually get bought.

  • Ops & Analytical Rigor: Experience building or overhauling marketing ops, attribution, automation and revenue reporting, plus the financial sense to turn performance data into decisions.

  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience leading distributed teams and agencies, and the credibility to influence, challenge and partner with senior Sales and executive stakeholders.

  • Builder’s Mentality: Strategic enough to design the system, and hands-on enough to make it work.

Bonus points for:

  • Technical Market Experience: Marketing cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, developer tools or AI infrastructure to platform engineers, infrastructure leaders and technical buying committees.

  • Open Source & PLG Motions: Familiarity with open-source, community-driven or product-led growth running alongside enterprise sales.

  • Modern GTM Stack: Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Common Room and AI-enabled GTM tools.

  • Scale-Up Experience: Scaling a marketing org through rapid ARR growth, including global field and ABM programs across North America and EMEA.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: £125K - £145K

raw.title: AI Phone - Security & Privacy Engineer
raw.excerpt: AboutWe are reimagining the phone.  AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost.
raw.description:
About

We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence.

There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Focus: Designing and implementing the security and privacy architecture for the AI-native phone, ensuring AI agents can safely access user data, interact with applications, and execute actions across the operating system.

Unlike conventional mobile application security, this role needs to consider the additional risks introduced by AI agents having access to personal context, system services, and application-level actions.

Responsibilities

  • Design the overall security and privacy architecture for the AI-native phone.

  • Define permission models and access boundaries for AI agents interacting with user data and system services.

  • Design secure mechanisms for AI access to messages, contacts, calendars, notifications, camera, microphone, location and other sensitive information.

  • Implement appropriate sandboxing and isolation for agent execution.

  • Define authentication, authorization and access-control mechanisms for AI tools and application integrations.

  • Ensure users have control over what information AI can access and what actions it can execute.

  • Implement audit logging and user-visible activity tracking for AI access and actions.

  • Design secure storage, encryption, data retention and deletion mechanisms for personal data and memory.

  • Identify and mitigate AI-specific security risks, including prompt injection, malicious applications, data exfiltration and unauthorized tool execution.

  • Review Android permission models, privileged system access, SELinux policies and system-level security boundaries.

  • Work closely with Android/AOSP, Agent Runtime, Context & Memory and Applied ML teams to ensure security is built into the architecture rather than added later.

  • Conduct security assessments, threat modeling and penetration testing for system-level AI capabilities.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in mobile security, Android security, application security or systems security.

  • Deep understanding of Android security architecture, including application sandboxing, permissions, SELinux, Binder IPC and privileged system services.

  • Experience designing authentication, authorization and access-control systems.

  • Strong understanding of encryption, secure storage, key management and data protection.

  • Experience with security threat modeling, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.

  • Understanding of privacy-by-design principles, data minimization and user consent.

  • Ability to work across Android platform, backend and AI agent architectures.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AOSP security customization or Android platform security.

  • Experience securing system-level applications or privileged Android services.

  • Experience with AI agent security, prompt injection, tool-use security and LLM data leakage.

  • Experience with mobile device security, Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), hardware-backed keystores and secure boot.

  • Experience with privacy engineering for products handling sensitive personal information.

  • Experience building permission and approval systems for autonomous agents.

raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 1+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

raw.description:
About the Role

Join a lean team at an early-stage biotech company developing AI tools for peptide and protein design. You will connect computational design, experimental validation, and platform operations, closing the loop from sequence generation to kinetics data and model improvements.

What You'll Do

  • Improve discrete diffusion and folding models for peptide and protein design, including model architecture and reasoning capabilities.

  • Operate an inference platform at scale and analyze usage patterns, including signups, churn, and customer segments.

  • Write, debug, and maintain production protocols for liquid-handling robots and plate automation.

  • Design and run BLI and SPR assays, fit kinetic curves, perform quality control, and diagnose assay failure modes.

  • Manage screening instruments and write precise protocols for external laboratory partners.

  • Use receptor biology, structure, and scoring to evaluate designs and make platform outputs useful to scientists.

  • Iterate on designed sequences using experimental kinetics data to improve models and subsequent designs.

What We're Looking For

  • Typically 3 to 11 years of relevant experience, including hands-on wet-lab work and experience across biology, bioinformatics, and machine learning.

  • Experience building or operating protein or biological models, such as discrete diffusion models, protein language models, or structure prediction systems, in a design-make-test workflow.

  • Practical experience with tools such as ESM or ProtT5 and sequence design methods such as RFdiffusion or BindCraft.

  • Hands-on proficiency writing and debugging methods for Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons, or equivalent liquid-handling platforms.

  • Experience independently designing BLI or SPR assays, fitting kinetic curves, extracting binding parameters, and diagnosing assay artifacts.

  • Python or equivalent scripting skills for automation and kinetic data analysis, plus an understanding of protein structure, receptor biology, and scoring.

  • Ability to troubleshoot instruments and protocols quickly, operate inference systems or refine model architectures, and explain scientific workflows clearly.

  • Experience in biotech or scientific software customer-facing roles, including user conversion, customer success, or solutions engineering, is relevant. Familiarity with scientific platform usage and customer buying processes is also valuable.

Compensation & Benefits

Full-time base salary is $80,000 to $200,000 annually, depending on experience, with equity and deal-contingent upside. A consulting engagement may be available at $3,000 to $5,000 per month. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid in New York, with increased on-site presence expected as internal screening operations are established.

About us:

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why we’re hiring:

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.

As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This program exists to close that gap. We are looking for 2-3 Product Managers-in-Training to work directly with, and be mentored by, our Cofounder/CEO (2x YC founder), and work on building or scaling one of our new product verticals.

Reporting directly to our CEO, you will have a unique opportunity to develop the craft of product building, learn how a serial founder/CEO thinks and makes decisions, and see/understand a late stage tech startup’s day-to-day challenges as it goes through a rapid growth phase. You will be exposed to nearly every function at the company (i.e., product, growth, operations, finance, engineering, data), learn how to execute big-picture strategies and navigate the intricacies of a complex business.

A successful graduate will likely go on to become a product leader or commercial leader (e.g. owning P&L) here or elsewhere. If you’re looking for an opportunity to greatly accelerate your career trajectory, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home or the office, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

About the Role

As the founding computer vision engineer at an early-stage internet marketplace, you will set the technical direction for identifying and valuing items from images. You will build production models that distinguish closely related items and communicate uncertainty clearly, helping users make decisions with confidence.

What You'll Do

  • Design and own computer vision architecture for fine-grained identification, adapting foundation vision models to a specific catalog.

  • Define accuracy standards by category and build calibrated confidence scores so the product can express uncertainty rather than guess.

  • Work with labeling partners to turn model errors into priorities for future data collection.

  • Balance expansion into new categories with improving accuracy in existing ones.

  • Own the path from model research to production serving, including latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Explain the model's capabilities and limitations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years of applied computer vision experience, including production systems shipped at meaningful scale.

  • Industry experience with image or item identification, object recognition, or detection, including fine-grained or instance-level classification where similar items must be distinguished accurately.

  • Hands-on production experience fine-tuning and deploying vision transformers or CNNs with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Experience adapting foundation vision models, building evaluation frameworks beyond loss metrics, and developing calibrated confidence scoring.

  • Experience owning production model serving decisions, including latency, cost, and reliability; familiarity with low-latency APIs is useful.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to lead technical decisions on an open-ended problem.

  • Experience with active learning, human-in-the-loop labeling, visual search, marketplaces, or an early-stage startup is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $200,000 to $260,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid, based in New York, New York, United States.
