At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix’s Infrastructure Engineering organization provides the backbone that powers Netflix's global scale and operations across business verticals. Within this organization, Data, AI & Experimentation Platforms accelerate product velocity and business impact by providing cohesive, reliable foundations for data, analytics, machine learning, and experimentation. We reduce friction across the insight-to-production loop so teams can move from questions to decisions and from prototypes to shipped features quickly, with confidence, and with measurable outcomes.

We enable teams to build and scale ML-powered products end-to-end with AI platform capabilities for training, model management, evaluation, observability, developer tooling, and production inference. Our experimentation platform makes it easy to design, launch, monitor, and interpret experiments so teams can iterate faster and validate impact with statistical rigor and accountability.

Our data and analytics foundations make information usable and trustworthy: streamlined data movement (ingestion, streaming, processing), standardized online data stores for real-time serving, and analytics experiences that accelerate discovery while enforcing consistent metrics, quality, lineage, ownership, and access controls. Ultimately, we make data- and AI-driven product development faster, safer, and more dependable at scale so teams can focus on building great experiences that entertain the world.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly technical Product Manager to lead Data Developer & Analytics Experiences within the Analytics Platform & Experiences team.

Your primary mission is to deliver a unified, AI-native experience that spans how practitioners build data assets, build and operate data agents, and orchestrate data workflows at scale. On the Data Developer side, you will own the practitioner “inner loop”; SQL and Python-first code authoring in AI-native IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code, JupyterLab), Python libraries, lifecycle and CLI tooling, data quality tooling, and the developer experience for building data agents that can securely discover, query, and act on data. On the Workflow Orchestration side, you will own the end-to-end experience for defining, scheduling, executing, monitoring, and operating data workflows, including dependency management, backfills, retries, and workflow observability—making it easy for practitioners to reliably move data pipelines and agents from development to production.

Analytics engineers, data engineers, and data scientists will be your primary customers, with a focus on making it easier for them to build data assets, orchestrate reliable workflows, and develop data agents. Partnering closely with engineering, design, and data leaders, you will shape product direction and deliver impactful capabilities across developer productivity, workflow orchestration, data quality and observability, and AI-native development.

In this role, you will shape the future of Data Developer Experiences and Workflow Orchestration at Netflix by leading a high-impact product portfolio. You will operate with significant autonomy to set strategic direction, define multi-year roadmaps, and make high-leverage tradeoffs across developer productivity, workflow orchestration, reliability and observability, data quality, and AI-native development—including how practitioners build and operate data agents.

What makes this role exciting is the blend of strategic vision and hands-on leadership. You'll maintain a broad portfolio view while selectively diving deep where your expertise makes the biggest difference. Your success will be measured by enabling Netflix's growth, innovation, and competitive advantage, while delighting users with exceptional experiences that empower teams to work more efficiently and with greater satisfaction.

What You Will Do

As the Product Manager forAnalytics Experiences, you will have the following responsibilities:

  • Set Direction: Develop a compelling long-term vision and strategy for your portfolio, aligning user needs with business objectives and industry trends for the Analytics Experiences.

  • Champion Users: Build deep user understanding and empathy through regular engagement, research, and feedback loops to identify pain points and opportunities.

  • Manage Roadmap: Develop and prioritize initiatives across the portfolio, from IDE-centric inner-loop productivity to centralize Semantic layer and conversational analytics, balancing immediate needs with strategic evolution.

  • Guide Development: Partner with design and engineering to define requirements, create intuitive interfaces, and validate solutions that ensure cohesive user journeys across the platform ecosystem.

  • Support Architecture: Partner with engineering on critical architecture decisions that ensure platform sustainability, scalability, and flexibility while strategically managing technical debt.

  • Drive Adoption: Create effective rollout strategies and promote new capabilities through targeted communication, education, and roadshows, while providing comprehensive documentation, learning resources, and self-service tools that accelerate adoption and reduce support burden.

  • Drive Improvement: Define success metrics centered on user delight and productivity gains, and implement tracking to continuously improve platform capabilities through data-informed experiments.

  • Establish Governance: Develop platform standards and processes that balance flexibility with standardization and innovation with stability to maintain quality and consistency, including API design guidelines, versioning policies, and deprecation protocols.

  • Align Stakeholders: Build strategic relationships and foster cross-functional collaboration to drive alignment and create shared ownership of outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

We value candidates who can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, technical depth with user empathy, and decisive leadership with collaborative partnership. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, can navigate complex technical and organizational landscapes, and ultimately delivers significant impact for your users and Netflix as a whole.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following attributes and experiences:

Technical Excellence

  • Expertise: 8+ years of Technical Product Management experience (or equivalent technical role) in complex technical domains. Comfortable discussing technical design trade-offs and system quality attributes with engineering teams.

  • Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of modern analytics architectures and data developer tooling — including dbt-based transformation workflows, workflow orchestration and scheduling, and deep familiarity with the practitioner stack: IDEs and notebooks (Cursor, JupyterLab, VS Code), Python/SQL developer tooling, interactive compute environments, and data quality/observability frameworks.

  • Curiosity: Demonstrated passion for Analytics with a pulse on emerging trends. Actively seeks new perspectives and brings fresh thinking to technical challenges. Regularly uses products and observes customers to identify improvement opportunities.

Product Leadership

  • Strategic Vision: Proven track record of managing product portfolios in complex technical domains with clear vision and strategy to maximize portfolio impact. Skilled at connecting business objectives with user needs, balancing quick wins with strategic bets, and making thoughtful trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession: Deeply understands user needs through continuous engagement. Exceptional at identifying and articulating clear problem statements. Develops innovative solutions with strong product intuition and taste, thinking holistically about end-to-end user experience.

  • Business Acumen: Understands how platform investments drive business outcomes. Articulates the ROI of technical investments in business terms and connects platform capabilities to Netflix's strategic priorities. Balances technical excellence with business pragmatism.

  • Data Driven: Deeply analytical mindset that leverages quantitative and qualitative data to understand user behavior, validate assumptions, and inform product decisions. Builds a metrics-driven culture with clear success metrics to measure impact and drive continuous improvement.

  • Decisive Leadership: Makes timely decisions that provide clear direction and reduce ambiguity without analysis paralysis. Shows conviction in product opinions while remaining open to new information. Removes decision bottlenecks and shields teams from unnecessary scope creep.

Collaboration & Influence

  • First Team Player: Creates psychological safety through vulnerability and assuming best intent. Values diverse perspectives and operates with a collaborative mindset where team success trumps individual accomplishments. Skilled at giving and receiving feedback with a growth mindset.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Builds strong relationships across organizational boundaries based on mutual respect and shared goals. Navigates complex organizational dynamics to drive alignment. Adapts communication style to different audiences and contexts to maximize effectiveness.

  • Influential Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and inspire. Great at rallying teams around a vision and motivating others to action.

Execution Excellence

  • Delivery Focus: Builds reputation through consistent, high-quality delivery. Disciplined prioritization with clear timelines and accountability. Drives initiatives to completion rather than letting them linger. Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and adjusting course as needed.

  • Learning Mindset: Champions incremental learning and fast feedback loops with customers. Values progress over perfection and breaks down large initiatives into manageable increments that deliver value at each stage. Adapts quickly based on real-world user feedback.

About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Product Designer at Abridge, you won’t just be designing software. You’ll be redesigning the future of healthcare delivery. You’ll create experiences that give clinicians back time, reduce cognitive load, and enable doctors to give their patients undivided attention again.

Healthcare is broken in ways most people don’t see. Clinicians spend much of their time on administrative tasks, contributing to unprecedented burnout and compromised patient care. The current state of clinical documentation forces doctors to choose between looking at their patients and looking at their computers.

We’re hiring product designers with a range of experience levels, strengths, and areas of expertise. Your scope will reflect what you bring to the team, but every designer at Abridge is expected to take meaningful ownership, navigate ambiguity, and help raise the quality of our products and practice.

This role is for someone who dreams big and can reimagine experiences. You’ll work on problems that have never been solved before, in an industry where design decisions directly affect human lives and well-being.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Designer, you’ll shape the product experience at Abridge, setting a high bar for taste, clarity, and strategic thinking across initiatives that directly impact clinicians, patients, and care teams.

You’ll collaborate deeply with cross-functional partners, immerse yourself in the complexity of clinical workflows, and bring structure and empathy to ambiguous problems. Whether you’re exploring new ideas or refining existing experiences, you’ll advocate for design excellence throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Simplify the Complex: Tackle challenging and ambiguous design and customer problems, transforming complex clinical workflows and AI capabilities into intuitive, thoughtful, and delightful experiences.

  • Elevate Our Craft and Standards: Push the boundaries of visual and interaction design. Bring a strong command of design principles, motion, and prototyping; contribute to our evolving design standards; and ensure every detail and interaction is carefully considered.

  • Own End-to-End Design Execution: Design for today’s needs and tomorrow’s challenges, translating early ideas into clear product direction, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, and user flows. No task is too small or too large when it contributes to building an exceptional product.

  • Champion User-Centered Design: Advocate passionately for the clinicians and care teams who rely on our product every day. Engage in user research, synthesize insights, and ground design decisions in a deep understanding of users’ needs and pain points.

  • Lead Through Collaboration: Build strong partnerships across design, product, engineering, research, and other disciplines. Communicate clearly, invite feedback, and help teams make thoughtful decisions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical realities.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience shipping impactful digital products, ideally within complex domains. Experience with AI-powered products is a plus.

  • A strong track record of taking meaningful design initiatives from concept through launch and demonstrating an impact on users and the business.

  • The ability to bring clarity and momentum to ambiguous problems, adapting your approach and level of ownership to the needs of the work.

  • A high craft bar that you consistently meet and help others elevate. You care deeply about the details while maintaining sight of the larger product experience.

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale and influence partners across functions.

  • A highly collaborative spirit and low ego, along with a genuine desire to learn, teach, give and receive feedback, and grow with a fast-paced, high-performing team.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

  • AI or machine-learning products

  • Consumer mobile products

  • Enterprise products

We value people who are eager to learn new things and recognize that great team members might not perfectly match a job description. If you’re interested in the role but aren’t sure whether or not you’re a good fit, we’d still like to hear from you.

Must be willing to work from our SF or NYC office at least 3x per week

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of coming into the office a minimum of (3) three times per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates willing to move to San Francisco or New York.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Every customer comes to us looking for a better, easier way to handle their insurance. As a Remote Sales Agent, your mission is to deliver an exceptional, consultative experience that turns initial interest into long-term customer trust, matching each individual with the ideal coverage from Jerry’s panel of 55+ carrier partners.

  • A top performer: You have 2+ years of experience in sales, consultative account management, or high-touch service environments.

  • Navigate friction thoughtfully: Listen to customer hesitation with empathy, addressing concerns directly to ensure a smooth, transparent purchasing experience.

  • Remote-first: Work from home with all equipment provided, supported by ongoing training and active team mentorship.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Lead – Supply Chain Resources

Company: Lux Decor Collection
Department: Supply Chain & Operations
Position: Lead – Supply Chain Resources
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Head of Operations / Senior Management

About Lux Decor Collection

Lux Decor Collection is a growing multi-channel e-commerce company operating across leading global marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Temu, eBay, and SHEIN. We specialize in offering a diverse range of products across various categories, including home décor, textiles, kitchen essentials, apparel, and lifestyle products.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Lead – Supply Chain Resources to oversee and optimize our end-to-end supply chain operations, ensuring product availability, cost efficiency, timely procurement, and seamless inventory movement across multiple sales channels.

Job Summary

The Lead – Supply Chain Resources will be responsible for managing the complete supply chain lifecycle, including demand planning, inventory management, sourcing, procurement, supplier coordination, logistics, and fulfillment.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical, leadership, negotiation, and operational management skills, with hands-on experience in managing supply chain operations for an e-commerce, retail, or consumer products business.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Strategy & Planning

Develop and implement effective supply chain strategies aligned with business objectives and marketplace growth.

Oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, from product sourcing and procurement to warehouse delivery and fulfillment.

Identify operational bottlenecks and implement strategies to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance productivity.

Ensure smooth coordination between supply chain, marketplace, warehouse, finance, and operations teams.

Demand Forecasting & Inventory Management

Analyze historical sales data, marketplace trends, seasonality, and promotional activities to forecast product demand.

Maintain optimal inventory levels across warehouses and fulfillment centers.

Develop replenishment plans to prevent stockouts, overstocking, and excess inventory.

Monitor inventory turnover, aging stock, sell-through rates, and stock availability.

Coordinate inventory planning for Amazon FBA, Walmart Marketplace, TikTok Shop, Temu, eBay, and SHEIN.

Logistics & Fulfillment Management

Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, freight forwarding, shipment tracking, and warehouse coordination.

Coordinate with freight forwarders, shipping companies, customs brokers, 3PL providers, and fulfillment centers.

Ensure timely delivery of inventory to Amazon FBA, Walmart fulfillment centers, and other relevant distribution channels.

Monitor shipping costs, lead times, and logistics performance.

Proactively resolve shipment delays, inventory discrepancies, and supply chain disruptions.

Cost Optimization & Operational Efficiency

Identify opportunities to reduce procurement, transportation, warehousing, and fulfillment costs.

Optimize landed cost per unit while maintaining product quality and supply reliability.

Develop and implement SOPs for procurement, inventory management, logistics, and supply chain operations.

Continuously improve supply chain processes through data-driven decision-making.

Team Leadership & Coordination

Lead, supervise, and develop the supply chain team to achieve operational targets.

Assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure timely completion of tasks.

Establish clear KPIs and performance standards for team members.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between inventory availability, marketplace sales, and business objectives.

7. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

Prepare regular supply chain reports, dashboards, and management updates.

Monitor key performance indicators, including:

Inventory Turnover Ratio

Demand Forecast Accuracy

Stockout Rate

Supplier On-Time Delivery Rate

Procurement Cost Savings

Inventory Aging

Purchase Order Cycle Time

Logistics Cost per Unit

Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Operations Management, or a related field.

Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, inventory management, or logistics.

At least 1–2 years of experience in a team lead or supervisory role.

Proven experience in e-commerce, retail, consumer products, or multi-channel marketplace operations.

Strong understanding of demand forecasting, inventory planning, procurement, supplier management, and logistics.

Experience with Amazon FBA and Walmart Marketplace supply chain operations is highly preferred.

Familiarity with TikTok Shop, Temu, eBay, and SHEIN fulfillment requirements will be an added advantage.

Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets; experience with ERP, WMS, or inventory management systems is preferred.

raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're looking for the top 1% - engineers who treat their craft like athletes treat performance, and who want to work alongside people who do the same. The world has changed dramatically in the last quarter. What used to take a team of consultants six months now takes a sharp engineer a few days. The momentum is unreal, and we're growing into it fast.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're embedded directly in our customers' environments, taking a messy enterprise problem from first conversation to a working production system in days - not quarters. You work as part of a small senior team - alongside a Senior Consultant and other FDEs - and you own the technical solution end-to-end: architecture, integrations, agent and workflow logic, frontend where needed, evals, deployment. The work starts and ends with the customer, not the codebase. Feedback cycles are measured in hours, the bar is high, and the people you ship with will push you to raise it.

What you'll do

  • Sit with end-users, process owners, and client engineers to understand the real workflow - and the real problem underneath the stated one

  • Translate the target-state process into a concrete technical solution: architecture, data model, integrations, agent and workflow design - and ship it in days and weeks, not quarters

  • Demo early and often, rough edges included, and fold real feedback into the next iteration

  • Make speed / quality / cost trade-offs in real time. Choose build vs. buy vs. configure existing platform capability

  • Own observability and evals once live. Iterate until the system is reliable in the customer's real conditions

  • Earn trust with the client's own engineering and security teams - API access, data flows, deployment, reviews

  • Bring patterns back - reusable components, prompt structures, integration approaches - so the next engagement ships faster

What you'll bring

  • Builder background with real shipping experience - you've taken systems from zero to production and kept them running

  • Fluent with modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, agent frameworks, evals, prompt engineering as a real discipline

  • Strong with TypeScript on the backend. Comfortable with APIs, auth, queues, and integrating with legacy systems

  • Daily, fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor, or similar - expected to ship meaningfully faster than a traditional engineer because of them

  • Customer-facing instinct - you genuinely enjoy being in the room with users, asking sharp questions, and pushing back respectfully when needed

  • You move fast, communicate clearly, and operate well with ambiguity. Comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar domain and coming back with a working prototype

  • Fluency in English. German is a plus

  • MUST: experience automating business processes in the ERP space (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar), or prior background in consulting, solutions engineering, or founding/building products end-to-end

What you'll get

  • Ship in days, not quarters. Watch a messy enterprise problem become a working production system inside a single engagement.

  • Work at the frontier. We use and build with state-of-the-art tech, the latest LLMs, agent frameworks, and AI coding tools, with the budget and mandate to keep up as the field moves.

  • Build with the best tools. No legacy stack to drag around.

  • Big responsibility, fast. You own customer engagements end-to-end from day one: architecture, build, delivery, and the relationship.

  • A team that raises the bar. You're working alongside other FDEs and senior consultants who were hired for exactly this pace.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

raw.description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and scaled revenue 70X. We’re now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

What You’ll Own

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back. And over your first year or two, as our newer products scale and the audience for our numbers widens beyond the people who already know the business, the reporting itself has to reach a standard that holds up to outside diligence.

Own the operating model and forecast cycle:

  • Own Jerry’s driver-based operating model for the base business and expand it as we launch new insurance products and business lines.

  • Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

  • Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

  • Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

  • Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

Build the financial case for new opportunities

  • Build the financial model for new product, vertical, channel or partnership: Size the market, model the economics, evaluate capital commitment and return profile.

  • Read results back against the case: Once something is live, compare the actual economics to what we underwrote and carry the lesson into the next decision. Monitor product and channel economics including CAC and payback, policy retention and lifetime value, contribution margin etc.

  • Support corporate development: Capital markets and investor workstreams through diligence, modeling, and transaction analysis as the need arises.

  • Frame build, buy or partner decisions: help refine the frameworks we use to compare the options and the return profile of each.

Underwrite vendor spend:

  • Build the business case before a commitment is made, support negotiation on terms, and give budget owners the visibility to manage their own numbers.

Who You Are

  • Accurate under deadline: Your numbers are right the first time, and they stay right when the deadline compresses. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

  • Picks the right question: No one hands you the workstream. You decide which analysis will actually change a decision, and leave the rest alone.

  • Direct communicator: You form a view, communicate it directly, and revise it when the evidence changes.

  • Executive-ready output: What you produce can go in front of the founders or the board without a rewrite — clear, precise, and honest about what the numbers do and do not show.

  • Owner: You take ownership of outcomes and are comfortable building process where none exists yet.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally combining 2+ years at a reputable investment bank, corporate development group, or private equity firm with 2+ years in strategic finance or FP&A at a high-growth company.

  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a similarly quantitative field.

  • Strong financial modeling skills: driver-based operating models, three-statement mechanics, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and a working command of accounting concepts and GAAP.

  • Experience with unit economics in a consumer or marketplace business, including CAC, LTV, payback, cohort retention, and contribution margin.

  • A track record of translating complex analysis into a clear narrative for an executive or investor audience.

  • Startup or high-growth experience strongly preferred, including building financial processes from scratch.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools for analysis, research, and workflow automation.

Nice to have:

  • Insurance, insurtech, fintech, or marketplace experience;

  • CFA certification;

  • vendor negotiation or procurement exposure;

  • finance tech stack experience (NetSuite, Ramp, planning tools).

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Our Business Operations & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

  • Growth Marketing

  • Product Development

  • Strategic Partnerships

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • No corporate fluff: The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

  • Define the right problems: Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

  • Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

  • Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Who You Are

  • First principles thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

What You'll Bring

  • 1+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our Tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Solution Design and Prototyping
  • Map workflows end to end with process owners and decide where AI, conventional automation, or a process change is the right answer.

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. About this role

We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth.

We’re looking for 2-3 Product Managers to drive progress across one of our key new product bets, including motorcycle insurance (just launched), home insurance (also just launched), new insurance products for other assets like boat and RV (concept phase), as well as non-insurance products to make car and home ownership easier such as helping customers save money on their property taxes (about to launch).

Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational complexity, its own customer personas and painpoints, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to take ownership of one of these new bets.

We leverage market-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce.

About the Role

Propelus serves clinicians, licensing boards, and healthcare organizations that rely on accurate licensure and continuing education information. The rules behind that work keep changing across states, agencies, and professional boards.

As External Affairs Manager, you’ll help Propelus stay ahead of those changes. You’ll work independently to track legislative and regulatory developments, manage relationships with key healthcare stakeholders, and keep the External Affairs function organized and running smoothly.

What You’ll Do

Policy & Regulatory Intelligence

  • Track legislation, rulemaking, board actions, licensure compacts, and CE requirements across priority states and national bodies.

  • Spot developments that affect Propelus, its customers, or its market, and share them with the right teams.

  • Turn complex policy into clear summaries, briefings, and talking points.

  • Keep legislative calendars, deadlines, and implementation dates current.

  • Coordinate with contract lobbyists and manage their agreements, deliverables, and lobbying compliance filings.

State Association Partnerships & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build relationships with state healthcare associations, workforce centers, educational institutions, and professional organizations.

  • Coordinate Propelus’s participation in coalitions, task forces, conferences, and other forums.

  • Keep relationship records up to date (contacts, notes, commitments) and make sure follow-ups happen.

  • Prepare the VP for external meetings with research, briefing materials, and logistics.

Operations

  • Lead the day-to-day rhythm of External Affairs: priorities, timelines, meetings, events, and deliverables.

  • Build repeatable processes, templates, and systems (HubSpot, Quorum) that help the function grow.

  • Identify gaps, risks, and decisions that need to be brought to the attention of the VP early.

  • Support special projects, including RFPs, events, partner needs, and internal communications.

About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities.

Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a Vice President, Market Expansion & Patient Engagement to lead two of our most important growth priorities: launching new markets and connecting attributed members to care.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end process of bringing new payer markets into operation—from contract execution through go-live and early market performance. You will also lead the enterprise strategy and execution infrastructure that converts attributed members into active patient relationships.

You will build and continuously improve our market launch toolkit, ensuring each new market benefits from a repeatable, reliable operating approach. As the leader of patient engagement strategy, you will guide the development of playbooks, outreach capabilities across channels, and field enablement tools that support member activation and care conversion at scale.

This role requires a leader who can set enterprise strategy while staying close to execution, build teams, and drive accountability across cross-functional partners. This is a remote position reporting to the SVP, Operations.

Key Responsibilities

Market Implementation & Launch

  • Own the strategy and execution of a repeatable market launch operating system, improving the approach with each new market.

  • Lead the 90-day market sprint from contract execution through the first patient visit and early market performance.

  • Translate executed payer contracts into operational requirements, workflow triggers, and readiness checklists so teams understand their responsibilities before go-live.

  • Lead pre-launch readiness assessments across Clinical, Operations, HR, Training, Technology, and Compliance.

  • Own operational sign-off on launch timing during contracting, certify readiness, and escalate recommended launch delays to the SVP, Operations when appropriate.

  • Drive staffing and credentialing timelines for each new market and serve as the internal escalation point when timelines are at risk.

  • Coordinate launch activities across Growth, Legal/Compliance, Clinical, Operations, HR, and Technology to manage dependencies and support timely execution.

  • Establish the strategy and governance for implementation tracking, including timelines, milestones, and status reporting from contract execution through go-live.

Patient Engagement & Member Activation

  • Own the enterprise strategy and execution infrastructure that connects attributed members to active patient relationships.

  • Lead the strategic development of patient engagement playbooks, outreach capabilities across channels, and tools that enable field teams.

  • Build scalable approaches that support member activation and conversion into care.

  • Coordinate with payer teams to support accurate patient attribution and enrollment.

  • Oversee attribution reconciliation to identify gaps, improve accuracy, and coordinate corrections.

Operational Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Build alignment and accountability across teams responsible for market readiness and patient engagement.

  • Identify implementation gaps, lead root-cause analyses, and translate findings into lasting operational improvements.

  • Maintain and improve launch playbooks and standard operating procedures.

  • Balance enterprise planning with hands-on execution to support reliable launches and early market performance.

Qualifications

  • Experience leading market expansion, implementation, or operational launch initiatives within healthcare.

  • Deep understanding of value-based care and payer operations.

  • Experience translating payer contract requirements into operational workflows and launch plans.

  • A track record of scaling patient or member engagement functions.

  • Experience developing operational playbooks, governance processes, and tools that support consistent execution.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive accountability across teams with different reporting relationships.

  • Experience coordinating staffing, credentialing, compliance, technology, and operational readiness.

  • Strong strategic planning, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain closely involved in execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • New markets launch through a consistent, repeatable process with clear ownership and readiness standards.

  • Payer contract requirements are translated into actionable plans before go-live.

raw.title: Product Quality Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Menlo Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it.
raw.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
Asimov gets built at scale on someone else's line. As Product Quality Engineer, you are Menlo's quality owner at our contract manufacturer, responsible for the final assembly and test of the robot from the first trial build through mass production. You make sure what comes off the CM line matches what our engineers designed, every unit, at rate.
You will own process yield, define and enforce final inspection criteria, and run the customer side of quality at the EMS partner. You will live in the phase gates, EVT, DVT, PVT, and into MP, catching the defects, drift, and process gaps that decide whether a ramp succeeds or stalls. This role sits between our design teams and the factory floor, and holds both to the standard.

What You'll Do

  • Own final assembly and test quality at the CM (Tier-1 / EMS), from trial production through mass production

  • Drive process yield: monitor first-pass yield and defect rates at each station, run the analysis, and lead the CM to close the gaps

  • Define, document, and maintain final inspection criteria, including inspection standards, limit samples, workmanship standards, and pass/fail criteria for the line

  • Own the customer inspection and acceptance process: OQC, outgoing quality gates, AQL sampling plans, and lot disposition before shipment

  • Represent Menlo through the NPI phase gates (EVT, DVT, PVT), driving build readiness, defining test coverage at final assembly and test, and signing off on quality exit criteria for each phase

  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective action on line failures and test escapes, using structured methods such as 8D, fishbone, and 5-whys, and verify the fix holds

  • Set up and audit the CM's process controls: FAI, in-process inspection, SPC on critical parameters, and change control on the line

  • Manage non-conformance at the CM: MRB, containment, rework and sorting decisions, and disposition of held material

  • Track and report quality metrics (yield, DPPM, defect Pareto, RTY) and drive continuous improvement reviews with the CM

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and manufacturing engineering to feed field and line failures back into design and process

What We Look For

  • 3 or more years in a product, supplier, or manufacturing quality role owning final assembly and test at a contract manufacturer or EMS partner

  • Direct experience taking a product through NPI phase gates (EVT / DVT / PVT) and into mass production

  • Strong command of yield analysis and defect reduction, and the discipline to chase a failure to its real source rather than its symptom

  • Hands-on ownership of final inspection and outgoing quality: inspection criteria, AQL sampling, limit samples, and lot acceptance

  • Fluency in core quality tools and methods: 8D, FMEA, SPC, control plans, FAI, and MRB / non-conformance handling

  • Comfort reading mechanical drawings and GD&T, electrical schematics, and test specs across a complex electromechanical product

  • Strong communication and influence skills to hold a CM accountable while keeping the ramp moving, working across engineering, manufacturing, and the supplier

  • Willingness to travel to and work on-site at manufacturing partners

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or other high-reliability electromechanical products

  • Experience managing quality at CMs in the region (for example Vietnam, China, or elsewhere in Asia)

  • Familiarity with quality systems and standards such as ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, and IPC-A-610

  • Motor, actuator, or drivetrain assembly and test quality experience

  • Experience defining final assembly and test (FATP) test coverage and station-level test strategy

  • Scripting for quality data analysis and automation, for example Python or SQL

  • Experience standing up CM quality processes from near-zero at an early-stage hardware company

Why Join Menlo
You will own the quality of a humanoid robot as it moves from a handful of hand-built prototypes to real production volume, the phase where most hardware companies either learn to ship or quietly stall. You will define the inspection standards and yield discipline for a product that has to move in the real world, not pass a bench check, and you will hold both our engineers and our factory to them. On a small team, your sign-off is what stands between a design and a shippable robot.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
ELESSAR SYSTEMS INC.

Training. Left of Launch.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Q2 Holodeck™ Sales Executive

Join a talented founding team and help put an AI-enabled defense training platform into the hands of the people protecting our communities and critical infrastructure.

Position Summary

Elessar is hiring two ambitious Sales Executives to help bring Q2 Holodeck™ to government, defense, public-safety, sports, critical-infrastructure, and commercial customers. This is a hands-on sales role for someone who wants more than a narrow territory and a scripted pitch. You will learn a new and sophisticated product, build relationships with buyers, create opportunities, support live demonstrations, shape pilots, and help close the company’s first generation of customers.

You will join a small, talented team of technologists, operators, trainers, and business builders. Success will be visible. Your work will directly influence Elessar’s revenue, customer strategy, product roadmap, and growth. The role is designed for a high-energy early-career seller who is coachable, persistent, organized, comfortable opening doors, and excited by the opportunity to grow with an emerging defense technology company.

About Elessar and Q2 Holodeck™

Elessar is a defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, a browser-based, AI/ML-driven, scenario-based training and decision-rehearsal platform. Q2 Holodeck™ helps security, force-protection, and first-responder personnel identify a drone, select a lawful and effective response, and report the incident before a real event occurs. The platform is built to support practical readiness across defense, homeland security, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and allied markets.

Our immediate commercial objective is straightforward: identify customers with urgent operational problems, demonstrate the platform, launch well-designed pilots, prove value, and convert successful pilots into annual subscriptions and larger deployments. The Sales Executive will be at the center of that effort.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

  • You will sell a differentiated product addressing a timely challenge in c-UAS preparedness that is ubiquitous and also engage in national-security and public-safety challenges.
  • You will work directly with senior leaders, technical experts, operators, and customers rather than being buried in a large sales organization.
  • You will have room to build a network, shape the sales playbook, and earn responsibility quickly.
  • Your compensation has meaningful upside: reaching the individual $1.5 million Year 1 sales goal produces target cash earnings of $135,000.
  • You will be part of the team building Elessar from early commercialization into a scalable recurring-revenue company.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (approximate % of time)

  • Prospecting and Opportunity Creation (30%). Build and maintain a disciplined list of named accounts; research buyers and funded entry points; conduct outbound outreach; use events, referrals, partners, and digital channels to secure qualified meetings.
  • Customer Engagement and Discovery (20%). Lead early conversations, uncover operational problems, identify buying authority and funding, qualify timing and fit, and translate customer priorities into a clear next step.
  • Demonstrations, Pilots, and Proposals (20%). Coordinate with technical and training teammates to prepare compelling demonstrations; help define pilot users, scenarios, success measures, pricing, conversion terms, and proposal content.
  • Pipeline and Sales Execution (15%). Maintain accurate CRM records, next actions, close dates, probability, and forecast; follow up consistently; advance opportunities through a defined sales process; and surface blockers early.
  • Closing and Expansion (10%). Help negotiate and close qualifying sales, then work with customer success to position renewals, additional seats, new scenarios, and enterprise expansion.
  • Market Learning and Team Contribution (5%). Share customer insight, competitive information, objections, and product feedback; improve messaging and sales tools; and contribute energy, ideas, and accountability to the founding team.

Key Performance Objectives

OBJECTIVE, HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED, & HORIZON

Ramp and product fluency

Deliver a credible Q2 Holodeck™ pitch and demonstration narrative; understand target users, buyer problems, pilot offer, pricing, and key objections.

Months 1

Qualified pipeline

Build a named-account pipeline with documented customer need, buyer, funding path, next action, and realistic timing.

Months 1-3

Meetings and demonstrations

Consistently create qualified customer conversations and progress appropriate prospects to demonstrations or pilot design.

Ongoing

First sales

Close early Q2 Holodeck™ customers and establish references that support follow-on growth.

Months 3-12

Year 1 sales goal

$1.5 million in qualifying individual sales under the company commission plan.

Year 1

Sales discipline

Maintain current CRM data, reliable forecasts, rapid follow-up, and clear ownership of every next step.

Ongoing

Qualifications

Required

  • High school and/or bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of software sales, education, training, military service, or relevant professional experience.
  • One to five years of sales, business development, recruiting, customer success, fundraising, account management, or another results-driven customer-facing role. Exceptional recent graduates with strong evidence of initiative and persuasion will be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to start conversations, build relationships, ask thoughtful questions, handle rejection, and follow through.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, organization, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Comfort learning technical and operational concepts and explaining them in straightforward customer language.
  • U.S. citizenship and willingness to complete any customer-required background or security process.
  • Ability to travel for customer meetings, demonstrations, exercises, and events.

Preferred

  • Experience or interest in defense technology, drones, counter-UAS, homeland security, emergency management, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, training, simulation, AI, or SaaS.
  • Experience selling to government, defense, public-safety, or business-to-business customers.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools, outbound prospecting, pipeline management, demos, proposals, or consultative sales.
  • Military, first-responder, athletics, entrepreneurial, campus-leadership, or other background demonstrating competitiveness, resilience, teamwork, and accountability.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Hunter mentality. Energetic about creating opportunities rather than waiting for leads.
  • Coachability. Actively seeks feedback, learns quickly, and applies the team’s expertise.
  • Customer curiosity. Asks good questions and cares about the mission problem before presenting a solution.
  • Persistence with judgment. Follows through consistently without damaging trust or forcing a poor-fit opportunity.
  • Commercial discipline. Keeps accurate records, protects time, prioritizes qualified opportunities, and knows the next action.
  • Team orientation. Works closely with technical, training, operational, proposal, contracts, and leadership colleagues.
  • Integrity. Represents current product capability accurately and does not overpromise to win a sale.
  • Executive presence. Can prepare well, communicate clearly, and earn credibility with senior customers while remaining authentic and eager to learn.

Compensation and Growth

  • Base salary. $60,000 annually.
  • Commission. 5% of qualifying Q2 Holodeck™ sales, governed by a written company commission plan that defines crediting, payment timing, adjustments, and treatment of shared or team-supported opportunities.
  • Year 1 sales goal. $1.5 million in qualifying individual sales.
  • Target cash earnings. $135,000 at the Year 1 goal, consisting of $60,000 in base salary and $75,000 in commission. Actual earnings depend on qualifying sales and the terms of the commission plan.
  • Career growth. Strong performers may earn larger accounts, greater market responsibility, leadership opportunities, and increased influence over the company’s go-to-market model as Elessar grows.

Working Conditions

  • Travel. Approximately 20-30% for demonstrations, customer meetings, exercises, and industry events.
  • Remote work. This is a remote role requiring dependable availability, disciplined communication, and proactive coordination with a distributed team.
  • Security and confidentiality. Employment is contingent on appropriate background review and execution of confidentiality, intellectual-property, and company policy documents.
  • Performance environment. This is an accountable, goal-oriented role in an early-stage company. Priorities may change as customer evidence, funding, and market opportunities develop.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Elessar, a subsidiary of Q2IMPACT™, is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

About Ceros

At Ceros, you’ll help ambitious brands create digital experiences that people actually want to explore. Our platform gives marketers and designers the flexibility to design, build, and publish immersive content. All without code. With Ceros, teams move faster, scale smarter, and deliver work that makes a real impact.

Customers report engagement times that are 80% longer and conversion rates more than 20% higher on Ceros-built experiences. That kind of performance is why leading brands like Pepsi, TimeOut, and Mastercard rely on us. Working here means shaping the future of digital experiences and joining a team that values bold ideas, creativity, and purpose-driven work.

The Role

Sr. SDRs at Ceros are high-performing outbound sellers who blend grit, creativity, and AI-powered tools to build pipeline at scale. Having mastered the core skills of the Outbound SDR role, you are now ready to operate at the intersection of human strategy and machine efficiency.

Functionally, you are given full autonomy to drive opportunities within your pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting. While you will spend a significant portion of your day on high-value human tasks like strategic cold calling, you will be supported by a tech stack that automates repetitive tasks. You will be responsible for managing AI agents - helping to build, test, and refine their outputs - while sharing fresh insights to help the team evolve. You aren't just using ChatGPT to "fix your grammar"; you are a curious architect of AI workflows, comfortable oscillating between 5-6 different AI-driven platforms to amplify your output.

Success in this role means exceeding targets through a blend of grit and technological sophistication. Your role will work closely with New Business Directors to help them close and win business on a set of industry-specific target accounts. While you are responsible for the top of funnel pipeline sourcing, your NBD will focus on running calls and closing deals.

This role is designed for those who have ambition to progress into Sales, Customer Success, or Strategic Accounts within 12-24 months by demonstrating they can lead in the new era of AI-integrated sales. This is a fully outbound SDR role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Generation & Acceleration: Build and maintain a pipeline of Outbound qualified leads, achieving quotas by leveraging AI for high-velocity prospecting.
  • Cold Calling: Responsible for spending 3-4 hours a day prospecting via cold calling to source meetings for your New Business Director.
  • AI Orchestration: You will manage multiple vendor-forward and homegrown AI tools, moving seamlessly between platforms to optimize your workflow.
  • Agent Management: Take ownership of AI agents. You will be responsible for the creativity behind their deployment, monitoring their performance, and auditing their output to ensure brand alignment.
  • Strategic Outreach: Generate qualified Outbound meetings for our new business pod through sophisticated, high-touch phone, LinkedIn, and email outreach.
  • CRM Cleanliness and Tooling Upkeep: Manage the hand-off to sales executives and maintain pristine data integrity within our Hubspot CRM.

Practical Stuff We Anticipate You Having

  • 1-3 years of Outbound SDR/Sales experience with a proven track record of hitting targets.
  • The ability to spend 3+ hours a day on the phone. Because AI handles your admin (list building, research, and data entry), your calling time must be high-energy and high-impact.
  • A strong curiosity about how AI is shaping modern sales. You’re comfortable leveraging the AI capabilities within tools beyond ChatGPT and Gemini, like Common Room, Amplemarket, Clay, or similar platforms, and you’re eager to experiment with new AI tools that streamline your process and make your workflows more efficient.
  • Ability to write strategic emails and converse professionally with C-suite and VP-level executives.
  • A willingness to work with others across the sales team and a desire to help build the future of the Ceros sales engine.
  • A "start-up soul" that thrives in a changing environment with an ever-evolving AI-forward product.

Note: This is not a traditional “data entry” SDR role. We’re looking for someone who is deeply curious about AI tooling and excited about how automation can elevate and empower the sales process. If you’re energized by high-volume prospecting and leveraging innovative technology to work smarter and drive impact, you’ll thrive in this role.

Key Things to Know

  • This is a full-time position
  • This is a remote-first role

Benefits

📍Global remote-first organization

📈 Stock options

🏥 Premium health insurance

🏦 401K matching

👶 Paid parental leave after a year of employment: 16 weeks for primary caregivers, 4 weeks for secondary caregivers

🌴 Flexible vacation days

🤒 Paid Sick days

👩‍💻👨‍💻 Stipend towards experiences in which Cerosians can collaborate, educate, and create social connections with one another

🏢 Unlimited access to co-working spaces around the globe
