raw.description:
About Patronus AI

Patronus AI is a frontier lab developing simulation research and infrastructure to accelerate progress toward human-aligned AGI. We are on a mission to simulate all of the world’s intelligence.

We are the team behind some of the earliest and most influential research in AI evaluation likeFinanceBench, Lynx,SimpleSafetyTests,CopyrightCatcher,Humanity’s Last Exam, and more. We are formerly AI researchers and engineers from companies like Meta AI, Amazon AGI, and Google. Our customers include foundation model labs and Fortune 500 enterprises like Adobe. We are backed by top-tier investors like Lightspeed Venture Partners, Notable Capital, Stanford University, Noam Brown, Gokul Rajaram, and more.

About the roleWe are looking for experienced software engineers (task-based contract) to design realistic, challenging tasks for frontier AI models and to judge how well those models handle them. You'll apply your day-to-day engineering judgment to show where AI gets code, reasoning and technical instructions right, and where it falls short.

What you’ll do

Depending on the project, you may:

  • Design realistic, multi-step coding and technical tasks that test an AI model's ability to reason, write code and follow precise instructions.
  • Build tasks around realistic workspace materials such as codebases, technical specs, architecture docs and datasets.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code and technical content for correctness, efficiency, clarity and alignment with real-world engineering practice.
  • Grade model outputs against rubrics and ground-truth answers, and write clear, structured feedback.
  • Help improve how AI understands programming, system design, data workflows and engineering best practices.
  • Work independently and asynchronously, meet deadlines, and collaborate with the Patronus team to keep quality high.
  • Test and refine content to reflect real-world complexity.
  • Review other contributors’ work for accuracy, clarity, and practical relevance.
  • Incorporate feedback promptly and flag gaps or unclear guidance.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data science or analytics.
  • Experience with system design, data pipelines, ML or LLM-based applications.
  • Prior work in code review, technical writing, AI training or model evaluation.
  • Strong coding skills in at least one major language, such as Python, Java, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript or Go.
  • Experience building, reviewing and debugging production-grade code.
  • Ability to follow detailed technical guidelines, work independently, respond to feedback, and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written communication and close attention to detail.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Our standards

  • All tasks and solutions must be human-authored. LLM-generated content is not permitted.
  • Tasks must be original and non-searchable.
  • Accurate, carefully checked contributions.
  • Quality over volume.

Pay: $30–$100 per hour and some tasks would have a flat rate

Location: Remote (India)

Type: Hourly, project/task-based contract (not a full-time role)

Commitment: Flexible, typically 15–20 hours per week; can be done alongside a full-time job

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Placement depends on project needs and assessment results.

You’ll be the go-to for attendee registration, housing coordination, confirmations, and client support across multiple congresses at once. It’s a great fit for someone who’s detail-obsessed, solution-oriented, and enjoys working with both data and people.

You’re Good At

  • Working in a structured, compliance-focused environment where documentation, audit readiness, and deadlines are essential
  • Using Cvent attendee, hotel, and reporting modules to maintain clean data, reporting, and communication workflows
  • Handling client questions and logistical details with professionalism, responsiveness, and a strong customer-service mindset
  • Juggling multiple congresses at once while staying organized, collaborative, and focused on delivering quality work

You Might Also Have

  • 5+ years of congress or convention planning and management experience
  • 3+ years of client management experience and 3+ years of attendee management experience
  • Experience supporting Life Sciences or pharmaceutical programs in a highly regulated, detail-oriented setting
  • International attendee experience and confidence working across cultures on a global team
  • A college degree and/or CMP certification

You Should Know

  • This role is virtual and is open to US and Canadian applicants.

If you’re ready to bring precision, energy, and great client service to exciting congress programs, apply now!

THE PERKS

Flexible Working
We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow
Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

Everyone has a voice
We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected.

Make your move
The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move.

We’ve got you covered
Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.
It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways.

Travel requirements for this role are as follows:Less than 25%

We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Congress Registration Manager is between $52,500 - $65,000 USD. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience, geographical location, and project budget.

raw.excerpt: Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex.
raw.description:
Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World

The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex. By combining innovative technology, powerful trade intelligence and the reach of our network, Descartes helps get goods, information, transportation assets, and people where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

We’re one of the most broadly deployed logistics and supply chain technology companies in the world. More than 26,000 customers around the globe use our cloud-based solutions to transform the way they move inventory and information to enhance productivity, better serve customers, thrive competitively, keep pace with evolving regulations, and respond to rapidly changing market conditions. Descartes is publicly traded (Nasdaq:DSGX, TSX:DSG) with headquarters in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, and offices and partners around the world. With record financial performance for more than 16 years, we lead the industry in innovation investment. Every day, logistics service providers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors, and other logistics-intensive businesses of all sizes rely on our scale, stability, and comprehensive solution footprint to move what’s most important to them. Learn more at www.descartes.com.

We’re growing fast and invite you to join our amazing team.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own a core product area within the Warehouse Management value stream of our eCommerce portfolio. Our WMS serves third-party logistics providers, brands, and retailers whose operations depend on our software every hour of every day, receiving, inventory, picking, packing, shipping, and billing, often for many clients inside a single warehouse. This is a senior individual contributor role with high expectations. You’ll own outcomes, not a backlog: deciding which problems are worth solving, validating them directly with customers, and driving delivery with Engineering through to measurable business results. The WMS business was recently acquired by Descartes, so you’ll also help shape how it connects to the rest of our portfolio; order and inventory management, shipping, and transportation.

What You’ll Do

Own Your Product Area and Its Outcomes

  • Define and communicate a focused strategy and roadmap for your product area, tied to clear business objectives and customer outcomes.
  • Be accountable for results of adoption, retention, revenue, and operational efficiency does not feature shipped.
  • Know your numbers: revenue, growth, usage, churn drivers, and where the product wins and loses against competitors.
  • Prioritize with discipline and be clear about what we will not build, and why.

Lead Discovery

  • Spend real time with customers; on calls and on warehouse floors to understand the problems behind the requests.
  • Validate problems before committing to solutions, using interviews, usage data, prototypes, and experiments.
  • Turn ambiguous, messy problems into structured, actionable plans.

Drive Execution with Engineering

  • Partner closely with Engineering to deliver complete solutions workflows, edge cases, integrations, and performance at scale.
  • Go deep enough technically to understand the architecture, APIs, and data model, and make sound tradeoffs with engineers.
  • Balance roadmap work, technical investment, and customer commitments; remove blockers and keep scope disciplined.

Build with AI

  • Use AI tools daily to move faster in discovery, analysis, specs, and prototyping.
  • Identify and deliver AI-driven capabilities that create real value for warehouse operators and know where AI doesn’t belong.

Shape the Commercial Side

  • Contribute to pricing, packaging, positioning, and upsell decisions, grounded in customer value and financial impact.
  • Build the business case for investments using market insight, customer evidence, and financial models.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Professional Services on launches, enablement, and competitive positioning.
  • Stay ahead of the market – competitors, customer expectations, and emerging technology in fulfillment and logistics.

Connect the Portfolio and Lead Without Authority

  • Work with Product Managers across Descartes to identify integration and partnership opportunities so our products work as a connected suite.
  • Help bring the acquired WMS business into Descartes’ operating model without losing what made it successful.
  • Earn trust with executives and cross-functional partners through clear communication, sound judgment, and data.
  • Mentor other PMs and help raise the bar for product practice across the team.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, owning products through discovery, delivery, and iteration.
  • Experience in warehouse management, fulfillment, 3PL, order management, inventory, shipping, or logistics software strongly preferred.
  • A track record of delivering business outcomes, not just features – and you can describe them in numbers.
  • High agency: you take initiative, create momentum, and own outcomes end to end without waiting to be asked.
  • Strong, hands-on discovery skills with direct customer exposure.
  • Technically fluent and comfortable in complex, multi-system, integration-heavy environments; a technical background is a plus.
  • Commercially fluent – you understand pricing, packaging, unit economics, and how your product makes money.
  • A daily, hands-on user of AI tools, with a point of view on how AI should shape both the product and the way product teams work.
  • Clear, concise communicator who brings structure to ambiguity and adapts to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Early signs of leadership – mentoring others, leading cross-functional initiatives, or influencing decisions above your level.
  • Willing to travel periodically to customer sites, warehouses, and team locations.

What We Value

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You don’t just accept the problem; you unpack it. You ask the second and third questions. You seek to understand, then act.
  • Bias for Ownership: You step into gaps, drive clarity, and take accountability for the result; not just the process.
  • Customer Empathy: You treat the customer’s problem like your own. You test assumptions and listen with the intent to solve.
  • Product Rigor: You know the difference between a roadmap and a strategy. You demand high-quality thinking and bring data to decisions.
  • Team-First: You make the people around you better. You share credit, own misses, and help others raise their game.

Why Join Us

This role offers real ownership of a product area at the core of physical warehouse operations at a moment when the portfolio is being shaped rather than maintained. Your work will be highly visible to leadership, and your ability to deliver outcomes will directly influence the growth of the business.
Location: This is a remote opportunity open to individuals who are legally entitled to work in Canada or the United States (with 10–20% travel across North America)..
Salary Range: $120,000 - $150,000 USD annually. Compensation information provided is a good faith estimate for this position only. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills as well as the years of experience you have. Similar positions located in different geographic regions will not necessarily receive the same compensation.

Join Us

As we scale, we’re looking for new doers, collaborators and innovators to join Descartes in uniting the people and technology that move the world as the Global Leader in Logistics and Supply Chain Technology. We’re entrepreneurial, hardworking, geeky-in-a-good way problem solvers. Guided by our values, we nurture a TEAM focused culture that invests in people and creates opportunities for advancement across a broad spectrum of career paths. We prioritize work-life balance and foster an environment with the space to take ownership, to be heard, and to carve a path for your individual accomplishments to help drive our success.

Descartes also has a deep sense of environmental responsibility. Learn more about how we helped our customers save over 552,000 metric tons of CO2 in 2020 by reducing fuel and paper consumption: .  Join a team that’s committed to working with customers to conserve resources and enhance sustainability.

At Descartes, everyone has a voice and the best idea wins, regardless of who makes it. We offer competitive compensation, great benefits, remote and flexible work hours, and the opportunity to join a company on an awesome mission with a great existing team and trajectory. If you feel you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for, and Descartes sounds like the team and the mission you want to be part of, apply now. raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

One of the key drivers to our success is a committed and rigorous emphasis on our people. We believe that our competitive advantage lies in our talent and that we can build a sustainable advantage by attracting, enabling and cultivating the world’s most exceptional people to do the very best work of their careers.

What you’ll do

Stripe is seeking a People Operations Specialist, HR Compliance to join our Global People Operations team. This role is a critical pillar of our People Operations function, focusing on complex operational challenges and continuous improvement across the employee lifecycle. You will serve as a critical operational stakeholder enabling HR transformation by ensuring seamless support, optimizing processes with data-driven insights, and collaborating closely with our Centers of Excellence (COEs).

Responsibilities

  • Audits and controls Management: Own Global People Operations participation in recurring compliance audits including SOX, HR security controls, and external audits. Coordinate evidence gathering, manage timelines, and serve as the People Operations point of contact for audit teams across multiple concurrent cycles.
  • Process Optimization and Data-Driven Improvement: Bring innovative, data-driven ideas and recommend enhancements to existing HR processes and workflows. Interpret data and formulate insights to proactively drive continuous operational improvements that enhance the overall employee experience.
  • Regulatory filing management:Track and execute Stripe's recurring compliance filings as required. Maintain filing calendars and monitor global regulatory changes.
  • Stakeholder and COE Partnership: Work closely with cross-functional teams and Centers of Excellence (COEs), including Procurement, Employment Legal, and Employee Relations, to ensure cross-functional compliance obligations are met, processes align, and smooth handoffs occur across the organization.
  • HRIS Management and Integrity: Maintain the accuracy and integrity of our HR Information System (Workday) by accurately entering employee change transactions manually and through bulk data uploads, ensuring a robust and reliable foundation for all HR data.
  • SOP Development and Documentation: Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that document workflows from end to end, encompassing all system interactions and cross-functional handoffs for clarity and efficiency.
  • Vendor management: Manage compliance vendor relationships — background check providers, labor law poster services, employment verification platforms — including contract renewals, SLA oversight, and service transitions.
  • Navigating Ambiguity: Operate effectively in ambiguous situations using your expertise, Stripe’s operating principles, and stakeholder perspectives to determine the best course of action and communicate clearly about systemic blockers.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Operations, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in HR compliance, People Operations, or employment law support, with direct ownership of compliance obligations
  • Knowledge of HR processes, policies, and best practices across the employee lifecycle.
  • Experience managing or supporting external audits, including evidence gathering and cross-functional coordination.
  • Technical aptitude and proficiency with Workday (specifically data accuracy and management) and experience with Salesforce or a similar ticketing system.
  • Working knowledge of US employment compliance requirements: I-9/E-Verify, EEO-1 filing, state pay equity reporting, labor law posting requirements
  • Experience driving operational improvements and contributing to significant program delivery.
  • Proven experience collaborating effectively with COEs (e.g., Legal, ER, People Partners) to resolve complex employee issues.
  • Written and verbal English communication skills including translating regulatory requirements into plain-language SOPs and stakeholder updates
  • Collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and cross-culturally in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Detail-oriented, with a focus on accuracy, quality, and compliance.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity effectively.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • Data fluency with the ability to interpret data and formulate insights to drive improvements and measure program success.
  • AI fluency, including the ability to use AI tools effectively, assess output quality, and recognize when human review or escalation is required.
  • Experience with SOX controls, internal audit processes, or global compliance frameworks
  • Vendor management experience.
  • Familiarity with international employment compliance — GDPR/ROPA, Right to Work checks outside the US, or EMEA/APAC regulatory requirements.
  • Experience building or improving global HR compliance program infrastructure.

Bring your leadership, strategy, and Life Sciences expertise to a role where you can truly make a difference—apply now!

THE PERKS

Flexible Working
We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best.

Room to Grow
Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow.

We’re positive. You’ll love it.

As a Mortgage Loan Originator on our Sales team, you'll be the first voice a client hears—and the trusted guide they rely on throughout their homebuying journey. You’ll engage directly with prospective and current clients over phone and email, providing clear, expert guidance on loan products, prequalification, and next steps—all while building strong relationships rooted in trust and transparency. Working closely with our Operations and Processing teams, you’ll manage a robust pipeline, make outbound calls to generate new business, and own the client experience from first conversation through closing. You’ll join a team that thrives on coachability, collaboration, and a shared obsession with putting clients first—because we know that winning the right way is the only way. If you’re energized by meaningful conversations, motivated by impact, and ready to leave the woodpile higher every day, you’ll thrive here.

For the Sage Home Loans website click here. Curious how Sage Home Loans fits into Red Ventures? Click here.

What You'll Do 

  • Answer inbound customer calls to discuss various loan products, prequalification criteria, and next steps
  • Communicate loan progress clearly to consumers and collect any required documentation
  • Make outbound sales calls to prospective and existing customers to generate new business and strengthen retention
  • Monitor and actively manage a pipeline of leads and loans to meet conversion goals and cycle time targets

What We're Looking For 

  • At least 3 years of mortgage sales experience with a proven track record of performance and client trust
  • NMLS-licensed mortgage loan originator with hands-on experience in originating a wide range of loan products
  • Full understanding of FHA, VA, and Conventional mortgage products and their unique benefits to clients
  • Strong knowledge of consumer lending regulations, including fair lending, privacy, RESPA, and TILA — and a commitment to always doing the right thing
  • Excellent phone sales skills with the ability to connect, empathize, and guide clients confidently through the loan process
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment while consistently meeting deadlines and service expectations
  • A natural relationship-builder who can collaborate across teams and foster trust with both internal partners and external clients
  • Demonstrated coachability, adaptability, and a growth mindset — always striving to leave the woodpile higher
  • Takes ownership of the client experience and communicates proactively to exceed expectations and uphold our service-level commitments
  • Energized by a culture that values speed, ethics, impact, and accountability — and driven by a desire to win the right way

Compensation 

This range reflects total cash compensation, which may include base salary only or base salary plus target bonus, depending on the role. Where eligible, equity may also be offered separately and not included above. Actual compensation varies based on location, experience, and qualifications.

  • Total Cash Compensation: $35k per year plus role specific incentive

Additionally, the following benefits are provided by Red Ventures, subject to eligibility requirements.

  • Health Insurance Coverage (medical, dental, and vision) 
  • Life Insurance 
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance 
  • Flexible Spending Accounts 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Holiday Pay 
  • 401(k) with match 
  • Employee Assistance Program 
  • Paid Parental Bonding Benefit Program 

  

Who We Are: 

Sage Home Loans Corporation is a digital mortgage lender solution redefining the mortgage origination experience. By building new technology solutions, we're creating simple and clean customer experiences to simplify the mortgage application process. Our team has developed a fully digital online application that enables the user to complete their application and start looking for the right mortgage that matches their needs 24/7. We then marry the digital journey with exceptional human interaction from our expert Loan Officers to create the best possible borrower experience. 

Founded in 2000, Red Ventures (RV) is home to a diverse portfolio of industry-leading brands and businesses, strategic partnerships and proprietary technology, including Sage Home Loans, Bankrate, Lonely Planet, The Points Guy, BestColleges and more. Together, RV helps millions of people worldwide make life’s most important decisions, accelerates digital adaptation, and innovates the online consumer experience by improving every step of the consumer journey from first discovery of information, throughout the decision-making process, to transactions. Headquartered south of Charlotte, NC, Red Ventures employs thousands of people across the US and Puerto Rico, with international offices in the UK and Brazil. For more information, visit and follow @RedVentures on social platforms.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Enterprise (Grower), you’ll be managing existing relationships and identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.

Responsibilities

  • Work with existing Stripe customers to develop and execute long-term sales strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue
  • Own the full sales cycle, from business case development, to deal structuring and negotiating, to close
  • Develop account plans and cross sell into your list of strategic customers, driving growth through expansion and new revenue streams
  • Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business, deeply understanding problems they are solving and helping drive to solutions
  • Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
  • 8+ years leading complex sales cycles with Enterprise organizations required
  • Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally
  • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

About This Role

Caylent’s Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic.

The Agentic Architect is the strategic and architectural lead on AI engagements. Paired with a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who handles hands-on implementation, you own the engagement arc: shaping AI strategy, designing operating models, mapping AI outcomes to business value, and guiding executive stakeholders through adoption. You lead the room — the FDE builds what you architect.

This is a cross-functional role. You engage across lines of business, not just engineering, connecting AI initiatives to the outcomes that matter to each part of the organization. Every engagement is anchored to Anthropic’s platform and focused on real AI adoption outcomes.

Your clients span PE portfolio companies, growth-stage software businesses, and enterprise organizations. You are the strategic face of Caylent from kickoff through handoff.

What You’ll Do

Strategy and Architecture

  • Own AI engagements end-to-end as the strategic lead, from discovery through executive handoff, partnered with an FDE who drives implementation
  • Run structured discovery across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to map organizational context, AI readiness, and strategic goals across lines of business
  • Design AI operating models that define how the organization adopts, governs, and scales AI. Not just within engineering, but across the business
  • Define AI outcome maps that tie initiatives to measurable business results: efficiency gains, revenue impact, risk reduction, and time-to-value
  • Lead AI maturity assessments and architect near-term and long-term adoption roadmaps aligned to Anthropic’s platform capabilities
  • Facilitate executive workshops and enablement sessions for audiences ranging from engineering teams to C-suite leaders
  • Deliver executive presentations to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and line-of-business leaders covering current-state findings, ROI projections, and strategic recommendations
  • Direct FDE work on Claude Code tooling, prompt architecture, and workflow automation. You set the technical direction, the FDE executes

Client Relationship and Business Development

  • Identify expansion opportunities across lines of business. AI strategy work naturally surfaces adjacent needs in departments beyond the initial engagement
  • Shape follow-on scope throughout the engagement: by Week 1, you should have a working hypothesis for the next engagement; by the final on-site block, you present it
  • Build executive relationships that position Caylent as a long-term AI strategy partner, not a one-time vendor
  • Attend on-site for the final Catalyst block: readout, workshop, and executive presentation

Internal Contribution

  • Contribute reusable strategy frameworks, delivery artifacts, and methodology improvements back into the practice at engagement close
  • Lead AI strategy engagements spanning multiple teams, platforms, and business functions
  • Collaborate with FDEs to refine the architect-engineer delivery model and improve handoff patterns

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of software development or technical architecture experience across varied stacks, including hyperscaler environments
  • 3+ years in engineering leadership, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or a combination
  • Demonstrated ability to engage across lines of business. You can talk to a VP of Engineering about CI/CD and a COO about operational efficiency in the same week
  • Experience designing or advising on AI operating models, technology adoption strategies, or digital transformation programs
  • Hands-on familiarity with Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development tools — you don’t need to configure them daily, but you need to speak the language credibly and direct an FDE’s work
  • Certified Claude Architect
  • Experience running structured stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, and facilitated workshops with both technical and business audiences
  • Strong executive communication: writing and presenting to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and line-of-business leaders
  • Experience delivering professional services engagements, including scope management, deliverable ownership, and client advisory
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software development workflows

Preferred

  • Experience mapping AI initiatives to business outcomes (revenue, efficiency, risk, time-to-value) with executive-level ROI framing
  • Familiarity with PE portfolio company environments and board-level communication
  • Background in solutions architecture, platform engineering, or enterprise technology strategy
  • Experience with LLM prompt engineering, agentic AI workflow design, or AI product development
  • Direct experience with Claude Code’s extensibility model
  • Familiarity with SDLC maturity frameworks or workforce analytics (DORA, DevEx)
  • Experience designing and facilitating workshops for mixed audiences — engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders

Who Thrives Here

The Agentic Architects who do well here are a specific profile:

  • Sat in the seat. You’ve led engineering teams or technology strategy inside a product company and understand the pressures executives navigate when adopting AI. Clients can tell.
  • Thinks across the business. You don’t stop at engineering. You see how AI impacts operations, product, and go-to-market — and you can have those conversations with the people who own them.
  • Knows when to slow down. You surface risks before committing to an approach. When the client’s definition of the work is wrong, you say so.
  • Closes the next engagement. The final week of a Catalyst is a conversion window. You treat it that way — and the cross-LOB relationships you’ve built give you multiple paths to expand.
  • Makes the methodology better. Every engagement teaches you something. You feed it back into the practice rather than keeping it in your head.
  • Earns trust at the executive level. You’re as comfortable presenting an AI operating model to a COO in the morning as reviewing prompt architecture with your FDE that afternoon.

This is a poor fit if you want someone else to handle the sales motion or prefer execution-only roles. You are accountable for both strategic delivery quality and account expansion.

Why This Team

  • Ground floor of something real: this BU is early, well-resourced, and anchored to Anthropic. You're writing the playbook, not inheriting one
  • Own the methodology: you are shaping how AI-DLC enablement gets delivered. Every engagement you run improves the one after it
  • Proximity to the market: your clients are PE portcos, enterprise engineering orgs, and Anthropic-referred customers at the frontier of AI adoption
  • Revenue upside: Agentic Architects who drive account expansion earn on revenue generated, not just delivery margin
  • AI-native by default: this team uses AI in how it works. Specification-First Engineering is how we move from prototype to production fast
  • Outcomes, not hours: advancement tied to delivery performance and account growth, not utilization

Benefits

  • 100% remote work
  • Medical Insurance for you and eligible dependents
  • Generous holidays and flexible PTO
  • Competitive phantom equity
  • Paid for exams and certifications
  • Peer bonus awards
  • State of the art laptop and tools
  • Equipment & Office Stipend
  • Individual professional development plan
  • Annual stipend for Learning and Development
  • Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture

This role may require up to 50% travel, depending on business needs.

Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.

Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.

We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!

The Mission

Caylent's Anthropic Business Unit is a dedicated AI services practice built in partnership with Anthropic — Anthropic's first pure-play delivery partner. Engagements are production-grade: agents, data products, AI-augmented operations, workforce transformation.

Forward Deployed Engineers live inside client organizations — in their standups, codebases, and architecture decisions. You own your assigned workstreams, deliver production-quality work from day one, and build the independent track record that creates a path to solo account ownership.

We hire into two specializations: Technology-Workforce FDEs embed in engineering, product, and IT organizations building LLM-native production systems; Operational FDEs embed in business functions — Finance, HR, Legal, Supply Chain, and more — building workflow automations and running AI enablement programs for non-technical teams.

raw.excerpt: Por que a Valtech?  Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais.
raw.description:
Por que a Valtech?

Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreira internacional e a chance de definir o futuro das experiências. 

Aqui você encontrá um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto relevante e crescimento profissional.

Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho contribuirá para a transformação das indústrias.

Temos orgulho de: 

  •  O trabalho que realizamos e a inovação que promovemos
  •  Nossos valores: share, care e dare
  • Uma cultura que incentiva criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nosso modelo global sem fronteiras, que permite colaboração integrada e fluida

 

A vaga

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como Senior Learning & Development Analyst. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenhar, implementar e avaliar programas de aprendizagem que atendam às necessidades do negócio e promovam o aprendizado contínuo. A posição atua em estreita parceria com líderes de negócio e outros stakeholders para alinhar as estratégias de aprendizagem aos objetivos organizacionais, fomentar uma cultura de inovação e garantir que os colaboradores estejam preparados para prosperar em um ambiente em constante transformação.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenhar e desenvolver programas e materiais de aprendizagem de alta qualidade,
  • Atuar como especialista, oferecendo orientação sobre design e estrutura de aprendizagem.
  • Projetar e liderar a implementação de programas essenciais, como onboarding, treinamentos obrigatórios (compliance), AI Academy, Growth Academy, certificações de parceiros, entre outros.
  • Implementar e gerenciar plataformas e ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem.
  • Apoiar e viabilizar a realização de workshops, sessões de treinamento e experiências de aprendizagem virtual que promovam transferência de conhecimento e desenvolvimento de habilidades.
  • Oferecer coaching e orientação a colaboradores e gestores, apoiando o crescimento individual e o desenvolvimento de carreira.
  • Apoiar a identificação de lacunas de competências e prioridades de desenvolvimento na organização. Traduzir esses insights em planos de ação concretos.
  • Mensurar a eficácia das iniciativas de aprendizagem por meio de análise de dados, feedbacks e indicadores de desempenho.
  • Atuar em parceria com RH, líderes de negócio e especialistas de conteúdo para garantir que as iniciativas de aprendizagem estejam alinhadas às prioridades estratégicas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação em Administração, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência prévia na implementação bem-sucedida de programas de aprendizagem, preferencialmente em nível global.
  • Capacidade de criar programas estruturados e centrados no aprendiz.
  • Conhecimento básico na criação e edição de vídeos.
  • Proficiência em LMS, ferramentas de autoria de e-learning e plataformas virtuais.
  • Habilidade em engajar públicos diversos, tanto presencialmente quanto virtualmente.
  • Capacidade de interpretar dados e aplicar insights para melhoria contínua; conhecimento em mensuração de impacto e ROI de programas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de influência e comunicação eficaz.
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e de ritmo acelerado, com alto nível de ambiguidade.

 

Diferenciais  

  • Espanhol intermediário/avançado.
  • Certificações profissionais em aprendizagem e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento em diversidade, equidade e inclusão.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de IA.

Se não atender a todos os requisitos , ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender. 

 

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas - e isso também vale para o nosso time.
Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. 

Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas.
Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil.
Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner. 

Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

Quer fazer parte do próximo capítulo? Venha fazer parte do time!

raw.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you will operate, monitor, and continuously improve client cloud environments, lead the response to incidents within agreed SLAs, and drive automation that reduces operational risk. This position participates in a rotating shift and on-call schedule to provide round-the-clock coverage for Valtech's managed services clients.

Role responsibilities

• Monitor cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) using observability tooling; triage alerts and respond to incidents within defined SLAs as part of a 24x7 rotation, including nights, weekends, and holidays as scheduled.
• Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management for production issues, escalating to vendors or engineering leadership when required.
• Execute and support change requests, patching, backups, and routine maintenance following Valtech's change management and least-privilege access processes.
• Design, build, and maintain Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep) and CI/CD pipelines to automate provisioning and reduce manual toil.
• Own and continuously improve monitoring, alerting, and dashboarding (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Azure Monitor) to increase visibility and reduce mean time to detect/resolve.
• Support security operations: apply patches, respond to vulnerability findings, and follow incident escalation procedures in line with client and Valtech security policies.
• Maintain accurate runbooks, knowledge base articles, and shift handover notes to ensure smooth 24x7 continuity across teams and time zones.
• Collaborate with client stakeholders, account teams, and cross-functional Valtech engineering teams on service improvement initiatives.
• Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization, and reliability improvements (SLOs/SLIs) for managed environments.
• Participate in on-call rotation and follow escalation/paging procedures for priority incidents outside scheduled shifts, where applicable.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

• Advanced/Fluent English

• 5+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure support roles, ideally within a managed services or 24x7 operations environment.
• Deep, hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP); multi-cloud experience is preferred.
• Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows Server administration.
• Scripting/automation experience (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools.
• Solid experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) is expected.
• Familiarity with monitoring and incident management tooling (e.g., Datadog, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).
• Understanding of ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management practices.
• Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to remain calm and methodical during high-pressure incidents.
• Clear written and verbal communication skills for shift handovers and client-facing updates.
• Willingness and ability to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays, to support 24x7 coverage.
• High adaptability and curiosity around emerging tools
• Strong analytical judgement to assess AI outputs
• Systems thinking with the ability to understand full incident to resolution chains with AI support
• Experience with an AI-first approach to triage, RCA generation and observability insights

Nice to have qualifications

• Cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional/DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Azure Administrator/Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect).
• Experience supporting enterprise or multi-tenant client environments in a managed services or MSP setting.
• Exposure to security frameworks and compliance requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience with IT Service Management platforms enriched by AI

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a Full Time position based in Brazil, open for remote or hybrid work (São Paulo or Florianópolis)

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

raw.description:
About Onnit:

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

JOB SUMMARY

ONNIT is doubling its launch cadence in 2027 and expanding into new categories, and we need a dedicated owner for the pipeline. In this role, you'll lead our innovation pipeline end to end, from spotting promising ingredients to launching products customers love. You'll bridge R&D and Brand. You don't need to be a scientist, but you do need to be fluent in both the evidence behind an ingredient and the commercial case for a product.

  • Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer, in close partnership with the Chief Operating Officer
  • Team: Individual contributor leading cross-functional project teams
  • Scope: Supplements and functional nutrition: new ingredients, formats, flavors, categories, and hero-product renovations
  • Location: Remote (U.S.); NYC, LA, or Austin preferred. Travel up to 25%

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Discover what's next

  • Own the ingredient opportunity map. Prioritize the ingredients most likely to shape Total Human optimization, starting with our core need states (cognition and focus, energy, sleep and stress, recovery) and extending to adjacent ones (gut health, hormonal health, longevity).
  • Separate signal from hype. Track emerging clinical research, branded and patented ingredients, and new delivery technologies, and run ONNIT's trend radar with clear recommendations for leadership each quarter.

Define where we play next

  • Expand our format and flavor range. Evaluate new form factors, from gummies, chews, and stick packs to ready-to-drink and functional foods, and set taste targets with R&D and flavor-house partners, ensuring daily products are ones people look forward to.
  • Make the case for new categories. Recommend which categories ONNIT enters as part of our 2027 expansion, and in what order, informed by consumer evidence and regular competitive teardowns.

Build on credible evidence

  • Lead evidence reviews. Assess dose, delivery, bioavailability, safety, and study quality, and hold the line on clinically meaningful doses with formulators and scientific advisors.
  • Build compliance in from day one. Partner with Regulatory and Legal on regulatory pathway (including New Dietary Ingredient requirements), claims and substantiation, and third-party certifications like NSF Certified for Sport where they matter to our athletes.
  • Turn science into a story people trust. Create a science brief for every launch covering approved claims, the evidence behind them, and a plain-language story.

Own the roadmap and drive concepts to launch

  • Build a balanced roadmap. Turn brand strategy into a rolling 12–18-month roadmap that balances line extensions and hero-product renovations with bigger bets, supporting our goal to double launch cadence in 2027.
  • Run a right-sized stage-gate. Quick-turn gates for extensions and renovations, a fuller path for new ingredients, formats, categories, and monthly pipeline reporting that recommends stopping projects early when the case doesn't hold.
  • Lead cross-functional launch teams. Drive approved concepts to launch with R&D, Operations, Quality and Procurement, owning COGS, margin, and timeline targets and making sure formula, packaging, labeling, and supply are ready ahead of each channel's timeline, including retail sell-in windows.

Prove the case and co-lead go-to-market

  • Stay with every launch past the handoff. Co-lead go-to-market with Brand on positioning, naming and the launch story; equip sales, retail partners, and athletes to talk about each product credibly, and track performance at 30, 60, and 90 days.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in CPG innovation, NPD or R&D, with multiple products taken from concept to launch
  • Experience in supplements, functional or sports nutrition, or a closely related category
  • Strong scientific literacy. You can read a clinical study, judge its quality, and explain what it does and doesn't prove, including on safety (a degree in nutrition, food science, biology, chemistry, or a related field is a plus, not required)
  • Working knowledge of how supplements are made and regulated, including formulation, cGMP, DSHEA, claims substantiation, and NDI requirements
  • A track record of launching quickly while protecting quality, safety, and claims integrity
  • Proven ability to lead through influence, aligning cross-functional partners and leadership around a clear recommendation
  • Commercial judgment. You can build a business case and co-lead a launch, and you care whether a product sells, not just whether it's interesting

Nice to have: Experience in nootropics, performance, recovery, sleep, or longevity; launches across TTS, DTC, Amazon, and retail; ready-to-drink or functional food experience; a fast-moving or early-stage environment.

Onnit takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. This position is bonus eligible and employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. Should the employee choose to participate, they can choose from a range of benefits to include, but is not limited to, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, sick leave, paid vacation and holidays. Any coverages for health insurance will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents.

  • Flexible workplace policy

  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Fringe benefits include in-office meals, product credits and discounts, lifestyle spending account, family planning, online learning, fitness stipend, among many others

raw.description:
About the role

At Valtech, we build digital experiences that help the world's leading brands connect with their customers through content, commerce, experimentation, data and AI.

We're looking for a Lead Optimizely Solutions Architect to join our growing Optimizely practice in Canada. In this role, you'll lead the design and delivery of enterprise digital experience platforms, guide multidisciplinary teams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients navigating complex digital transformation initiatives.

This is a highly strategic role that combines architecture, consulting, technical leadership, AI innovation and people management. You'll help shape client roadmaps, support business development efforts, mentor engineers and architects, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure and aligned with business goals.

If you're passionate about Optimizely, modern digital architectures and AI-enabled experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do

Architecture & Delivery

  • Design enterprise-grade Optimizely solutions that align business objectives, technical requirements and industry best practices.
  • Define scalable architectures across content management, integrations, personalization, analytics and digital experience platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple concurrent projects and guide teams through complex implementation challenges.
  • Produce architecture documentation, technical specifications and executive-ready presentations.
  • Lead technical discovery efforts, feasibility assessments and risk identification.
  • Support engineering teams with proof-of-concepts, complex implementations and critical technical decisions.
  • Establish and promote best practices around content modeling, headless delivery, security, performance and maintainability.
  • Design integrations across CRM, commerce, CDP, PIM, DAM, analytics and identity ecosystems.
  • Define data collection, event tracking and analytics strategies that drive personalization, experimentation and business insights.

AI Solutions & Innovation

  • Design and deliver AI-enabled experiences and workflows leveraging Optimizely Opal, LLM services and emerging AI technologies.
  • Define governance frameworks and guardrails for AI adoption, including privacy, compliance, content quality and human oversight.
  • Champion AI-assisted software delivery practices, including code generation, testing automation and developer productivity tools.
  • Help clients identify practical AI use cases that create measurable business value across content, marketing and experimentation workflows.

Client Advisory & Consulting

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to enterprise clients.
  • Define technology roadmaps and provide recommendations for platform evolution and modernization.
  • Advise on broader MarTech and enterprise ecosystems, ensuring Optimizely integrates effectively with existing platforms and services.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Delivery Leads and Creative teams to maximize business impact.
  • Communicate architecture decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Practice Growth & Leadership

  • Stay current with the Optimizely product ecosystem, including CMS, Graph, Experimentation, CMP, Commerce and Opal.
  • Contribute to business development activities, solution shaping, client workshops and proposal development.
  • Lead top-down and bottom-up estimation exercises for new opportunities.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to Valtech's offerings, accelerators and delivery standards.
  • Mentor architects and developers while helping define the future direction of the practice.
  • Manage a small team of direct reports, supporting performance, career growth and professional development.

What you bring

Platform Database Engineer

Location: Colombia – Remote

About the Role

The Platform Database Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, administering, and optimizing MongoDB (Atlas and on‑premise) within a large-scale, cloud-based enterprise ecosystem. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE principles to ensure performance, reliability, scalability, and automation across mission‑critical data platforms.

What You Will Do

  • Architect, implement, and maintain MongoDB Atlas and non‑Atlas environments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security.
  • Design and enforce resiliency and disaster recovery strategies, including backup, restore, and multi‑region failover.
  • Optimize database performance and query execution to support application development teams throughout all SDLC phases.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure‑as‑code solutions (Terraform, GitOps) for database provisioning and automation.
  • Implement and refine observability and monitoring solutions using Dynatrace, CloudWatch, and MongoDB native telemetry.
  • Manage access control, auditing, and encryption to meet enterprise security and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with application, DevOps, and platform teams to continuously improve reliability, performance, and operational excellence.
  • Lead incident response for database‑related issues, drive root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventative measures.
  • Mentor and guide technical teams, contributing to documentation, standards, and design reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience as a MongoDB DBA, including 4+ years administering MongoDB Atlas.
  • Strong experience with the AWS ecosystem (EC2, EKS, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, VPC, Lambda).
  • Proficiency in Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD automation, and containerized workloads (EKS/Kubernetes).
  • Experience with Dynatrace, Prometheus, or equivalent observability platforms.
  • Strong Linux administration expertise and scripting skills (Python, Bash).
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to participate in on‑call rotation and incident response.
  • Travel requirement: <10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kafka, CDC, and enterprise data integration platforms.
  • Familiarity with GitOps practices and infrastructure observability at enterprise scale.

This is a freelance position: Expected project duration is 6 months, starting as soon as possible, full-time.

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

The role

We are looking for a Business Analyst (Data) to join the delivery squad building a Loyalty Revenue Accounting solution on Databricks. The solution takes data from the Loyalty platform and other source systems and produces the accounting outputs Finance needs, including journals and reports. You will define the data requirements, business logic and mapping rules that the data engineers build from, and keep them current as requirements evolve.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, finance and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Define and document data requirements for a data platform solution, working closely with Product Teams from Finance, Loyalty and architecture stakeholders
  • Define business logic in precise, testable terms, including calculations, allocations and rules for how transactions are treated
  • Produce source-to-target mapping specifications, covering field-level mappings, transformations and reference data
  • Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira, with enough detail for engineers to build from and testers to validate against
  • Maintain traceability from business need through requirements to mappings and design, and keep documentation up to date as requirements change
  • Identify gaps, edge cases and anomalies early, and raise them with options and impact
  • Work with the product manager, data engineers, architects and QE through delivery, answering questions and validating what is built against the requirements
  • Support walkthroughs and sign-off with Finance and other business stakeholders

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst on data-focused projects, such as data platforms, data warehouses or data migration – a must
  • Experience defining both business logic and data mapping logic, not only high-level process requirements – a must
  • Strong written requirements skills, including writing and managing requirements in Jira
  • Ability to read and reason about data structures, tables and fields, with working knowledge of SQL
  • Strong communication skills, able to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in an agile delivery team where requirements iterate

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks or a similar cloud data platform
  • Experience in finance, revenue accounting or accounting journals
  • Experience with loyalty, airline or travel data
  • Familiarity with event-driven or streaming data sources

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. Somos uma empresa focada em inovação e experiência - um parceiro de confiança para grandes marcas globais. Para quem faz parte da Valtech, oferecemos oportunidades de crescimento, uma cultura guiada por valores, carreira internacional e a chance de definir o futuro das experiências. 

Aqui você encontrá um ambiente projetado para aprendizado contínuo, impacto relevante e crescimento profissional.

Seja criando novas soluções digitais, desafiando padrões ou construindo a próxima geração de experiências para clientes, seu trabalho contribuirá para a transformação das indústrias.

Temos orgulho de: 

  •  O trabalho que realizamos e a inovação que promovemos
  •  Nossos valores: share, care e dare
  • Uma cultura que incentiva criatividade, diversidade e autonomia
  • Nosso modelo global sem fronteiras, que permite colaboração integrada e fluida

 

Estamos procurando alguém para se juntar à nossa equipe no escritório de Florianópois, São Paulo ou Remoto na função de Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist.

O que estamos procurando:

Como Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist, você trabalhará em projetos de implementação, sustentação e/ou operação do Salesforce Marketing Cloud, de forma independente ou em colaboração com outros membros da equipe de Automação de Marketing. O foco principal desta posição não é apenas realizar configurações por meio dos produtos do Salesforce Marketing Cloud e de suas funcionalidades estendidas, mas também atuar como o principal ponto de contato com o cliente, definindo a solução a ser proposta, coordenando sua construção e garantindo a qualidade da entrega final.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Configuração por meio dos principais produtos do Salesforce Marketing Cloud (como Email Studio, CloudPages, Content Builder, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Audience Builder, Mobile Connect, Mobile Push e Contact Builder) e de funcionalidades estendidas (como Marketing Cloud Personalization, Customer Data Platform, Account Engagement, Intelligence e Advertisement Studio);
  • Recomendação das melhores práticas de Automação de Marketing nos níveis estratégico, tático e funcional, visando alcançar os objetivos de negócio;
  • Mapeamento das necessidades do negócio e do cenário de produtos/funcionalidades, bem como cocriação do blueprint de cada entrega;
  • Gerenciamento do backlog e garantia de que as user stories estejam alinhadas aos requisitos e às priorizações de negócio estabelecidos;
  • Briefing e coordenação da equipe de configuração/desenvolvimento do projeto;
  • Revisão e validação das entregas para garantir sua qualidade;
  • Elaboração de relatórios, análises e recomendações para otimização após o go-live;
  • Execução de treinamentos e criação de apresentações;
  • Colaboração nas principais cerimônias dos projetos, como reunião de kick-off, dailies internas, reuniões semanais de status com os stakeholders do projeto, sessões de discovery, sessões de validação do blueprint, sessões internas de garantia da qualidade, testes de aceitação do usuário (UAT) e retrospectivas;
  • Acompanhamento dos novos lançamentos do Salesforce Marketing Cloud, novos produtos, atualizações de funcionalidades e descontinuações;

Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente
  • 5+ anos de experiência
  • Capacidade de atuar como consultor(a), transitando com facilidade entre negócio, estratégia e tecnologia.
  • Experiência como Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant, com domínio de Marketing Cloud Engagement e Data Cloud, atuando em implementação, evolução e melhoria contínua de soluções.
  • Conhecimento técnico de SQL e JavaScript, com boa compreensão de dados e integrações
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções que tragam agilidade e eficiência para a operação, identificando oportunidades de automação, novas funcionalidades, integrações e melhorias, além da execução de campanhas do dia a dia.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de Marketing Cloud, como Marketing Cloud Personalization e Account Engagement
  • Certificação Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant; certificação em Data Cloud

Se não atender a todos os requisitos, ainda assim o incentivamos a inscrição. Na Valtech, valorizamos perfis diversos e vontade de aprender. 

Nosso compromisso com todas as pessoas

Criamos experiências que atendem diferentes perfis de pessoas - e isso também vale para o nosso time.

Na Valtech, buscamos manter um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos tenham o apoio necessário para crescer e desenvolver seu potencial. 

Valorizamos a diversidade de trajetórias e perspectivas.

Se quiser conhecer mais sobre nossas iniciativas, acesse nosso site Explore our Diversity & Inclusion.

Seu processo de candidatura

Após enviar sua candidatura, o time de Talent Acquisition revisará seu perfil.

Se suas habilidades e experiência estiverem alinhadas, entraremos em contato para os próximos passos.

Seu CV deve destacar experiências e conhecimentos relevantes. Não solicitamos informações como idade, gênero, estado civil ou foto. Avaliamos candidatos com base em habilidades, experiência e potencial.

⚠️ Atenção: esteja alerta para possíveis fraudes de recrutamento. Utilizamos apenas e-mails oficiais da Valtech.

Se você necessita de adaptações no processo seletivo, basta indicar na aplicação ou informar ao seu Talent Partner. 

Sobre a Valtech

A Valtech existe para desbloquear novas formas de experienciar o mundo.

Nós combinamos diferentes práticas, setores e culturas para ajudar marcas a gerar valor em um mundo digital.

Na interseção entre dados, IA, criatividade e tecnologia, impulsionamos transformação para organizações líderes como L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen, Dolby e outras.

Na Valtech, não apenas falamos sobre transformação, nós fazemos acontecer.

E nossas pessoas são o centro desse impacto, em um ambiente criado para que possam crescer, inovar e prosperar.

Deliver high-quality datasets that support analytics, machine learning, causal modeling, and optimization systems. Architecture, Governance & Observability

Apply modern architecture patterns including event-driven and streaming architectures, and ensure adherence to best practices in data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC), using tools such as Unity Catalog and AWS Lake Formation, or Microsoft Purview, depending on the platform in use.

Establish strong data observability, including monitoring of data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence, ensuring systems remain trustworthy and production-ready.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

Enable data serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) to support downstream systems, including ML and AI platforms. Continuously monitor and optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency across our core cloud ecosystems.

Bring genuine curiosity to every engagement — ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders are asking for, but why. Apply common sense thinking, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help derive and refine business requirements, surfacing gaps or better alternatives where they exist rather than simply executing a brief as written.
