raw.excerpt: About Clarity Pediatrics Clarity Pediatrics is building a new model for pediatric chronic care — one that brings affordable, science-backed care to the 1 in 3 kids with chronic conditions.
raw.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics
Clarity Pediatrics is building a new model for pediatric chronic care — one that brings affordable, science-backed care to the 1 in 3 kids with chronic conditions. We deliver virtual, evidence-based care that’s accessible, collaborative, and designed to support families and providers alike. We’ve started with ADHD and anxiety, and we’re working to expand into other chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity. Backed by $10M from leading healthcare investors, we’re led by experienced clinicians and healthcare leaders with deep domain expertise and a shared commitment to clinical excellence.

Our Culture

We’re building a team of clinicians who are collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering exceptional care. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Co-founded by a pediatric provider, with exceptional clinical leaders including licensed mental health providers in key roles shaping every major decision

  • Clinical model built to partner closely with referring providers

  • Multidisciplinary collaboration and robust case consultation opportunities

  • A diverse, inclusive, and mission-driven community where your voice matters

  • Access to expert clinical guidance from ADHD and anxiety specialists and researchers

  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and training

What We Offer

We’re committed to taking care of the healthcare providers who care for our patients. Our benefits include:

  • Fully remote and flexible schedule

  • Salary $85,000-$110,000/year (full-time)

  • Available bonus opportunities

  • Medical, dental, vision, and ancillary benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Flexible PTO

  • CME/CEU support and reimbursement

  • Remote-friendly work culture

  • A dedicated care coordination team to support with administrative tasks (e.g., cancellations, rescheduling, documentation requests, billing)

  • And more—we’re growing and evolving, so tell us what matters most to you!

About the Role

Clarity Pediatrics is seeking full time, licensed Child and Family Therapists to join our remote, multidisciplinary team. You’ll provide clinical services including ADHD and anxiety assessments and leading parenting groups such as Parent Training in Behavior Management (BPT) and Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotion (SPACE).

We’re committed to setting clinicians up for success with peer consultation groups, guidance from ADHD and anxiety experts, and stipends for professional development. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape our care model and improve workflows that support high-quality, sustainable care. We value diverse clinical backgrounds and encourage you to grow your expertise, lead initiatives, and focus on what you do best.

With our full time (40 hr/week) role, enjoy flexible scheduling within our operating hours (weekdays 8 am – 8 pm and Saturdays), in the time zone where you provide care.

What You’ll Own

  • Conduct comprehensive ADHD and anxiety assessments and intake evaluations for new patients and families

  • Provide personalized treatment recommendations, including referrals to community providers when appropriate

  • Lead group therapy sessions for caregivers of children with ADHD, anxiety, and co-occurring conditions such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver high-quality, integrated care

  • Opportunities exist to contribute to program development, evaluation, and research initiatives—based on your interests and organizational needs

About You

  • You’re a licensed mental health professional (LPCC, LMFT, or LCSW) with a master’s degree in a relevant field—and you're passionate about providing excellent care to kids and families.

  • You’re currently licensed in California and open to getting licensed in other states (we’ll support you with that!)

  • You have experience working in integrated care settings and enjoy using evidence-based approaches, especially for pediatric ADHD and anxiety.

  • You’re tech-savvy, a quick learner, and excited about shaping the future of behavioral health through innovative, virtual care.

  • You’re energized by collaboration and interested in building better systems—whether through care model design, new tools, or team initiatives.

  • This role is remote, so you’re able to work from a private, secure location with strong internet—and you’re open to working at least 2 hours per week during peak times (M-F 6:00-8pm PT, and/or Saturday 8am-2pm)

Nice to Have

  • Licensed in additional states

  • Spanish proficiency (with pay differential)

raw.excerpt: About us Xiatech is the pioneer of Xfuze, the world’s first AI-powered composable Integration, Data Management, Analytics and Orchestration Platform that innovatively connects systems, creates a single view of data and delivers actionable insights in one cloud-native, SaaS solution.
raw.description:
About us
Xiatech is the pioneer of Xfuze, the world’s first AI-powered composable Integration, Data Management, Analytics and Orchestration Platform that innovatively connects systems, creates a single view of data and delivers actionable insights in one cloud-native, SaaS solution. Business, technology and data teams use Xfuze to shorten time-to-insights, accelerate digital transformation, and extend the value of their legacy technology investments.

We’re a culture-first organisation and put our people at the forefront of everything we do. We believe that a great working environment leads to a happy and productive team, which is why we offer our staff the flexibility to work remotely or from our beautiful office in Fitzrovia, Central London.

The Role
We're looking for a highly motivated, independent Principal Implementation Engineer to become an Xfuze "super user", architecting and delivering end-to-end, data-driven solutions for our clients. You'll be involved from the start of each engagement: understanding requirements at pre-sales, running business analysis, building conceptual architecture through to high-level design across data, integration, and agentic AI workflows, then getting hands-on to configure the platform yourself.

You'll likely have a background in data and/or integration, an architecture and design mindset, strong communication skills, and a natural ability to lead others. Ideally you've worked on a data/integration or complex Enterprise SaaS platform within a professional services team, with a track record of delivering successful projects. Deep technical expertise everywhere isn't required, but a solid technical foundation and willingness to learn are essential. This is a broad, end-to-end role, so flexibility is key.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Delivery
  • Lead other Implementation Engineers, helping them grow and get the most from Xfuze
  • Own pre-sales, discovery, design, environment, releases, and supportability end-to-end, acting as gatekeeper for designs from other Senior Implementation Engineers
  • Support estimating and sizing projects through pre-sales and delivery
  • Collaborate with Client Partners and Pre-Sales on commercial aspects, and with the product team (including our Central Design Group) on technical aspects
  • Make high-level design decisions with enterprise-grade architectural maturity, validating designs prior to formal review
Product Implementation
  • Take a "standard first" approach, challenging requests for bespoke customisation
  • Analyse, explore, and validate data with clients to understand structures and use cases
  • Identify product gaps and coordinate with the platform team to resolve them
  • Produce high-level designs using standard templates; scrutinise and approve low-level designs, config specs, and code
  • Deliver complex implementations, including custom plugins and data model extensions, working with data engineers and platform developers
  • Configure connectors (e.g., Shopify, Akeneo, Bloomreach, Optimove), workflows, and data transformations
  • Create and extend Power BI dashboards using Xfuze data layers
  • Support rigorous testing and QA of solutions
Consulting & Client Engagement
  • Contribute to commercial proposals and implementation strategy
  • Understand client landscapes and use cases; advise on best practices and the right implementation path
  • Manage key stakeholders (e.g., Solution Architects, Heads of Engineering/Development/Data)
  • Produce documentation and training guides for other Implementation Engineers
  • Act as the "Voice of the Customer", advocating for recurring custom work to be folded into the Core Platform roadmap

Your Knowledge & Experience
Must have
  • Independent, self-motivated, and results-oriented, with the drive to see initiatives through
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, confident presenting to clients and stakeholders at all levels
Should have
  • Strong business analysis skills: capturing requirements, analysing use cases, translating them into solutions
  • Strong data modelling knowledge, able to design complex models
  • Competent in Python or similar for writing functions and plugins (not necessarily expert level)
  • Intermediate SQL
  • Proficient with at least one cloud environment
  • Comfortable using AI tooling for efficiency; understands Agentic AI concepts and AI guardrails
  • Retail experience preferred; expertise in at least one complex domain required
Desirable
  • Proficient in Power BI or similar (or able to learn quickly)
  • Good working knowledge of modern architectures and leading data platforms
  • Experience with Boomi, Mulesoft, or similar integration platforms

Your Personality
  • Energetic
  • Driven
  • Innovative
  • Resilient
  • Insightful
  • Creative
  • Analytical
  • Sound judgement
  • Strong problem solver
  • Quick learner

If you would like the opportunity to join an established UK-based Software as a Service organisation that believes in using the latest leading-edge technology to drive business growth, please enquire now by emailing

you receive an offer of employment, this will be conditional upon satisfactory completion of a right to work & identity check, a reference check and a basic criminal record check for any unspent convictions.

Xiatech is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.

raw.description:
JSI invites you to join our team as a Permit Coordinator on our Permitting & Environmentals team, where you'll play a critical role in advancing broadband and telecommunications initiatives that expand connectivity and drive digital inclusion—while advancing your career within a mission-driven, growth-focused organization.
About the Company:
JSI is a leading full-service consulting firm specializing in broadband solutions. For over 60 years, we have provided independent communications service providers with expert financial, engineering, management, operational, regulatory, and strategic guidance. Our extensive industry knowledge and proven track record of success have empowered clients to achieve sustainable growth and profitability. With clients nationwide and a powerful presence in markets across the United States, JSI empowers rural and regional broadband providers to expand, evolve, and excel in a rapidly shifting digital world.
Position Overview:
As a Permit Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing and supporting the permitting process across all active projects. This role serves as a key operational resource, coordinating between internal project teams, municipal agencies, and external stakeholders to ensure permits are obtained in a timely and compliant manner.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate permitting activities across multiple active projects, ensuring adherence to permit schedules and timely submission of complete permit packages.
  • Track permit status, supplemental information, approvals, and as-built staking sheet submissions while maintaining accurate permitting records and documentation.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with municipal, county, and state agencies regarding permit applications, inquiries, and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor regulatory changes and collaborate with project engineers, designers, and internal teams to resolve permit-related issues and minimize project delays.
  • Maintain organized digital and physical permitting files and ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and accessible.
  • Provide regular permit status updates to project managers and leadership, identifying potential risks and recommending solutions to keep projects on schedule.

Qualifications

Required:
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in permitting, construction coordination, project administration, or a related role.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).

raw.description:
At Reimagined Parking, we believe great people drive great results. That’s why we prioritize our teams, champion a positive culture, and relentlessly pursue excellence.
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Senior Data Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and growth of Reimagined Parking’s commercial data products.
This role is responsible for identifying opportunities to turn Reimagined Parking’s data, analytics, and insights into differentiated products and services that create measurable value for customers and the business.

The Senior Data Product Manager will own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for commercial data products, working closely with customers, business leaders, commercial teams, data engineering, data science, analytics, and software development.
The role combines product management, data strategy, customer discovery, and commercial development. The successful candidate will understand customer problems and market opportunities, translate them into compelling data products, and work cross-functionally to bring those products to market and continuously improve them.
In addition to developing external-facing data products, this role will identify opportunities to leverage data products and analytics to improve Reimagined Parking’s revenue, operational performance, customer experience, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Data Product Strategy
  • Define the vision and strategy for Reimagined Parking’s commercial data product portfolio.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to transform proprietary data, analytics, and insights into products and services that deliver customer and commercial value.
  • Develop product business cases, including target customers, value propositions, use cases, competitive differentiation, revenue potential, and investment requirements.
  • Maintain a prioritized product roadmap aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and company strategy.
  • Establish product success metrics and measure customer adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, retention, and other key business outcomes.
Customer & Market Discovery
  • Partner with customers, prospects, sales, marketing, and business leaders to understand customer needs, pain points, and emerging market opportunities.
  • Conduct product discovery to validate customer problems and determine where data can provide meaningful competitive advantage or business value.
  • Translate customer and market insights into clear product requirements, use cases, and product opportunities.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and evolving expectations for data, analytics, and intelligence products.
  • Establish ongoing customer feedback loops to inform product development and prioritization.
Data Product Development
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and discovery through development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
  • Translate business and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Work closely with data engineering, data science, analytics, software engineering, and technology teams to deliver scalable and reliable data products.
  • Ensure data products are intuitive, actionable, performant, and fit for their intended customer use cases.
  • Balance customer requirements, commercial opportunity, technical feasibility, data availability, and time-to-market when prioritizing product investments.
  • Define and manage product launches, releases, enhancements, and ongoing product improvements.
Data Commercialization & Monetization
  • Identify opportunities to commercialize Reimagined Parking’s data assets through new products, services, insights, APIs, reporting, analytics, and other data-enabled offerings.
  • Partner with commercial leadership to support product positioning, packaging, pricing, sales enablement, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Develop compelling product value propositions that clearly articulate the business outcomes customers can achieve.
  • Evaluate opportunities for new revenue streams and expansion within existing customer relationships.
  • Monitor product and market performance to identify opportunities for growth, product expansion, and improved customer value.
Data-Enabled Business Outcomes
  • Identify opportunities to use commercial data products and analytics to improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency, customer experience, and business decision-making.
  • Establish clear business outcomes and KPIs for data products and measure value delivered after launch.
  • Use product and customer data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization.
  • Partner with internal business teams to ensure insights generated by data products are translated into actionable decisions and measurable outcomes.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Serve as the primary product leader connecting customers, commercial teams, business stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
  • Build strong relationships with sales, marketing, customer success, operations, finance, data engineering, data science, analytics, and software development.
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, priorities, and performance to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional product teams through discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and optimization.
  • Create alignment around product priorities while effectively managing competing stakeholder needs.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Proven experience (2 years) as a Data Product Manager or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of data management, data analytics, and data visualization concepts.
  • Experience with data engineering, science and visualization technologies (e.g. Redshift, DBT, Microsoft Power BI)
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, product management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello), and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience in the parking industry is a plus.

Benefits

Join our team and enjoy an outstanding benefits package, including:

Annual Discretionary Incentive plan: Designed to align pay with performance.

Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy 20 days of paid time off, plus 8 paid holidays, so you can rest and recharge.

Comprehensive Health Plans: Access top-notch Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for you and your family.

Life and Disability Insurance: Company paid basic life and Short-Term Disability to secure your future with essential protection for you and additional options for your loved ones.

401(k) Plan: Benefit from a generous employer match with immediate vesting to help you save for retirement.

Employee Assistance Program: Access behavioral Health Care to assist with personal needs for you and your family members.

Parental and Caregiver Leave: Enjoy time off to support your growing family or care for loved ones

raw.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.
As an Operations Lead, Strategic Growth Initiatives, you will be a strategic operator who brings structure to ambiguity, aligns cross-functional teams, and moves high-priority growth initiatives from idea to execution. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will work across Product, Go-To-Market, Operations, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and leadership to strengthen how In Tandem executes. You will move fluidly between strategy and hands-on implementation, using AI as a practical tool to increase speed, quality, and operating leverage.

What you will accomplish:

  • Run a tight executive operating cadence, including weekly leadership meetings, monthly business reviews, board preparation, leadership offsites, and the metrics and narratives that anchor decision-making.
  • Turn company goals into clear operating frameworks such as OKRs and KPIs, surface risks early, and drive follow-through on decisions and commitments.
  • Evaluate and execute partnership and business development opportunities through market mapping, research, opportunity sizing, diligence, outreach preparation, testing, and execution planning.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional special projects that matter to company growth, from strategic analyses and process redesigns to product launches, commercial experiments, and new-market opportunities.
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate research, synthesis, planning, documentation, communication, and workflow design; build lightweight AI-enabled workflows, prompts, templates, and internal tools that help teams move faster.
  • Create repeatable playbooks, dashboards, launch plans, operating metrics, and other systems that improve clarity, accountability, speed, and measurement as the company grows.

Who you are:

  • A high-ownership operator who is energized by ambiguity and can create structure without waiting for perfectly defined responsibilities.
  • A structured, analytical problem-solver with strong business judgment who can move from sizing an opportunity to making sure the right follow-ups actually happen.
  • A trusted cross-functional partner who builds credibility across Product, GTM, Operations, Finance, Legal, Partnerships, and leadership.
  • Action-oriented and comfortable getting into the details; you care as much about implementation and outcomes as you do about the quality of the strategy.
  • Curious and pragmatic about AI, with a habit of actively using new tools to improve your own work and the way teams operate.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience across strategy, operations, product operations, business operations, growth, partnerships, consulting, investing, banking, or a similarly high-ownership environment.
  • Ideally, a mix of strategy training and meaningful operating experience inside a company—for example, consulting or investing followed by 1–2 years in an operations, growth, product, partnerships, or business role.
  • Experience in SaaS, consumer technology, marketplaces, healthcare technology, fintech, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving environments while managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting product launches, GTM initiatives, strategic partnerships, commercial experiments, or growth projects.
  • High comfort with AI tools and genuine curiosity about how AI can improve business operations, productivity, and decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience working closely with Product and Engineering; partnerships, BD, channel strategy, or ecosystem development; automation/workflow platforms such as Claude, Notion AI, Airtable, or Zapier; and building dashboards, operating metrics, launch plans, internal playbooks, or executive reporting.
What we're not looking for:
  • Someone who has only advised from the outside and has not owned execution inside a company.
  • Someone who is purely a project manager without strong strategic, analytical, or commercial judgment.
  • Someone who is interested in AI only conceptually, but does not actively use AI tools in their own work.
  • Someone who needs highly defined responsibilities and struggles with ambiguity.
  • Someone who produces strategy documents but does not enjoy driving implementation.
Why Join?
We’re redefining family technology.
In Tandem brings together a growing portfolio of trusted tools that support families, and the professionals who guide them, through the moments that matter most. We bring clarity to chaos and stability to daily family life, helping parents feel less stressed so kids can have healthier childhoods.
Scale meets startup energy.
With more than 20 years of impact and a strong market presence, we’re entering a bold new chapter of growth. We have the foundation, the momentum, and the ambition to go further: expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and elevating the tools families and professionals rely on every day.
Purpose-driven. Performance-focused. People-first.
Our culture is rooted in accountability, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, thoughtful problem-solving, and teammates who care deeply about building something that matters.
How We Support You:
  • Medical: In Tandem pays 100% of the premium for employees AND 99% for all additional family members
  • 401k: Up to a 4% match with immediate vesting
  • Paid leave for all new parents

  • Personal Time Off: 15 days for 0-1 years of employment + 20 days for 1-3 years of employment
  • Supportive and flexible working environment – work from anywhere!
Come As You Are!
In Tandem provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal.

What you'll do

  • Own positioning and messaging execution. Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations.

  • Build and maintain competitive intelligence. Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns.

  • Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences.

  • Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback.

  • Drive product launches and releases. Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers.

  • Fuel demand and thought leadership. Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives.

  • Be the voice of the market internally. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging.

What you'll bring

  • 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories.

  • Proven ability to market to economic buyers: you write for CFOs, CIOs/CTOs, and COOs in the language of cost, productivity, working capital, and EBIT - not features.

  • Strong competitive instincts: experience building battlecards and positioning in crowded categories, and translating technical differentiation into commercial arguments.

  • A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts.

  • Analytical rigor: comfortable with win/loss analysis, market and analyst research, and grounding messaging claims in defensible evidence.

  • Excellent writing and presentation craft in English; German is a strong plus for our DACH-concentrated customer base.

  • Enough technical depth to understand ERP processes, AI agents, and enterprise integration well enough to challenge product - and simplify it for buyers.

What you'll get

  • Category-defining work. Agentic process automation is being defined now, and you will shape how the market understands it.

  • Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises.

  • Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives.

  • A company at an inflection point. It has a strong European base, fresh US market entry, and a proven platform to build the story on.

raw.title: Database and Infrastructure Engineer
raw.excerpt: The Database Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day administration, performance and resilience of the Microsoft SQL Server estate.
raw.description:
The Database Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day administration, performance and resilience of the Microsoft SQL Server estate. This estate supports the software platform we provide to our customers, as well as our internal systems. The role also supports the Windows and Active Directory infrastructure around it. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role in a regulated financial services environment. Our platform is directly accessed by customers and connected to third-party trading, settlement and market data services.

The successful candidate will bring strong SQL Server database administration skills together with solid Windows Server, Active Directory and Azure experience. They will be comfortable owning business-critical database changes and migrations end-to-end, working directly with customers, and producing high-quality documentation for the wider team and for our audit and compliance obligations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administering and supporting the Microsoft SQL Server estate, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades and day-to-day operational support
  • Maintaining our SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery configurations, including Always On availability groups and failover clustering
  • Monitoring and tuning database performance, including query optimisation, indexing, statistics and capacity planning
  • Managing database security, logins, roles and permissions in line with least-privilege principles and audit requirements
  • Designing, running and maintaining SQL Agent jobs, maintenance plans and database integrity checks
  • Testing and maintaining backups and DR processes (including invocation testing) so they meet contracted RPO/RTO obligations
  • Supporting database migrations and upgrades, including moving workloads towards Azure-native services where appropriate
  • Administering and maintaining Active Directory, including trusts, Kerberos delegation (including SQL Server SPNs and service accounts), certificate services and certificate lifecycle management
  • Administering the Windows Server and IIS infrastructure that hosts our platform, including routine patching and maintenance
  • Maintaining our software and associated components on Third Platform Services (TPS)
  • Working alongside group information security to make sure the database and server estate is configured and maintained in line with security policies, control frameworks and audit requirements, and helping to fix any risks and vulnerabilities found
  • Responding to IT audit and customer due-diligence information requests and providing supporting evidence
  • Managing relationships with third-party vendors and suppliers, including technical liaison, escalations and coordinating delivery of changes
  • Producing and maintaining clear technical documentation, runbooks and knowledgebase articles to support the team and meet audit requirements
  • Monitoring and responding to alerts from the database, infrastructure and monitoring platforms
  • Out-of-hours work for routine maintenance and occasional project work
  • Working on other IT projects relating to databases, infrastructure and security as required
  • Contributing to team planning

Key attributes and Skills

Essential
  • Proven experience in a similar technical role, with a significant focus on Microsoft SQL Server database administration
  • Experience in an environment providing and supporting B2B customer-facing technology
  • Experience working within a regulated or externally audited industry, with an understanding of contractual obligations and control frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 / ISAE 3402 / AAF, and CIS benchmarks/controls (or equivalents such as NIST)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivated, and capable of tackling complex projects either on their own or as part of a team
  • Able to work collaboratively across different departments/teams with differing technical capabilities, and with external customers and vendors, to deliver effective solutions
  • Microsoft SQL Server administration in production environments, ideally SQL Server 2022: installation and patching, backup/restore and point-in-time recovery, security/permissions, SQL Agent job management, and performance tuning (query optimisation, indexing, execution plans)
  • Proficiency in T-SQL for writing, reviewing and troubleshooting queries, stored procedures and maintenance scripts
  • Strong Windows Server administration
  • Advanced Active Directory administration, including trusts, Kerberos delegation and certificate management
  • Knowledge of Windows-based IIS application administration
  • PowerShell scripting
  • Experience with backup and DR tools and processes
  • Strong documentation skills and experience managing third-party vendors/suppliers

Desirable
  • SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery design: e.g. Always On availability groups, clustering, log shipping
  • Azure SQL experience: Azure SQL Database and/or Azure SQL Managed Instance, including migration from SQL Server on VMs
  • Basic Microsoft Azure administration: VMs, storage, networking fundamentals and resource management
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM administration
  • ADFS administration
  • Redgate SQL Monitor (or similar SQL monitoring/tooling, e.g. the wider Redgate toolset)
  • PostgreSQL administration
  • Microsoft BizTalk Server administration
  • Microsoft SharePoint Server administration
  • Fortinet/FortiGate firewall administration
  • Experience with PRTG, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms
  • Atlassian suite: Jira ticketing and project management, Confluence documentation
  • Industry-specific experience: payment/settlement gateways (e.g. CREST/Euroclear), trading interfaces, CASS, and similar financial-market infrastructure
  • Wealth management / stockbroking domain knowledge

A little about us 
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.

People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too. 

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact. 

Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work. 

Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus 
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion. 
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector. 

More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development. 

At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

  • Be Innovative

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why we’re hiring:

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth – from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

This year alone, we launched 5 new products – home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.

As our business expands, we have a growing list of ideas but not enough people to execute them. This role exists to close that gap. We are looking for 2-3 Product Managers to work directly with, and be mentored by, our Cofounder/CEO (2x YC founder), and work on building or scaling one of our new product verticals.

raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
raw.excerpt: At EIS, DevOps ownership spans the complete path from cloud foundation to a running application.
raw.description:
At EIS, DevOps ownership spans the complete path from cloud foundation to a running application. We are looking for a senior, hands-on engineer who can connect AWS infrastructure, secure networking, platform services, CI/CD, and application deployment into one reliable delivery system.
You will design and provision AWS environments, automate configuration, build delivery pipelines, deploy and configure EIS Suite applications, operate Kubernetes workloads, and troubleshoot issues across the stack. You will work closely with developers, QA engineers, architects, project managers, and customers. This role offers genuine end-to-end ownership, influence over technical standards, and the opportunity to mentor other engineers. EIS One Suite is delivered as a SaaS product, so your decisions directly influence the availability, security, scalability, performance, observability, release experience, and cloud efficiency that customers depend on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own solutions end to end - from AWS infrastructure and network design through CI/CD, application configuration, deployment, observability, and production support.
  • Design and evolve secure, highly available AWS environments, including customer connectivity and hybrid-cloud integrations.
  • Build reusable Terraform modules and maintain clean, reviewed, version-controlled infrastructure code with controlled change and minimal drift.
  • Design, improve, and operate Jenkins delivery pipelines and their GitLab integrations, including pipeline-as-code and Groovy-based automation.
  • Deploy and operate containerized services on Amazon EKS using Docker, Helm, and YAML-based configuration.
  • Automate Linux and platform configuration with Ansible, including the installation and lifecycle of services such as GitLab, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube, and OpenGrok.
  • Operate GitOps-based EIS Suite deployments across development, pre-production, and production environments through Argo CD, using GitLab as the configuration source and cloud-hosted Helm and container registries as artifact sources.
  • Implement and troubleshoot AWS networking, DNS, load balancing, identity, permissions, and secure access using least-privilege principles.
  • Build actionable monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts; lead diagnosis of complex incidents across cloud, platform, pipeline, and application-delivery layers.
  • Embed security and quality controls into automation, including privileged access, secrets handling, code quality, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Improve engineering standards, create clear operational guidance, review technical solutions, and mentor less experienced engineers.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to improve automation, code quality, documentation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows, with appropriate security, review, and human oversight.
  • Help evolve the internal developer platform as a shared cross-department capability: gather feedback from engineering and delivery teams, contribute reusable self-service patterns and platform improvements, and share ownership of adoption and outcomes across departments.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

We look for depth in AWS cloud and platform engineering, supported by strong hands-on capability across the adjacent delivery lifecycle. Equal mastery of every tool is not required; what matters is the ability to own, deploy, and troubleshoot EIS Suite environments end to end and to deepen adjacent skills.
Core dept
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Deep practical knowledge of AWS architecture and services, including EKS, IAM, VPC, Security Groups, Route 53, load balancers, EC2, S3, EBS, RDS, and ElastiCache.
  • Strong production experience with Terraform, including module design, state management, code review, and safe infrastructure change.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, building, troubleshooting, and maintaining Jenkins pipelines, including pipeline-as-code and Groovy automation.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of GitLab as a source-control platform, including repository configuration, access controls, merge-request workflows and code reviews, and integration with Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid Linux administration and networking knowledge, including routing, DNS, firewalls, VPN/IPsec, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Strong adjacent capability
  • Hands-on experience with Argo CD and GitOps-based deployment of EIS Suite applications across Kubernetes environments.
  • Strong Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm skills, including deployment configuration, troubleshooting, scaling, and high-availability considerations.
  • Practical experience with Ansible for repeatable software installation and configuration management.
  • Strong Git skills and the ability to automate with Bash and/or Python.
  • Working knowledge of Java application build and delivery ecosystems, including tools such as Maven, and familiarity with artifact repositories.
  • A systems-thinking approach to production troubleshooting, with the ability to follow a problem across multiple technical layers and drive it to resolution.
  • Clear communication, sound technical judgment, and experience collaborating across teams; mentoring or technical leadership experience is expected at senior level.
Broader awareness and useful experience (nice to have)
  • Experience with AWS CloudFormation or AWS CLI in addition to Terraform.
  • Experience with Azure or IBM Cloud and an interest in applying common engineering standards across cloud platforms.
  • Experience with Grafana, Grafana Loki, Prometheus, ELK, or comparable observability platforms.
  • Experience with Datadog for infrastructure and application monitoring, dashboards, alerting, and troubleshooting including configuration of Datadog Application Performance Monitoring (APM) configuration.
  • Experience with CyberArk or another privileged access management platform.
  • Experience with SonarQube, Nexus, OpenGrok, or similar engineering enablement tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Relevant AWS, Kubernetes, security, or infrastructure-as-code certifications.

raw.description:
At Zappi we take pride in helping some of the world's most influential companies transform the way they approach insights. We’re developing tools and programs around them that allow our customers to be more proactive and strategic in the way they test and learn. Ultimately, helping them in creating more effective advertising and launching more successful products.
The Customer Success team at Zappi is growing! We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager who is passionate about delivering outstanding value to your customers. You will have empathy for our customers, a passion for advocating for them internally and will thrive on partnering with them to deliver on their business goals. You focus on value extraction, customer experience, retention, and working cross functionally to deliver success and growth to our customers and Zappi.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Value – As a Senior Customer Success Manager, your #1 goal will be to make sure that our customers are extracting the most possible value from our platform and want to use it more for their research needs. You will partner with customers to identify their objectives and achieve their desired outcomes and identify and resolve any blockers to success.
  • Customer Onboarding and Training – Working closely with the Sales and Implementation team, you will be responsible for ensuring that users achieve return on investment quickly and are regularly trained on the latest and greatest that Zappi has to offer.
  • Tool/Platform Expert – You will need to be an expert on all of our tools and our platform so that you can advise customers on the best possible solutions and optimisations to achieve their business goals, and enable users from all areas of the customer’s org.
  • Account Retention and Growth - You will retain and grow the revenue within your book of business, effectively resolving churn risks and partnering with Sales, Professional Services, and Marketing to identify and facilitate opportunities for expansion. You are able to drive deep discovery to surface cross-sell and up-sell opportunities centered around driving customer outcomes.
  • Relationship Building- In order to be successful within the role, it will be crucial that you build strong relationships based on honesty and trust, both with your customers as well as internal stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, Product). You will build connections across multiple layers of mid-market and Enterprise organisations. You are also comfortable managing user and executive relationships across your customer organizations.
  • Customer Advocate - You will need to represent the voice of our customers within our organisation so that we are building and moving in the direction that will give the customer greater value. You will effectively communicate with product, marketing, sales, professional services, and engineering to deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Change agent - We are market disruptors, which means our CSMs must be effective change agents. You bring customers along new ways of working, helping them adopt, adapt, and evolve so they — and their organizations - become more successful as a result.
  • Proactive Mindset - As you navigate your book of business, you will need to be able to work creatively to identify opportunities for growth, value and retention. These proactive solutions require creative problem solving and a desire to think “outside of the box”. You will be able to quickly assess your customers, understand where their challenges are, and craft a comprehensive plan for them.
  • Data Driven - As a company that revolves around data, we expect our team members to be comfortable using data to inform your decision making. You understand how to work strategically, tracking customer health, identifying growth opportunities, and maintaining close tabs on each of your customers as you navigate their customer journey. Data is a tool you can use effectively to drive your proactive motions.
  • Process Scaling - You know how to take ownership of and coordinate initiatives that improve our business and the success of our customers. You can articulate a problem and business need, put together a clear and comprehensive plan, and execute against it. You know how to work cross-functionally and maintain clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Team Coaching - We expect our Senior Customer Success Managers to set a tone of excellence across our global team. They are responsible for some of our largest customers and have the opportunity to lead large process improvements. They work to elevate their peers by offering peer coaching while setting an example of what a great CS team member should be.

Who are you?
You are dedicated to helping customers maximise the value they get from every interaction with Zappi. You are a self-starter with the ability to juggle multiple conflicting priorities, you are able to provide high-quality and responsive customer service, while being a change agent; you are solution-focused, and you are able to proactively identify opportunities that drive the adoption of Zappi.

Senior Customer Success Managers will gain exposure to the inner workings of a growing company, learn how major brands use market research to drive their businesses forward, and influence how research can be used more effectively.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • 5+ years working in Customer Success and/or Account Management roles within the Consumer Insights or Market Research space.
  • Experience and interest in technology, marketing, market research, consumer insights, and contributing to the growth of large organizations
  • Experience managing a complex larger scale book of business comprised of mid market and enterprise customers valued at $5MM+
  • Proficiency in Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools like Salesforce, and/or Customer Success Platforms (CSP) like Gainsight
  • Deep knowledge of all G-Suite products as well as other tools like Loom, Gong, ChatGPT, and/or other AI driven tools
  • You have proven track of record completing projects with measurable results, scaling internal process and improving business outcomes
  • Ability to travel across the United States to support customer on-site visits on average one or more times per month
  • Comfortable working in a SaaS and consumption based environment
  • Experience crafting detailed customer success plans and delivering business reviews
  • Comfortable leading deep discovery to identify cross sell and up sell opportunities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to ensure clear and impactful interactions with customers and stakeholders
  • Highly responsive while maintaining attention to detail
  • Strong team player, able to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders and also able to take ownership of tasks
  • Able to prioritize a customer-centric approach, aiming to foster lasting relationships and positive customer experiences
  • Comfortable working with tight deadlines while delivering results that contribute to overall objectives
  • Maintain composure in high-pressure situations, ensuring effective problem-solving and decision-making
  • Based in and around Boston, Massachusetts and able to travel to visit clients when necessary as well as participate in internal workshops, quarterly business reviews and team offsites. Expectation of customer travel is a minimum of once per month on average.

Job Benefits

  • Salary range $110,000 - $125,000 USD OTE per annum (consists of 80% base salary + 20% variable bonus which is uncapped). Variable pay is eligible after onboarding. Salaries are benchmarked annually.
  • Unlimited vacation time – we want well rested and motivated teams so encourage people to take plenty of time off. We don’t cap your allowance, but do set a minimum of at least 20 days per year plus national holidays
  • One company-paid mental health day each quarter. These are pre-scheduled, so the entire company can take the same days off regularly to reset
  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote (unless otherwise specified)
  • Thoughtfully designed offices to support both individual work and collaboration without interrupting others
  • Personal development budget – each year we allocate funds for our team members to further develop their skills that will benefit our business and customers
  • Budget to support setting up your home office, if appropriate (chair + desk, etc)
  • Wellbeing benefits and access to trained therapists / counsellors
  • Company paid Life, AD&D, Short term & Long term disability
  • Immediate access to Zappi's Health, Dental and Vision Insurance Plan

  • Tailored personal development through coaching, mentorship and career frameworks
Why join us?
We’ve been recognized as one of the hottest martech companies in 2022 by Business Insider and named Best Place to Work by Quirk’s Media for our engaging and inclusive workplace culture. We’re committed to both people and the planet.
Our belief in inclusion means we’re building an organisation of diverse individuals and helping brands eliminate cultural presumptions in their research. Read our Diversity Manifesto here.
We are a values and behaviours driven business and believe that Trust, Truth, Ownership, Ambition and Humility describe Zappi employees on our best day. This is how we strive to show up for our customers, for each other and for our communities.
Earning B Corp certification assures us we’re on the right track and have structures in place to become the business we want to be.
Our commitment to minimise our impact on the environment means being honest with ourselves and transparent with you—about everything from carbon emissions to tree-planting initiatives. We achieved our goal of becoming Net Zero in 2021!

Equal Opportunity
Zappi is an equal opportunity employer; our diversity is a major strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

raw.description:
You're not running a classroom. You're building the EAs our clients count on, one person at a time.
Why does this role exist?

You're an in-house Magic employee, full-time from day one, and not a freelance or client-placed role.

Every EA who steps in front of a client has to be ready, not "probably ready," actually ready. That's what you're here for. You run the sessions that turn new hires into confident, capable Executive Assistants, and you're the one who calls it when someone is or isn't there yet.
This isn't about lecturing from a slide deck. You're facilitating, assessing, coaching, and constantly tightening the program itself because "how we've always done it" isn't good enough if it's not producing EAs who can hold their own with US clients.
You'll work closely with the Assistant Training Manager, but the day-to-day judgment calls, including how a session goes, whether someone's ready for their mock client call, and what feedback actually lands, are yours.

What Winning Looks Like
  • You run daily virtual sessions that trainees rate as clear, engaging, and genuinely useful, not just "completed."
  • You grade every assessment against the rubric, not your gut, and your calls hold up under review.
  • You synthesize checkpoint scores, mock interviews, and day-to-day notes into a readiness call that's right more often than not.
  • You flag performance risks and program gaps early before they become a trainee's problem in front of a client.
  • You ship at least one program improvement a quarter that measurably moves engagement or retention.

What You'll Actually Do

Training Facilitation Trainee Readiness
  • You lead daily, trainer-led virtual sessions for each assigned batch, and you keep every scrap of training documentation accurate and current. You run rubric-based assessments at each stage of the program, graded on defined criteria, not impression, and you resolve trainee questions and concerns as they come up, on the spot.
EA Assessment Coaching
  • You run mock client intro calls and mock interviews to pressure-test readiness beyond checkpoint scores, then pull all of it, such as checkpoints, mock performance, and facilitation notes, into one clear readiness read per trainee. Experience with security compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar; relevant cybersecurity certifications are a plus.

The Business Analyst, Veeva Migration will support the planning, execution, validation, and post-go-live stabilization of Veeva Vault eTMF migration initiatives. This role requires a strong understanding of clinical operations, Trial Master File processes, document metadata, data migration activities, and GxP-compliant system delivery. The analyst will work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, validation partners, migration vendors, and Veeva platform specialists to ensure accurate, compliant, and business-ready migration of eTMF data and documents into Veeva Vault Clinical Operations.

Business Analyst, Veeva Migration Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Clinical Operations, TMF, Quality, IT, and vendor teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for Veeva eTMF migration activities.
  • Support migration planning, including scope definition, source-to-target mapping, metadata review, document classification, audit trail handling, and migration readiness activities.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, test scenarios, and traceability documentation.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to support data extraction, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and verification of eTMF documents and related metadata.
  • Assist with validation activities, including IQ/OQ/UAT planning, test script development, execution support, defect tracking, and evidence review for GxP systems.
  • Support Veeva Vault configuration discussions related to document types, lifecycles, workflows, roles, permissions, metadata, Expected Document Lists, and TMF Reference Model alignment.

  • Prepare and maintain project deliverables such as requirements documentation, migration specifications, test evidence, defect logs, support plans, and operational readiness materials.
  • Support go-live, hypercare, transition to support, and post-migration issue triage to ensure business continuity and user adoption.

Requirements:

  • Strong understanding of Trial Master File processes, TMF Reference Model, document completeness, inspection readiness, audit trails, and clinical document lifecycle management.
  • Experience working in regulated life sciences environments with knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, validation, change control, and data integrity expectations.
  • Ability to document functional requirements, business process flows, data mapping rules, test cases, traceability matrices, and migration-related deliverables.
  • Experience supporting UAT, defect management, production readiness, go-live planning, and hypercare support.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience migrating content from legacy eTMF systems such as IQVIA eTMF or other clinical document repositories into Veeva Vault.
  • Familiarity with Veeva Vault Loader, migration-center tools, bulk loading processes, and document migration utilities.
  • Experience with ALM, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar tools for requirements, testing, change management, and defect tracking.

We Also Walk Dogs needs you to help our clients win fights to make the world a better place.

Our product, ActionKit (actionk.it), is used by dozens of major progressive groups and not-for-profits to stay in touch with tens of millions of online supporters. Our clients use ActionKit to fight climate change, push back against corporate power and more.

We've already begun moving our stack from on-premises servers to AWS, and need a DevOps engineer to help us take that effort to the next level. If you'd like to work at the intersection of cool cloud tech and making a better world, this is the job for you.

ActionKit is built by We Also Walk Dogs. Named after a Robert Heinlein story about a company that specialized in solving impossible problems, We Also Walk Dogs has spent over a decade serving online progressive organizations and charities. We're a small, friendly, and clever company. And we all work remotely.

Is this the job for you?

  • Do you keep production systems running? According to our external monitoring, we've kept 99.98% uptime this past year, and gone three months without downtime, while very actively working on the product. We need someone with the expertise and discipline to help us keep that going.
  • Do you think in the cloud? After starting with a fully on-premises deployment, today we're serving millions of end-users from AWS. But we know that intelligently deploying new tools and cloud capabilities can help us do things we could never do with just a rack of servers, and we need a DevOps engineer who can take us there.
  • Can you can wear a lot of hats? We're a small company and not much for bureaucratic divisions. The boss codes; the project manager gives sales demos; most everyone, including you, does a shift of at least a few hours each week answering our clients' support tickets.

If this sounds like you, please apply!

Must haves:

  • You need to care about maintaining a high-quality deployment. We've kept our uptime record with solid automation and monitoring, jumping on oddities before they become problems, and digging into root causes when things go wrong. We need you to be able to continue that tradition.
  • You need vision as well as execution. We need you to not only keep things running smoothly, but also help lead us where we need to go next. You need expertise in modern tools and AWS capabilities, and a strategic sense of how we can use them for efficiency, manageability, performance, and reliability.
  • You need to be in touch with others' needs. We're a small, tight-knit crew where everyone pitches in. Empathy with clients and end-users is also core to our business. Everyone on the team works directly with clients.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with all-remote teams.
  • Experience with Django, MySQL, and Ansible.
  • Experience with AWS features and patterns like VPCs, ELBs, SQS, auto-scaling groups, multi-zone deployments, and so on.
  • That said, experience with our stack is maybe the least important factor here; Even if you've used Rails instead of Django, Postgres instead of MySQL, or Azure instead of AWS, we want to hear from you.

Why work for us?

  • Competitive salary. We are a self-funded, for-profit company.
  • Remote work. Hours and location are flexible as long as you get the work done. In this day and age you shouldn't have to relocate to San Francisco for awesome work.
  • Four weeks paid time off. We encourage you to take vacation; we are not the sort of workplace that pressures anyone into 60-hour weeks.
  • A free, great health insurance policy and 401(k)
  • Work with an awesome team for awesome causes.

Description

At Ledgebrook, we’re building a next-generation insurance infrastructure - fast, smart, and scalable - and are looking for a Director of Underwriting to join Stonehaven Specialty Insurance Company, Ledgebrook’s new third-party hybrid fronting carrier.

This role reports to the Chief Programs Officer (CPO) and owns underwriting quality and discipline across the full program book, setting and enforcing underwriting appetite and guidelines, and supervising the Underwriting Manager(s) who handle day-to-day program-level underwriting oversight.

About the Role

Stonehaven is seeking a Director of Underwriting to set and enforce underwriting appetite and guidelines across all programs, supervise the Underwriting Manager(s) who handle day-to-day program-level oversight, and serve as the senior underwriting authority in new-program due diligence and BAA negotiations. The successful candidate will bring deep delegated-authority/MGA-oversight underwriting experience and a track record setting guidelines and appetite for a book of business, not just executing within them.

What You'll Do:

  • ﻿Set and maintain enterprise underwriting appetite, standards, and guidelines across all programs, in coordination with the CPO and CRO’s Actuarial function.
  • Supervise and develop the Underwriting Manager(s); review their program-level underwriting audits and sign off on findings that need escalation.
  • Own the underwriting side of new-program due diligence (“underwrite the underwriter”) jointly with Business Development, escalating go/no-go recommendations to the CPO.
  • Serve as the senior underwriting authority in BAA negotiations — binding authority limits, referral thresholds, and underwriting guideline provisions — working with Legal on final language.
  • Track underwriting audit findings to remediation across the book and report portfolio-level underwriting quality trends to the CPO.
  • Coordinate with Actuarial and Claims on loss experience, emerging trends, and guideline changes across programs.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

﻿Need to Haves:

  • Track record setting underwriting guidelines and appetite for a book of business, not just executing within them.
  • Experience negotiating binding authority agreement underwriting terms directly with program partners.

Nice to Haves:

  • ﻿CPCU, AU, or equivalent underwriting designation.
  • Prior fronting-carrier, program administrator, or MGA-side underwriting leadership experience.
  • Experience across multiple lines of business relevant to Stonehaven’s target programs.

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

  • We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top-level view across the board with our monthly & quarterly town hall meetings.
  • A highly inclusive work culture that promotes a relaxed, creative and productive environment.
  • Practice autonomy, open communication, growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work-life balance
