Description

As a Lead Paid Search Strategist, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic SEM campaigns to drive online visibility, website traffic, and conversions for our clients. You will lead a team of Paid Search Strategists, collaborate with innovative & transformative digital health and e-commerce clients, and leverage industry best practices to achieve outstanding results. Your role involves analyzing data, staying updated on SEM trends, and continually optimizing campaigns to meet and exceed client goals.

Job Responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Campaign Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute SEM strategies in line with client objectives. Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis. Create and manage campaign budgets and forecasts. Develop a robust testing roadmap and ensure the continuous evolution of the client’s SEM programs. Develop comprehensive Quarterly Business Reports (QBRs) with the team that includes highlights of the last quarter and top testing priorities for the upcoming quarter. Stay informed about industry trends, algorithm updates, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge.
  • Campaign Execution: Create, optimize, and manage PPC (Pay-Per-Click) campaigns on platforms like Google Ads, Bing Ads, and others. Write and optimize ad copy for maximum click-through rates (CTR). Set up and optimize landing pages for conversion rate optimization (CRO). Implement A/B tests and other optimization strategies
  • Team Management: Lead and mentor a team of Paid Search Strategists. Delegate tasks, set performance goals, and provide guidance. Conduct team meetings and training sessions.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Monitor and analyze campaign performance using various analytics tools. Generate regular reports to track KPIs and campaign effectiveness. Provide insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Client Communication: Maintain regular communication with clients to understand their business goals and objectives. Present campaign results, insights, and recommendations to clients. Address client queries and concerns promptly.
  • Stay Updated: Stay informed about industry trends and updates in search engine algorithms. Recommend and implement new strategies and tools as needed.

Additional Information:

  • This role may require occasional travel to meet with clients or attend industry conferences
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing client needs and industry trends is essential.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or related field (Master's preferred).
  • Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaign management.
  • Experience managing enterprise-level e-commerce paid media, including feed managment
  • Certification in Google Ads and other relevant digital advertising platforms
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Leadership and team management experience.
  • Proficiency in SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is a plus.
  • Familiarity with web analytics tools like Google Analytics.

Benefits

Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.

Boxer Benefits

Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.

  • Health Insurance
  • 401(k) & Retirement Savings
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Scheduling
  • Remote-First Culture
  • Professional Development
  • Employee Referral Program
  • And more!

Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.

At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.

We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.

Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.

raw.title: Staff Information Security Engineer - AI First
raw.excerpt: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences.
raw.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

Rithum is embedding AI into every corner of how it operates — and security is no exception.

As a Staff AI-First Information Security Engineer, you own the intersection of AI adoption and information security: designing guardrails for AI-powered products, building automated security tooling, designing security controls and monitoring for an AI-First workforce, helping every team at Rithum move fast without creating risk they cannot see. This is not a typical security role. You spend as much time building and automating as you do reviewing, turning a repeating control into infrastructure-as-code, a manual review into a workflow, and a vague AI risk into a concrete, enforced guardrails. You work autonomously, balancing research with fast-paced delivery, and collaborating closely with Platform Engineering, IT, Security Champions, and external auditors.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the bridge between architectural intent and operational reality; mediate conflicts between security requirements and feasible implementation, propose compensating controls where gaps exist and help register, track and remediate residual risks.
  • Implement preventive, default-on security controls across cloud and enterprise environments, codified as policy- and infrastructure-as-code so security is enforced by design, including controls that govern how AI tools and models may be used.
  • Implement and enforce identity and access controls to an agreed standard, including access boundaries for AI systems and non-human/agent identities by partnering with Platform Engineering and IT to align tooling and policy to the architecture.
  • Assist in maintaining the InfoSec risk register; track emerging threats and translate them into actionable guidance for engineering teams.
  • Support third-party and vendor risk assessments, with a focus on vendors who process data through AI pipelines.
  • Automate repetitive security workflows (evidence collection, access reviews, alert enrichment) and build or operate AI-assisted security agents — with human-in-the-loop approval gates, least-privilege credentials, and explicit attention to each agent's own blast radius.
  • Integrate security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, DAST/SAST, vulnerability scanners) with LLM layers to surface actionable insight and automated responses.
  • Define and enforce security requirements for AI-powered features: model access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, output validation, and data-handling boundaries.
  • Conduct threat modelling on agentic and LLM-based systems, accounting for novel attack surfaces such as tool misuse, indirect prompt injection, and supply chain risk.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of security engineering experience with demonstrated AI/ML security depth (prompt injection, model supply chain, adversarial inputs, RAG).
  • Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) and LLM frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or similar) to accelerate and elevate your work.
  • Hands-on identity and access expertise across modern enterprise and cloud identity stacks, including access models for AI systems and non-human identities.
  • Infrastructure and policy-as-code (e.g. Terraform, OPA/Rego) and proficiency in a scripting language for automation (Python preferred).
  • Cloud security expertise: AWS Solutions Architect / Security Specialty or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including multi-account governance, preventive guardrails, and policy-as-code.

raw.description:
Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve. We bring together world-class clinicians, technologists, and autism specialists to build cutting-edge AI tools that help care teams work smarter and spend more time with the children and families who need them most.

The Community Health Worker (CHW) operates within the New Mexico Department of Health (NMDOH) Community Health Worker Scope of Work and plays an essential role in connecting families with ABA services, supporting client engagement, and fostering community partnerships.

The CHW provides culturally responsive outreach, coordination, and family-centered education so that every family has the support they need to begin and sustain services with FronteraCare.

The CHW serves as the primary intake representative for an assigned group of families, providing consistent support and communication from initial referral through completion of the intake process. They partner closely with the Intake and Scheduling teams to help families move smoothly toward evaluation and service start, making sure no one gets lost between referral and the first appointment.

Beyond intake, the CHW provides ongoing case management for these families. This means understanding each family’s needs, connecting them with community resources, and building trusting relationships that continue well after services begin.

Intake & Referral Coordination

  • Serve as the primary intake representative for an assigned group of families, providing consistent communication and support from initial referral through completion of the intake process.

  • Conduct proactive outreach and follow-up with new leads and referrals — via calls, texts, and emails — to reduce backlog and help families move from initial inquiry toward evaluation scheduling.

  • Partner with Intake Specialists, the Family Intake Coordinator, and Care Liaison to coordinate evaluation scheduling, required documentation, and next steps for assigned families.

  • Help families understand what to expect during the intake process, including evaluations, required documentation, and timelines.

  • Track intake progress for assigned families and flag delays or barriers to the Intake team.

Case Management

  • Serve as the ongoing point of contact for assigned families once intake is complete, continuing the relationship built during referral and onboarding.

  • Conduct monthly outreach to each assigned family to check in on how services are going and how the family is doing overall, including factors beyond therapy that may affect their engagement and stability.

  • Identify barriers facing each family, such as housing, food security, transportation, financial hardship, and emergency needs, and connect them with community, state, and local resources.

  • Follow up on referrals and resource connections to confirm families received the support they need, and adjust as circumstances change.

  • Provide timely support between scheduled check-ins as needs arise.

  • Partner with the care team and Care Liaison to address non-clinical barriers to care, including attendance and access challenges, and share relevant family context to support service continuity.

  • Help families navigate insurance and benefits, including Medicaid reapplication and coverage changes that could interrupt services.

  • Document all family contacts, identified needs, referrals, and follow-up in accordance with organizational and NMDOH CHW standards.

Clinical Quality

  • Coordinate client referrals, assessments, and onboarding for families on FronteraCare’s waitlist.

  • Support families in understanding the ABA process, clinical goals, and care expectations.

  • Assist with ongoing service coordination, including client scheduling and follow-up support.

  • Engage families who have paused services or experience frequent cancellations to identify and address barriers to care.

  • Promote adherence to treatment recommendations and consistent participation in services.

  • Operate within NMDOH Community Health Worker Scope of Work, contributing to:

    • Community outreach and engagement

    • Care coordination and case management

    • Home-based and community support

    • Health promotion, training, and system navigation

Professional and Ethical Conduct

  • Maintain confidentiality, discretion, and professional boundaries in all interactions with clients and colleagues.

  • Follow all Frontera Health policies and applicable state and federal regulations.

  • Demonstrate integrity and ethical behavior consistent with NMDOH CHW standards and ABA service expectations.

  • Uphold a strengths-based, family-centered approach in all work.

  • Accurately document all outreach, case coordination, and family interactions.

Communication and Family Interaction

  • Serve as a trusted liaison between FronteraCare, clients, and community partners.

  • Provide clear, empathetic, and culturally responsive communication to families.

  • Educate families on the benefits of ABA therapy, service processes, and available community resources.

  • Support families through changes in service status (e.g., on hold, paused services, or new onboarding).

  • Reinforce family understanding of care plans and encourage collaboration with clinical staff.

  • Facilitate translation and interpretation as needed to enhance understanding and engagement.

  • Support full alignment with FronteraCare’s technology platforms, including assessment tools and digital phenotyping systems; ensure families are actively engaged in providing consent, using the parent training app, and understanding video-based technology.

  • Utilize technology to enhance family engagement, monitor adherence to digital protocols, and identify opportunities for additional guidance or support.

Leadership and Mentorship

  • Model professionalism, collaboration, and accountability for other team members.

  • Promote a positive, solutions-focused clinic culture aligned with Frontera Health’s values.

  • Serve as a resource for families and staff on community systems and service navigation.

  • Participate in meetings, parent training, and team discussions to enhance care coordination and service delivery.

  • Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and communication to address client and family needs

Qualifications and Requirements

Required:

  • Community Health Worker Certification from the NMDOH Office of Community Health Workers

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish for effective family communication

  • Organization & task management skills to ensure families are being wholly supported and following up consistently through the care initiation journey

  • Empathy to support families through challenging situations

  • Patience to support families through complex care coordination & navigation activities

Preferred:

  • Experience working with families or children in health, social services, or behavioral health settings

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

  • Knowledge of community health systems and social service resources

  • MSW or LCSW candidates are strongly encouraged to apply (not required)

  • Experience with intake coordination, lead follow-up, or scheduling in a healthcare or behavioral health setting

Work Environment and Travel

  • Hybrid schedule: approximately 75% remote / 25% travel within FronteraCare New Mexico regions

  • Travel may include home visits, community outreach events, and care coordination meetings

  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on family or program needs

At Frontera, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and safe—period. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to maintaining an environment where harassment, discrimination, and retaliation have no place.

Position Title: Customer Care and Quality Assurance Specialist

Work Set Up: Work From Home

Schedule: 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM PHT

Quick Rundown:

The After-Hours Clinical Support Nurse provides after-hours nursing support, clinical guidance, call handling, and care coordination for the client’s daily operations. The role serves as the primary point of contact for incoming calls during the client’s designated after-hours period, replacing the existing answering service.

The position combines clinical nursing knowledge with scheduling and administrative responsibilities to help ensure continuity of care, timely responses to inquiries, accurate documentation, and efficient management of staffing changes. The nurse will work closely with the client’s clinical leadership and care team, escalating clinical concerns and situations that require additional authority or intervention.

What You’ll Do:

  • Answer incoming calls during the client’s designated after-hours period and provide direct call handling and appropriate support.
  • Document calls, inquiries, actions taken, and follow-up requirements in the client’s ABS call logger.
  • Provide clinical guidance to nurses calling with questions or concerns, within the scope of nursing practice and the client’s established protocols.
  • Assess the urgency of clinical inquiries and escalate serious, uncertain, or complex situations to the Director of Nursing or designated clinical supervisor.
  • Assist with scheduling nurses, caregivers, and Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs), including responding to call-offs and coordinating replacements.
  • Identify available internal staff to cover open shifts and use ShiftKey only as a last-resort staffing option.
  • Review available candidates based on credentials, availability, and reliability, then coordinate shift assignments and communicate location and assignment details.
  • Update scheduling calendars, maintain staffing records, and communicate unresolved coverage gaps to the appropriate client representative.
  • Perform additional administrative and care-coordination tasks during periods of low call volume.
  • Handle client, employee, and patient information in accordance with confidentiality, privacy, security, HIPAA-related procedures, and approved system-access protocols.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Registered Nurse (RN) qualification and relevant nursing experience, as required by the client.
  • Ability to provide clinical guidance within the nurse’s scope of practice and established client protocols.
  • Experience or demonstrated ability in scheduling, staffing coordination, or healthcare operations.
  • Strong communication, documentation, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to assess inquiries, recognize situations requiring escalation, and coordinate timely follow-up.
  • Familiarity with healthcare documentation systems and scheduling tools is an advantage.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and comply with confidentiality and security requirements.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with the client’s clinical leadership and care team.

Why You’ll Love Joining the CO Fam!

At Clark Outsourcing, we’re redefining what it means to work in a BPO. This isn’t your regular office setup - it’s where careers flourish, friendships grow, and fun is always part of the deal. Our culture is unmatched (seriously, our team swears by it), and we promise you’ll have to experience it yourself to believe it.

Here’s what’s in store for you:

Health and Welfare Benefits: HMO with prescription coverage, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th-month pay, retirement benefits, and more.

Beyond Work: Enjoy our in-office swimming pool (lowkey flex!), CO Club gaming lounge, CSR involvement through CO Stars, scholarship programs, and access to CO Academy for growth.

Travel Opportunities: We send at least 20 staff per year to visit our clients in the US, UK, and Australia, giving you international exposure and experience.

Leave Benefits: Paid holidays, Earned PTO on your first month, Wellness leave (no questions asked), plus special leaves like bereavement, parental leave, and Magna Carta leave.

Extra Perks: Salary loans up to PHP 1M (via BPI), CO Swag Bag, birthday and anniversary tokens, and our COol & flexible workplace.

Growth and Recognition: Yearly performance appraisals, career advancement programs, CO League events, and guidance from our amazing Coaches!

At CO, it’s not just about work - it's about loving where you work. Ready to experience the best workplace ever? We can’t wait to welcome you to the team!

raw.description:
New B2B Real-Money Game Provider

Location: Remote (Europe preferred) | International travel required

Salary: Negotiable / Flexible, based on experience and profile

About the Opportunity

Our client is a private investment group led by accomplished technology entrepreneurs with experience building and scaling international businesses.

The group is backing the launch of a new B2B real-money game provider, with the objective of building a fully operational, revenue-generating business serving casino operators, aggregators and platforms. The business will develop and distribute a commercially relevant portfolio of real-money games.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial CEO / Co-founder with direct leadership experience inside the B2B games-provider industry. The role is to turn a market opportunity into a commercially successful provider, with responsibility for market strategy, P&L, the leadership team, game production, distribution, operator launches and portfolio economics.

The Role

You will determine which operators, game types and competing providers perform in the priority markets, why specific game mechanics and mathematics can produce commercial results, and where the new provider can win market share. You do not need to design games personally or act as the Product Manager, but you must bring sound product-market judgement and make informed portfolio and investment decisions.

This is a hands-on business leadership mandate: build the operating model, establish commercial distribution, guide the first releases into the market and create a business capable of generating and growing revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an evidence-based market thesis, defining priority GEOs, customer segments, competitors, portfolio positioning and distribution channels.
  • Build the operating model, leadership structure and game-production system required to launch and scale the provider.
  • Agree and manage a game release roadmap with clear quality controls and the capacity to achieve the agreed annual release cadence.
  • Take the first games through production, certification, integration, operator launch and monetisation.
  • Develop a qualified commercial pipeline of operators, aggregators and platform partners.
  • Drive the full commercial journey from qualified lead to contract, integration, live launch, game visibility, promotional support and revenue.
  • Secure meaningful lobby placements and promotional commitments with operators, rather than focusing solely on making games technically available.
  • Own the P&L, cash plan, financial forecasting and unit economics by game, operator, GEO and distribution channel.
  • Propose changes to organisational structure and leadership to the Board, then implement agreed decisions.
  • Create a unified management dashboard with consistent, clearly defined delivery, distribution, player, revenue and reliability metrics.
  • Use AI where it measurably reduces production cycle time or cost, or increases throughput, without compromising quality, compliance or originality.

What We're Looking For

  • Direct senior leadership experience inside a B2B real-money game provider, specifically slots, instant or crash games. Experience solely with a casino operator, platform, affiliate, payments business or general B2C product is not a substitute for provider experience.
  • A demonstrable track record of building a provider from the ground up or materially scaling a provider, a game portfolio or its commercial distribution.
  • An active personal network of operators, aggregators and platforms that can be put to work, supported by evidence of completed launches, live integrations and revenue-producing relationships.
  • P&L ownership or comparable responsibility for the economics and performance of the business as a whole.
  • A genuinely hands-on management style, with examples of personally diagnosing and resolving delivery, commercial or organisational bottlenecks.
  • Strong product-market judgement: the ability to explain which games and providers perform in specific GEOs, how game mechanics and mathematics influence commercial outcomes, and how to translate that insight into a portfolio investment thesis.
  • Experience hiring, developing and leading an effective core team, and establishing practical management routines.
  • A career track record consistent with taking on a multi-year business-building assignment.
  • The ideal background is a current or former CEO or Co-founder of a game provider. We will also consider a CCO or COO from a provider with genuine P&L ownership, cross-functional leadership and experience building the business and its distribution. Leadership of a successful 20–30-person provider team may be relevant where that team delivered and monetised a strong portfolio; bringing a proven core team can also be considered.

What's on Offer

  • Build a new business: Lead the launch and commercial development of an international B2B real-money game provider.
  • Experienced investment backing: Work with established technology entrepreneurs supporting a new gaming business.
  • Business-wide responsibility: Shape the market approach, operating model, portfolio and team while working closely with the Board.
  • Flexible and competitive compensation:Our client is open to discussing attractive, individually tailored terms with exceptional candidates and a proven track record.
  • Participation in outcomes:Performance-based incentives, profit participation or equity arrangements will be discussed as part of an individually tailored compensation package.
  • International working arrangements:Remote working, with Europe preferred and travel for partner and investor meetings as required.

Interested?

If you have already built or materially scaled a B2B real-money game provider and can bring the commercial network, operational judgement and hands-on leadership needed to do it again, we would welcome a conversation.

Reach out to our Associate Partner at or via Telegram @tmalinouskaya to discuss more.

raw.description:
About Verto

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a dedicated Reconciliation Analyst to drive the efficiency and accuracy of our financial operations by managing the end-to-end reconciliation process for multiple banking partners. In this vital role, you will be responsible for gathering data, analyzing and matching transactions, and ensuring the precise reconciliation of all client deposits, withdrawals, conversions, and inter-product fund transfers. You will perform daily investigations into reconciliation breaks across assigned accounts, actively supporting the team in resolving and preventing future discrepancies. Beyond routine operations, you will also play a key role in strategic projects focused on enhancing automation and long-term process effectiveness to support the organization’s growth.

This role will work closely with our payments, trading, and middle office functions.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Contribute to the execution and improvement of our existing reconciliation processes.

  • Support the reconciliation framework, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all stages.

  • Investigate discrepancies and breaks in reconciliations, assisting in taking corrective actions to resolve and prevent future issues.

  • Contribute to the implementation of process improvements to enhance automation and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate on cross-functional projects aimed at optimizing the reconciliation process and integrating new systems or tools.

  • Running the daily reconciliation process, including data gathering, analysis, and matching of transactions.

  • Identifying and investigating discrepancies, breaks, and variances in financial transactions.

  • Assisting in developing and implementing solutions to resolve reconciliation issues and prevent recurrence.

  • Contributing to the enhancement of the efficiency of the reconciliation process through automation and system improvements.

  • Collaborating with internal teams and external banking partners to ensure seamless and accurate financial reporting.

What You Need:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in reconciliation, financial analysis, or a related accounting function, preferably within the fintech, financial services, or payments industry.

  • Intermediate knowledge MS Excel (ability to perform functions such as Vlookup, Xlookup, etc).

  • Demonstrated ability to identify, investigate, and resolve reconciliation discrepancies.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, including collaborating effectively with cross-functional and international teams.

  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

  • Experience with process improvement and automation is a plus.

  • Knowledge of payment processing, FX transactions, and emerging markets is required.

  • Comfortable with the working hours: 9-hour shift within a 7:00 AM – 5:30 PM window

Life At Verto

Perks

  • Insurance paid by the company

  • Health and wellness benefits (with specific added benefits depending on the location of the role)

  • Yearly salary review based on inflation, personal and business performance

  • Access to entire Udemy’s library

  • Budget for professional development courses

  • Work-From-Anywhere policy for certain durations

  • Integration programme (opportunity to work from our global offices)

  • Regular team social events

  • Pension scheme (depending on the role location)

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • Exposure to work with globally distributed teams

  • Location specific benefits like car lease policy, cycle to work, gym membership, etc.

You’ll Fit Right In If You

  • Love asking “why?”

  • Value solving problems over just completing tasks

  • Understand sync vs. async communication practices

  • Thrive in ambiguity and change

  • Actively seek feedback

  • Prioritise impact over activity

  • Are fun to work with - we love good humour!

Culture

  • Our Core Values: These values reflect our focus, energy, and shared expectations.

    • Champion the Mission: We are driven by curiosity and belief to solve global cross-border payment challenges.

    • Be the Best: We are open, take calculated risks, focus on results, and excel in our work.

    • Work as One: We transparently share failures and successes.

    • Go the Extra Mile: We deliver beyond expectations and achieve the impossible.

    • Customer First: We creatively solve problems and boldly design better experiences for customers.

    • Run with It: We are determined, embrace challenges, own tasks, act swiftly, and deliver results.

  • Industry Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We reward employees for their value to the business with competitive compensation and benefits across all locations. This includes performance-based salary reviews, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, and flexible working arrangements to support your career and life.

Diversity and Inclusion at Verto

Verto is an equal opportunities employer and we value diversity. Anyone seeking employment at Verto is considered based on Merit, Competence, Qualifications and their Talent. We are proud to be a truly international team and we do not discriminate in our hiring process.

raw.description:
About your tasks:

  • Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, embedding security testing and controls into software development and deployment while enabling engineering teams to work efficiently and securely.

  • Strengthen application and cloud-native security, working hands-on with development teams across Kubernetes and containerized environments to identify risks and implement practical security controls.

  • Enable secure development across Data & AI by translating security requirements into practical guardrails, standards and solutions that AI/ML, MLOps and Data Science teams can apply in their day-to-day development.

  • CVE & vulnerability management: continuously identify and assess vulnerabilities, support their prioritization and work closely with application teams on practical mitigation and remediation.

  • Monitoring, security & continuous improvement: contribute to security testing, rollout and observability, advise teams when new security issues arise, and explore tooling and automation that can further strengthen application security.

About you:

  • You bring strong hands-on experience as a DevSecOps / Application Security Engineer, with the depth to secure applications and software development across cloud-native and Kubernetes environments.
  • You operate at a Senior/Staff level, with the technical depth and independence to own complex security topics and translate security requirements into practical solutions for engineering teams.
  • You have hands-on experience with CI/CD security and GitHub, GitLab or comparable tooling, including automating security guardrails, testing and checks within development pipelines.
  • You bring solid expertise in application and cloud-native security, including Kubernetes/container security, vulnerability management and CVEs, security scanning, triage/prioritization and remediation workflows.
  • You have a shift-left mindset and enjoy working closely with developers to embed security into how software is developed and deployed. Experience with Python and Data & AI/ML environments is a plus.

About your benefits:

In order to provide our employees with the best possible support for their individual needs, we offer a wide range of benefits:

  • Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
  • Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.
  • Kindergarten Grant: We offer our employees who pay for childcare in kindergarten 100,00 € (total) per month.
  • Mental Health: Get quick and professional help from psychologists if you feel overwhelmed in private or professional life. Anonymous and free of charge.
  • Personal Development: We are all constantly learning. That's why we support and foster your career development through internal & external training and help you grow.
  • Mobility: Your commute matters to us. We provide our employees with a fully costed Deutschland Ticket which can be used at any time.
  • Sports & Health: Your well-being is our top priority. Therefore, we offer you a range of opportunities to improve your health. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, providing a variety of sports offers tailored to your interests.

About Redcare Pharmacy:

As Europe’s leading online pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is driven by our dedicated teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create an enjoyable and collaborative working environment where every employee feels comfortable and is motivated to contribute to our vision: “Until every human has their health.” If you are looking for a meaningful career that aligns with your values, join our team and start your #Redcareer.

About the role:

As Senior, DevSecOps Engineering within our Data & AI organization, you’ll help us make security an integral part of how we develop and deploy applications. Working closely with MLOps, Data Science, AI and Engineering teams, you’ll combine hands-on security engineering with practical guidance, strengthening security across the development lifecycle and helping teams address new and emerging security challenges.

About the tech stack:

Our security and development landscape includes GitHub / GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Terraform and Python, alongside Azure services such as Entra ID (AAD), Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel. For application, container and infrastructure security, we work with technologies and approaches including Aikido, Trivy, CodeQL, Dependabot, Checkov/tfsec and OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno. Our Data & AI environment also includes Databricks, Unity Catalog and MLflow.

While this is a remote position based in Germany, it may require occasional on-site collaboration at our offices in Berlin or Cologne, depending on business and team requirements.

Position Title: Digital Product Designer

Category: User Experience

Seniority: Mid

Location: Remote

Why you will love Global Technology Services:

raw.description:
CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge, and for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess and apply that information to keep enterprises thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.

CAS is currently seeking an Assistant Director, Strategic Accounts - Americas on our Sales team. This position is remote and can be located anywhere in the United States.

Position Summary

This role leads CAS's Strategic Accounts team for the Americas, composed of Strategic Account Managers and Sr. Customer Success Managers who are seasoned commercial professionals, typically with more than 15 years of commercial experience. The Assistant Director is accountable for protecting and growing CAS's global enterprise accounts that have a strong presence across North America, building the account strategies, monthly forecasts, and executive relationships that keep these accounts healthy and expanding.

This is a leadership role, not an individual-contributor account role. The Assistant Director sets regional account strategy and forecast discipline, coaches the team on execution, and remains personally engaged with the customer executives who matter most to these accounts. The role carries budget responsibility associated with its account strategy and forecast, and is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

The Assistant Director works actively with the Program Manager, Strategic Accounts to ensure senior CAS leadership is well informed of needs, challenges, and opportunities in these accounts, and partners with the Custom Services team to build a services pipeline that Custom Services then facilitates and delivers.

Position Responsibilities

Account Strategy and Regional Leadership

  • Lead a regional team of Strategic Account Managers and Sr. Customer Success Managers accountable for protecting and growing CAS's global enterprise accounts with a strong presence in North America.
  • Build and maintain account strategies across the region in partnership with the team, ensuring plans reflect each account's current health, growth potential, and risk profile.
  • Set the region's priorities for account coverage, and adjust account assignments and strategy as the global enterprise account portfolio evolves.

Forecasting and Business Rigor

  • Build and own the monthly forecast for the region's global enterprise account book of business, in partnership with the team and Commercial Operations.
  • Track forecast accuracy over time and use variance analysis to refine account strategy and coaching.
  • Report regional account health, forecast, and risk to CAS senior leadership on a regular cadence.

Executive Stakeholder Engagement

  • Personally engage with senior customer executives at the region's most strategic accounts, building the relationships that anchor long-term retention and growth.
  • Facilitate executive stakeholder engagement between senior CAS leadership and customer executives, ensuring the right CAS voices are in front of the right customer stakeholders at the right time.
  • Represent the region's global enterprise accounts in internal executive reviews.

Strategic Accounts Program Partnership

  • Work actively with the Program Manager, Strategic Accounts to ensure senior CAS leadership is well informed of needs, challenges, and opportunities in the region's global enterprise accounts.
  • Contribute regional account intelligence to the broader Strategic Accounts program, supporting consistent reporting and prioritization across regions.

Custom Services Pipeline Partnership

  • Partner with the Custom Services team to help build a pipeline of custom-services opportunities within the region's global enterprise accounts.
  • Hand off qualified services opportunities to the Custom Services team, which facilitates and delivers the resulting engagements, while maintaining visibility into delivery progress as it affects account health.

Team Leadership and Talent

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of seasoned commercial professionals, typically with more than 15 years of commercial experience, setting a high bar for account strategy, executive engagement, and forecast discipline.
  • Recruit, retain, and develop top talent for the Strategic Account Manager and Sr. Customer Success Manager roles on the regional team.
  • Assure accurate and complete communication flow between the regional team and senior sales and CAS leadership.

Qualifications

Suitable candidate background includes:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, science-related fields, communications, or other related disciplines. An advanced degree is a plus but not required.
  • 15+ years of progressive commercial experience, consistent with the seniority of the team being led, including direct experience managing large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts.
  • Demonstrated experience building and executing account strategy and forecasting for a portfolio of global enterprise accounts.
  • Proven track record engaging and influencing senior customer executives, at the C-suite and VP level, in a consultative, relationship-driven sales or customer success capacity.
  • Experience selling or supporting science-related solutions and/or information/intellectual property solutions preferred.
  • Prior people-leadership experience managing senior, individually accomplished commercial professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience with CRM, forecasting, and opportunity management tools/systems, preferably Salesforce.com.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Strategic Accounts program leadership, Custom Services, and senior CAS leadership.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills; additional language fluency is a plus.
  • Willing to travel up to 40% (domestic and international)

CAS offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including a generous vacation plan, medical, dental, vision insurance plans, and employee savings and retirement plans. Candidates for this position must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future. EEO/Disabled/Veteran.

As an RN Case Manager, the RN will work closely with client and members alike to promote wellness, problem-solve, and assist members in realization of their personal health-care related goals.

This role includes telephonic member and provider outreach, data collection and analyzation, reporting, clinical review, medical and behavioral health assessments, and documentation in compliance with Federal/State regulation, NCAQ standard, and company policies and procedures. This position is part of the Value Based Care Services team.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Pulling, sorting, and analyzing data to determine member eligibility for the Population Health management Program.
  • Coordinating and providing care that is timely, effective, equitable, safe, and member-centric while following HMO processes.
  • Managing case assignments which includes outreach, documentation, monitoring for case progression, and case closure.
  • Meeting reporting and documentation standards while engaging in collaborative meetings with department staff and clients.
  • Assisting members in reaching wellness and health-autonomy by addressing barriers, social determinants, member motivators, and psychosocial issues.
  • Helping members make informed decisions by educating them on navigation through the HMO and healthcare spectrum while promoting quality and cost-effective interventions and outcomes.
  • Supporting operational aspects of the division to meet the organization’s customer requirements and satisfaction.
  • Maintaining confidentiality related to all computer programs, medical records, and data.
  • Participation in QM/UM Committee Meetings including material preparation, minutes, data collection, and analysis, reporting, and follow-up tasks which may require in-person attendance.
  • Rotation in off-hour/weekend calls if applicable.
  • Responsible for continued professional growth and education that reflects knowledge and understanding of current nursing care practice as outlined in the Illinois Practice Act.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned and per any changes in annual program requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE

  • Current IL Registered Nurse License (State of Illinois requires Nursing Professional Staff to complete 20 hours of CE per 2-year license renewal cycle).
  • Minimum of five years of experience in a variety of health care settings.
  • Highly experienced in Case Management and Chronic Condition Management.
  • Knowledge of utilization review, quality improvement, managed care, and/or community health.
  • Previous remote and/or telephonic work experience.
  • Basic knowledge of case management principles, healthcare management, and reimbursement components, with experience in motivational interviewing.
  • Excellent clinical judgment, as well as highly skilled in verbal and written communication.
  • Strong organizational. problem solving, and time management skills necessary.
  • Ability to ensure timely completion of projects and assignments.
  • Ability to prioritize and react based on rapidly changing business needs.
  • Must have ability to work independently and remotely with multi-tasking skills for fast paced workflows.
  • Must possess software knowledge including word processing and spreadsheets, computer skills including MS Word, Excel, Access, PDF, Outlook, etc.
  • Experience navigating multiple EMR’s.
  • A high speed/secured home internet connection, a private HIPAA compliant home office with a door that locks for security and privacy purposes, and back-up connection service options for internet outages.

WHAT WE'D LOVE FOR YOU TO HAVE

  • Certification in Case Management preferred but not required

The salary range for this role is $90,000.00

ALIVE with Purpose: How We Thrive at Guidehealth

At Guidehealth, our values come to life in everything we do.

  • We are Driven by Accountability — grounded in transparency, reliability, and integrity as we navigate challenges and opportunities alike.
  • Always Growing, Always Learning — staying curious and continuously improving inspires us to shape a better future for healthcare.
  • With Collaborative Innovation, we solve problems creatively, making every experience better for our employees and the patients we serve.
  • At Guidehealth, Every Voice Matters — we believe our collective strength is rooted in the unique perspectives of each team member.
  • And through Empathy in Action, we build stronger connections with those who count on us.
  • This is what it means to be ALIVE with purpose. This is how we thrive — together — at Guidehealth.

BENEFITS:

While you are hard at work advancing value-based healthcare, we are here to ensure YOU have the care you and your family need and the opportunities for growth and development. Our commitments to you include:

  • Work from Home: Guidehealth is a fully remote company, providing you the flexibility to spend less time commuting and more time focusing on your professional goals and personal needs.
  • Keep Health a Priority: We offer comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you covered.
  • Plan for the Future: Our 401(k) plan includes a 3% employer match to your 6% contribution.
  • Have Peace of Mind: We provide Life and Disability insurance for those "just in case" moments. Additionally, we offer voluntary Life options to keep you and your loved ones protected.
  • Feel Supported When You Need It Most: Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) is here to help you through tough times.
  • Take Time for Yourself: We offer paid time off plans helping you achieve work-life balance and meet your personal goals.
  • Support Your New Family: Welcoming a new family member takes time and commitment. Guidehealth offers paid parental leave to give you the time you need.
  • Learn and Grow: Your professional growth is important to us. Guidehealth offers various resources dedicated to your learning and development to advance your career with us.

All full-time employees of Guidehealth who work 30 hours per week or more are eligible for our comprehensive benefits package. Temporary employees and contractors are not eligible for benefits.

COMPENSATION:

The listed compensation range listed is paid bi-weekly per our standard payroll practices. Final base pay decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors which may include, but are not limited to: skill set, years of relevant experience, education, location, and licensure/certifications.

OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

Diversity, inclusion, and belonging are at the core of Guidehealth’s values. We are an equal opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation and identity, national origin, citizenship, religion, marital status, familial status, physical, sensory, or medical disability, Family and Medical Leave, military or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth or other related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. Our management is fully dedicated to ensuring the fulfillment of this policy with respect to hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruitment advertising, pay, and other forms of compensation, training, and general treatment during employment. 

OUR COMITTMENT TO PROTECTION OF PATIENT AND COMPANY DATA

This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI and PII under Guidehealth’s custodianship as well as Guidehealth Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

As a remote-first organization handling sensitive healthcare data, Guidehealth verifies candidate identity at multiple stages of the hiring and onboarding to safeguard patient privacy, data security, and compliance requirements.

REMOTE WORK TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Guidehealth is a fully remote company. We provide new employees with the necessary equipment to function in their role at no charge to the employee. Employees provide their own internet connection, capable of conducting video calls on camera and connecting to various internal and external systems. The required internet speed is a minimum of 100 mbps download, 10 mbps upload. Please run a speed test here to confirm your internet connection meets these requirements.

SECONDARY EMPLOYMENT

At Guidehealth, we value transparency and collaboration as part of our commitment to excellence. As your primary employer, we kindly ask all team members to disclose any secondary employment, regardless of whether it may present a potential conflict of interest.

To ensure smooth teamwork and availability, employees must be accessible during our stated working hours. We foster connection and engagement by asking team members to join virtual meetings with their cameras on.

WHO IS GUIDEHEALTH?

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Our goal is to make great healthcare affordable, improve the health of patients, and restore the fulfillment of practicing medicine for providers. Driven by empathy and powered by AI and predictive analytics, Guidehealth leverages remotely-embedded Healthguides™ and a centralized Managed Service Organization to build stronger connections with patients and providers. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients. 

Join us as we put healthcare on a better path!!

raw.title: Storage Administrator (Remote Opportunity)
raw.excerpt: We are currently looking for a SAN Engineer / Storage Administrator for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project.
raw.description:
We are currently looking for a SAN Engineer / Storage Administrator for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Data Migration & Syndication (DMS) initiative within the Electronic Health Record Modernization Integration Office (EHRM-IO). The engineer will be responsible for administering, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise storage infrastructure, including HPE, NetApp, Pure Storage, and Brocade technologies, while supporting data migration, backup and recovery, and storage integration across on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments.

The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary infrastructure and engineering team, collaborating with storage administrators, systems engineers, database specialists, cloud engineers, vendor support teams, and federal stakeholders. The engineer will support ongoing storage operations, capacity planning, infrastructure modernization, technical troubleshooting, and documentation activities to ensure the availability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical healthcare systems.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities:

  • Install, configure, administer, and optimize enterprise Storage Area Network (SAN) infrastructure, including Brocade Fibre Channel switches, HPE 3PAR, Primera and Alletra storage arrays, NetApp AFF clusters, Pure Storage FlashArray and FlashBlade systems, supporting approximately nine petabytes of storage across VA healthcare environments.
  • Monitor and maintain storage capacity, utilization, performance, and availability using tools such as HPE InfoSight, HPE SSMC, NetApp ONTAP, NetApp Unified Manager, Pure Storage Pure1, SolarWinds, and SANnav, producing capacity forecasts, performance metrics, and weekly status reports.
  • Administer enterprise backup, recovery, and data protection operations using Commvault, storage snapshots and snapclones, SQL Server backup tools, HPE tape libraries, and Microsoft Azure archival storage to ensure data availability, integrity, and recoverability.
  • Support storage infrastructure integration, technical refresh initiatives, and large-scale data migrations across EHRM, BISL, and Azure environments, including provisioning new storage devices, migrating existing workloads, and maintaining secure and reliable connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot complex storage connectivity, hardware, firmware, and performance issues across SAN fabrics, storage arrays, and cloud environments, coordinating with vendor support teams to perform root cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and minimize operational disruptions.
  • Maintain comprehensive storage infrastructure documentation, including system technical guides, topology diagrams, build and configuration guides, capacity planning reports, and Authorization to Operate (ATO) documentation, while evaluating approved AI-assisted tools for storage automation, predictive analytics, troubleshooting, and reporting.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or another engineering or technical discipline, or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise SAN and storage infrastructure, including NetApp ONTAP, HPE Primera, HPE 3PAR 20850, HP Lefthand Centralized Management Console, HP Storage Essentials, and HP SN8700 Fibre Channel director switches.
  • Experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting Fibre Channel SAN environments, enterprise storage arrays, and storage connectivity, performance, and availability issues across on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure cloud environments.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise backup and recovery technologies, including Commvault, storage snapshots, snapclones, hierarchical storage management, and storage integration supporting data migration and disaster recovery operations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues, optimize storage performance, identify operational risks, and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, technical documentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to participate in detailed technical discussions, coordinate with vendor support teams, and develop and present technical reports and briefing materials to stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal government infrastructure environments, particularly data migration, data syndication, and EHR modernization initiatives, with knowledge of database architecture, administration, and security across on-premises and cloud-hosted systems.
  • Experience with enterprise storage management and automation tools, including HPE InfoSight, HPE SSMC, HPE 3PAR CLI, HP SSSU, NetApp ONTAP CLI, Pure Storage Pure1, SANnav, and PowerShell, with familiarity in AI-driven predictive analytics for capacity forecasting, performance monitoring, and proactive infrastructure maintenance.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to develop and validate storage automation scripts, analyze logs and vendor diagnostics, generate performance reports, and maintain technical documentation, with an understanding of secure AI practices, non-production testing, protection of sensitive infrastructure information and PHI/PII, and compliance with federal responsible AI guidance.

Security Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Do you thrive in an international team of deeply specialised engineers? Are you excited about participating in some of the largest infrastructure projects in Europe? Do you want to contribute actively to the green transition? Are you an electrical engineer with LV Installation design?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Power Systems Department as our new LV Installations Designer and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new LV Installations Designer, you will be able to test yourself on a huge variety of tasks for many different clients while you will be the driver of developing our LV Installations services to even higher technical levels.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Preparation of engineering specifications and technical documentation for Low Voltage and Weak Current Installations
  • Preparation of necessary calculations (e.g. indoor / outdoor lighting, etc.)
  • Preparation of necessary Bill of Materials and Bill of Quantities
  • Preparation of the Building Design and Detailed Design
  • Delivering projects and models in BIM environment
  • Driving technical reviews and agreements with Clients and Suppliers
  • Deliver consulting services and advice to our Clients and Customers

Your new Team

You will be part of a highly skilled and dedicated team of power system engineers delivering solutions for DSOs, TSOs and developers of renewable energy. We are growing significantly at the moment, and you will therefore be able to have direct influence on defining our strategy. We aim to be the preferred supplier of power system engineering consultancy services for TSOs, DSOs and renewable energy developers.

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

These include:

  • That you hold a PhD or M.Sc. in electrical engineering degree or equivalent
  • That you have expert knowledge on Low Voltage and Weak Current Installations
  • That you have knowledge on 3D Modelling and BIM Methodology
  • That you are thriving with managing stakeholders and expanding your network
  • That you like taking responsibility for our scope, i.e. are comfortable making assumptions and decisions together with our clients
  • That you are eager to make a difference in the green energy transition

What we can offer you

  • Investment in your development
  • Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
  • Be valued for the unique person you are
  • Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realise their full potential.

About Ramboll

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion is at the heart of what we do

We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.

Overview

We are seeking experienced Independent Field Adjusters to investigate and evaluate daily property claims on behalf of our clients. This role involves delivering timely, accurate, fair, and professional service while managing a high volume of claims independently. Contractors are expected to uphold the highest standards of service and professionalism, representing both the client and company with integrity.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Promptly and effectively manage all assigned claims with minimal oversight.
  • Make claim decisions within delegated authority per company and carrier policies.
  • Accurately interpret policy coverages and apply appropriate claims practices.
  • Establish and communicate reserves in alignment with carrier expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of insurance policies, guidelines, and industry practices.
  • Understand local construction methods, pricing, and repair standards.
  • Submit supplemental reports as needed (e.g., severe incident reports, ITV reports).
  • Provide exceptional customer service to all insureds, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain high standards of professional conduct throughout all assignments.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of experience handling property claims
  • Minimum 2 years of experience using Xactimate and Symbility estimating software
  • Strong understanding of insurance policies, practices, and procedures
  • General construction knowledge strongly preferred

Important: This is a 1099 Independent Contractor Opportunity

This opportunity is classified as an independent contractor role under the IRS and applicable state laws, including New York. By applying, you acknowledge and agree to the following:

  • You will not be classified as an employee of Ryze Claim Solutions, and no employer-employee relationship exists.
  • You are responsible for your own taxes, insurance, and business expenses.
  • You control the manner, timing, and method of completing your work, consistent with client expectations.
  • You may provide services to other clients or entities, subject to applicable confidentiality or non-compete terms.

To qualify as a 1099 contractor under the ABC test:

  • (A) You must be free from company control and direction in how work is performed.
  • (B) The work must be performed outside the usual course of our business.
  • (C) You must be customarily engaged in an independently established trade or business.

If you do not meet all three criteria, you may not be eligible for this engagement

Salary: Per File Commissions - 1099 Contract

Job Description

About the Role:

Our Devoted Preventative Primary Care Provider roles, include Nurse Practitioners and Physician Assistants and will be considered for both roles.As a Devoted Preventative Primary Care Provider, you’ll be part of a mission-driven, interdisciplinary clinical team focused on improving the health, dignity, and quality of life of our members. You’ll meet patients in the first step of their primary care journey with Devoted Medical. You’ll conduct comprehensive clinical assessments, support chronic condition management, and emphasize preventative and proactive care. You’ll collaborate closely with primary care providers, specialists, pharmacists, nurses, care coordinators, caregivers, and families to deliver coordinated, member-centered care.

This role sits at the intersection of preventative care, primary care and complex care management — it is not a traditional primary care panel role, and it’s not a one-time Annual Wellness Visit role. You’ll develop a relationship with your members while working in a supportive, tech-enabled environment designed to optimize clinical time and connection.

What You’ll Do:

  • Conduct primarily telehealth video visits, with limited and occasional in-home visits to members in your local area.

  • Perform comprehensive assessments and provide evidence-based care focused on prevention, chronic condition support, medication optimization, and health maintenance.

  • Identify and address care gaps, coordinate with external and internal care team members, and contribute to individualized, whole-person care plans.

  • Utilize integrated technology and AI-enabled workflows to reduce administrative burden and maximize meaningful member interaction time.

  • Communicate with empathy and clarity, fostering trust and confidence with members and caregivers.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Active Nurse Practitioner (APRN/NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) license.

  • 3+ years of outpatient clinical practice, ideally in primary care, family medicine, internal medicine, or geriatrics.

  • Active and clear NP/PA license

    (must be willing to obtain additional licenses if necessary within the first 90 days — support and reimbursement provided)

  • Active BLS certification at time of hire.

  • Comfort with delivering care via video telehealth and using electronic documentation systems.

Preferred Experience:

  • Familiarity with managed care models, including STARS/HEDIS and identification of care gaps.

  • Experience performing comprehensive or preventive care visits with Medicare populations.

  • Experience supporting older adults and/or individuals with complex medical or social needs.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…

  • Find meaning in caring for older adults and supporting them in living healthier, more independent lives.

  • Lead with empathy, humility, and curiosity.

  • Value feedback, reflection, and personal and professional growth.

  • Enjoy working within a collaborative, supportive, tech-enabled care team environment.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • Member-first care: Time to build relationships — quality matters more than quantity.

  • Mission with heart: Every visit is an opportunity to improve someone’s health and dignity.

  • Flexible remote environment: Work from home while still being part of a tight-knit clinical community.

  • Growth & stability: Opportunities to expand licensure, clinical skills, and career pathways.

  • Schedule options: Standard schedules available; eligibility for 4x10 schedule after successful completion of first 90 days (post onboarding) and performance expectations.

Salary range: $115,000 - $140,000 annually

If you’re passionate about providing thoughtful, preventative care — and want to make a lasting impact on the lives of older adults — we’d love to meet you.

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.
