Job Summary: The Director, Financial Planning & Analysis provides strategic leadership for the organization’s financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and decision-support capabilities. Reporting to the CFO, this role serves as a trusted financial partner to executive leadership and translates business strategy into measurable financial and operational plans. The Director leads the annual budget, long-range planning, and recurring forecasting processes; establishes scalable financial models and management reporting; and delivers forward-looking insights regarding growth, profitability, cash flow, capital allocation, and business performance. The position strengthens financial discipline across the organization, identifies emerging risks and opportunities, and enables leaders to make informed, data-driven decisions.

This role also builds and develops the FP&A function by establishing clear standards, strengthening business partnerships, improving systems and processes, and leading a high-performing team capable of supporting the organization’s continued growth.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Financial Strategy and Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic financial advisor to the CFO, executive leadership, and business leaders.
  • Translate organizational strategy into financial priorities, operating plans, performance measures, and resource-allocation recommendations.
  • Provide objective financial perspectives on growth opportunities, operational investments, organizational capacity, and business risks.
  • Develop executive-level financial narratives that connect results, operating performance, assumptions, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Lead scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to evaluate alternative strategies and potential business outcomes.
  • Support leadership discussions concerning organic growth, new offerings, market expansion, pricing, investments, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Present financial analyses, forecasts, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership and other key stakeholders.

Enterprise Planning, Budgeting, and Forecasting

  • Own and continuously improve the organization’s annual budgeting, recurring forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes.
  • Establish planning calendars, methodologies, assumptions, templates, governance standards, and accountability across participating business units.
  • Partner with functional leaders to develop financially sound operating plans aligned with organizational goals.
  • Consolidate departmental plans into an integrated company forecast covering revenue, profitability, operating expenses, cash flow, and capital requirements.
  • Assess forecast accuracy, identify significant deviations, and implement improvements to assumptions, methodologies, and planning practices.
  • Ensure financial plans reflect operational drivers, workforce requirements, investment priorities, and anticipated business conditions.
  • Maintain multiple financial scenarios that enable leadership to respond effectively to changing performance or market conditions.

Financial Analysis and Performance Management

  • Establish an enterprise performance-management framework that connects strategic priorities with financial and operational measures.
  • Lead monthly and quarterly analysis of actual performance compared with budget, forecast, prior periods, and strategic expectations.
  • Identify the underlying drivers of financial performance and convert findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Oversee profitability and margin analysis by service, offering, client segment, business unit, or other relevant dimensions.
  • Evaluate revenue performance, cost structure, operating leverage, working capital, cash flow, return on investment, and capital requirements.
  • Develop leading indicators and early-warning measures that identify emerging financial risks and opportunities.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders to define corrective actions when performance differs from plan.

Reporting, Analytics, and Business Intelligence

  • Lead the development of accurate, timely, and decision-oriented management reporting.
  • Establish consistent definitions, methodologies, and governance for financial and operational performance measures.
  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting packages that highlight results, trends, risks, opportunities, and required decisions.
  • Advance the use of automation, financial systems, analytical tools, and business intelligence within the FP&A function.
  • Reduce manual reporting and increase the team’s capacity for forward-looking analysis and strategic support.
  • Collaborate with Accounting and other data owners to reconcile management reporting with underlying financial records.

Capital Allocation, Investment, and Transaction Support

  • Develop financial frameworks for evaluating capital deployment, strategic investments, business cases, and competing resource priorities.
  • Lead financial modeling and due diligence support for potential acquisitions, integrations, investments, and partnerships.
  • Evaluate expected returns, cash requirements, financial risks, sensitivities, and strategic alignment.
  • Monitor the performance of approved investments against the original business case and recommend corrective actions as needed.
  • Support post-transaction planning and performance tracking, as applicable.

Financial Governance and Risk Management

  • Establish and maintain appropriate FP&A policies, controls, documentation, and review practices.
  • Ensure financial models, forecasts, and management reports use consistent assumptions and reliable source information.
  • Identify financial, operational, and market risks and develop mitigation recommendations for executive consideration.
  • Partner with Accounting to support alignment with GAAP, financial reporting requirements, and internal control expectations.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality over financial, employee, client, and transaction-related information.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong partnerships with leaders across the organization and serve as the primary FP&A point of contact for strategic financial planning.
  • Increase financial understanding and accountability by helping leaders interpret performance and evaluate trade-offs.
  • Facilitate planning and performance discussions that generate clear decisions, owners, and follow-through.
  • Constructively challenge assumptions while maintaining productive, solutions-oriented relationships.
  • Coordinate with Accounting, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and other teams so plans and forecasts reflect current business conditions.

People Leadership and Functional Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop the FP&A team, establishing clear expectations for performance, quality, responsiveness, and business partnership.
  • Determine team priorities, allocate resources, and balance recurring deliverables with strategic projects.
  • Build team capabilities in financial modeling, forecasting, analytics, executive communication, and business partnership.
  • Provide meaningful feedback, professional development, and career-growth opportunities.
  • Establish succession and capability plans that support the long-term needs of the FP&A function.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, continuous improvement, collaboration, and ownership thinking.

Experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 

  • Advanced knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and corporate finance.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, working capital, GAAP, key financial ratios, and performance measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect financial analysis with business strategy and operational execution.
  • Executive-level communication, presentation, and influencing capabilities, both in person and virtually using Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to convert complex financial information into focused insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong business partnership skills, including the ability to constructively challenge assumptions and facilitate decisions.
  • Strong understanding of profitability, pricing, scenario modeling, investment analysis, and capital allocation.
  • Experience improving financial systems, reporting tools, automation, and data quality.
  • Ability to lead through change, ambiguity, growth, and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated people-leadership, coaching, performance-management, and talent-development capabilities.
  • High standards for accuracy, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.

Experience: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance
  • 3+ years of formal people-leadership experience, preferably leading financial analysts or an FP&A function
  • Demonstrated experience owning enterprise budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and long-range planning
  • Experience partnering directly with executive leaders and presenting financial recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Experience improving financial processes, reporting, systems, automation, or business intelligence capabilities
  • Preferred: experience in a growing, multi-entity, or acquisitive organization, ideally in technology services or a Managed Service Provider environment
  • Preferred: experience supporting acquisitions, due diligence, integration planning, or investment evaluation

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:  

  • CPA, CMA, CFA, ACA/ACCA/CIMA, or equivalent professional finance or accounting qualification preferred
  • MBA or other relevant graduate degree preferred

About the Job




Job Description

Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.

The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.

We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.

Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .


Summary:

The Medicare Specialist is responsible for managing the billing and collection processes for Medicare patients, ensuring compliance with Medicare policies and regulations, and following up on unpaid Medicare claims. This role involves processing Medicare claims, managing accounts receivable, addressing patient inquiries, and working closely with Medicare representatives to resolve billing issues.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and submit accurate Medicare claims for patient services, ensuring compliance with Medicare guidelines and regulations. Utilizes DDE, CWF, and other tools to identify, track and follow up on unpaid or denied Medicare claims, identifying issues and working to resolve any billing discrepancies with Medicare or patients.
  • Review patient accounts and reconcile payments with Medicare remittance advice, ensuring all payments are posted correctly and outstanding balances are addressed. Communicate with patients regarding their Medicare coverage, billing questions, payment options, and any unpaid balances.
  • Investigate and resolve issues related to denied or underpaid Medicare claims, working with Medicare representatives and internal departments to ensure accurate reimbursement. Prepares and submits appeals for denied claims, including supporting documentation.
  • Monitor and analyze aging reports to prioritize follow-up actions for overdue Medicare accounts, ensuring timely resolution. Ensure all billing and collection practices are compliant with Medicare regulations, HIPAA, and company policies. Identifies potential compliance risks and recommends corrective action. Maintains accurate records of all Medicare claims, payments, communications, and follow-up activities, ensuring proper documentation in the patient account system.
  • Identify and resolve Medicare credit balances and may assist with preparation of quarterly Medicare credit balance report. Request offset to future payments in DDE.
  • Work with internal departments, such as coding, finance, etc. to review diagnosis, CPT code, etc. to resolve claim edit issues.
  • Prepare, submit, and follow up on redetermination appeals to Medicare

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to analyze complex data, identify patterns, and draw accurate conclusions.
  • High level of accuracy in reviewing medical records and billing data.
  • Ability to analyze claim data, identify billing errors, and troubleshoot complex claim issues.
  • In-depth knowledge of Medicare billing codes, guidelines, and regulations. Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems, billing software, and remittance advice processing and DDE. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain Medicare billing details and resolve patient concerns effectively.
  • Ability to handle sensitive information and maintain confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA regulations. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously. Problem-solving abilities, particularly with regard to billing discrepancies and denied claims.

Work Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • Experience utilizing Payer portals, DDE and client systems
  • 3-5 years of hospital Business Office billing and follow-up experience as a Medicare representative. Medical Terminology, ICD-10, CPT and DRG knowledge a preferred, knowledge of third-party Insurance payer guidelines
  • High school diploma or equivalent

Working Conditions:

Work from home and remote location with a stable internet connection, a quiet and dedicated workspace free of distractions, and access to necessary office equipment. The ability to have daily communication with team members, management, and clients through email, phone calls, video meetings and other collaborative tools. Primarily requires sitting at a desk for extended period. Proper lighting and ergonomics shole be maintained to reduce eye strain.


100% Remote



Benefits


The base compensation range for this position is:


$49,603.71 - $74,405.56

Compensation ranges could be hourly or salary depending upon the exempt status of the posted position.


Beginning compensation is determined based on objective factors such as location, qualifications, skills, certifications, and experience. Typically, a candidate is hired in the lower to midpoint of the range; the top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive specialized experience and mastery within the role. Compensation may increase over time based on performance, experience, and tenure.


Compensation is only part of Ovation's total compensation package. Some additional benefits offered to full-time associates are:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage
  • HSA with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts for health care, and dependent care accounts
  • Wellness platform with premium incentives
  • Employee assistance support and additional voluntary supplemental plans including accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and child disability insurance
  • Robust and flexible paid time off offerings and company paid holidays
  • 401(k) plan with discretionary employer match opportunities
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company issued equipment

Successful candidates must be comfortable working across these support functions, communicating professionally, following established procedures, and maintaining accurate information.

We have six openings available across several weekday and weekend schedules. Candidates must be able to commit to their assigned shift and demonstrate the reliability, communication skills, and independent work habits required for a fully remote role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and communicate accurate information to help address housing or maintenance-related inquiries.

raw.description:
HAPPY HOWL®

Demand Capture Manager

Remote (US) · Full-Time

About Happy Howl

We started Happy Howl because we believe dogs deserve better — and better wasn’t available. Not from the legacy brands cutting corners with feed-grade ingredients, not from the fresh players who can’t survive a pantry shelf, and not from anyone willing to accept that the industry standard for pet nutrition is “good enough.”

We’re on a mission to help dogs live longer, healthier lives. Every recipe is 100% human-grade, single-source animal protein, zero preservatives, backed by real science and formulated by a PhD nutritionist who obsesses over every ingredient. Our food is shelf-stable for two years without refrigeration — real, whole-food nutrition that’s ready whenever and wherever your dog is. That combination doesn’t exist anywhere else.

But we’re more than a product. We work hand-in-hand with rescue organizations across the country because we believe every dog deserves a great meal — not just the ones who already found their forever home. Giving back isn’t a marketing campaign for us. It’s why we exist.

We’re backed by some of the most respected investors in consumer and pet, and we’re building the team that scales this brand past $100M in annual revenue. This is not a slow build. We move fast, we think big, and we hold ourselves to a standard most companies talk about but never actually live.

The people here are energetic, passionate, thoughtful, and intentional. We’re a team in every sense of the word — we win together, we solve hard problems together, and we’re building something that genuinely matters. If you want to do the best work of your career at a company that refuses to settle, Happy Howl is where you belong.

We’re headquartered in Huntingdon Valley, PA with team members across the US.

About the Role

The media buying team creates demand. You capture it. As Demand Capture Manager, you’ll own every organic and bottom-of-funnel touchpoint that converts interest into revenue — from SEO and organic social to product page optimization and Amazon listings. This is a high-impact role that directly influences conversion rates, CAC efficiency, and revenue growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own SEO strategy and execution across the Happy Howl website and blog.
  • Manage organic social media presence and content distribution.
  • Optimize product pages, landing pages, and checkout flows for conversion.
  • Lead Amazon listing optimization and organic ranking strategy.
  • Build and optimize quiz funnels and guided shopping experiences.
  • Track organic traffic, search rankings, conversion rates, and attributed revenue.
  • Coordinate with content and paid media teams on integrated campaign execution.

What We’re Looking For

You’ve spent 3–5 years in digital marketing and you understand that the best acquisition strategy in the world is worthless if the landing page doesn’t convert. You’ve done SEO, organic social, and CRO — and you’ve tied all of it to revenue, not vanity metrics.

You own outcomes. When conversion rate drops, you don’t wait for the next team meeting to bring it up — you’re already testing a hypothesis. You measure yourself by revenue influenced, not by traffic volume or keyword rankings in isolation.

You move with urgency. We’re launching on Amazon, scaling TikTok Shop, and rebuilding our website simultaneously. You thrive in that pace because you prioritize ruthlessly and you ship fast without sacrificing quality.

You embrace the underdog spirit. Most of the organic traffic and conversion infrastructure doesn’t exist yet. You’re building it from scratch, and that’s exactly what excites you.

You’re locked in. When a product launch or campaign demands extra effort on the conversion side, you rise to the moment. You understand that the demand your teammates create with paid media is only as valuable as the conversion experience you build to capture it.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Amazon SEO and marketplace optimization.
  • Background in DTC food, pet, or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop and social commerce.
  • CRO certification or demonstrable A/B testing experience.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary ($85K–$105K) plus bonus opportunity and equity.
  • Own the full organic and conversion function at a fast-growing DTC brand.
  • Remote work flexibility.
  • Collaborate with an experienced growth team and cutting-edge AI tools.
Salary: $85,000 – $105,000 / year
